Title: Senior Data Scientist – Optimization & MLOps
Description:
Providing Value & Impact – SwedQ

SwedQ is a consultancy company for people who want to grow, take ownership, and solve challenges that create real business value. We work with clients across a wide range of industries and help them turn technology, data, and ideas into tangible results.

We are now looking for an experienced and versatile Data Scientist who is comfortable working across data science, analytics, optimization, software engineering, and MLOps.

One of our current opportunities has a strong focus on mathematical optimization, production-grade AI, and Google Cloud Platform. However, as a consultant at SwedQ, you should enjoy applying your skills to different industries, technical environments, and business problems over time.

You do not need to fit into a narrow box. We value specialists with broad technical curiosity—the kind of person who can understand a complex business problem, explore the data, develop the solution, deploy it, and clearly explain the outcome.

What You Will Do

Depending on the assignment, you will:


Develop, maintain, and improve advanced data science and optimization solutions.
Build and enhance discrete optimization models, including Integer and Mixed Integer Programming models.
Productionize, deploy, monitor, and maintain AI and machine learning solutions in cloud environments.
Identify weaknesses in existing models and proactively implement improvements.
Build robust data preparation, aggregation, and feature engineering pipelines.
Integrate data from multiple internal and external sources.
Write clean, modular, tested, and maintainable Python code.
Implement MLOps and CI/CD practices for model deployment and lifecycle management.
Conduct exploratory and ad hoc analyses to support business decisions.
Present model outputs and analytical findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Translate business requirements and stakeholder feedback into scalable technical solutions.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Data Engineers, Product Managers, and business stakeholders.


Who are you?

We believe you have:


Several years of professional experience within data science, machine learning, optimization, or a related field.
Strong knowledge of discrete optimization, such as Integer Programming or Mixed Integer Programming.
Experience taking models beyond notebooks and operating them in a production environment.
Strong Python skills and experience building modular, production-ready software.
Strong SQL skills for data analysis, transformation, and data pipeline development.
Hands-on experience with MLOps, automated testing, deployment pipelines, and model monitoring.
Experience working with cloud-based data and machine learning platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform.
A solid understanding of software architecture and maintainable codebases.
Experience building data wrangling and aggregation pipelines from diverse data sources.
The ability to understand business problems and turn them into analytical or technical solutions.
Strong communication skills and confidence presenting complex findings in a clear and actionable way.
A proactive and collaborative mindset with the ability to take ownership in complex and sometimes ambiguous environments.
Experience working in Agile and cross-functional teams.


Nice to have

It is an advantage if you have experience with:


Optimization frameworks or solvers such as Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools, or Pyomo.
GCP services such as Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, or Cloud Composer.
dbt or similar data transformation frameworks.
Containerization and orchestration using Docker or Kubernetes.
Experiment tracking, model registries, and automated model validation.
Data visualization and communicating analytical findings through dashboards or decision-support tools.
Additional areas such as forecasting, simulation, recommendation systems, or applied machine learning.


What’s in it for you?

At SwedQ, we want to understand what motivates you.

Some people value stability, a fixed salary, pension, and strong benefits. Others want greater flexibility, more responsibility, or the opportunity to share in the value they help create. We shape the setup together based on your ambitions and what makes sense for both sides.

You will be surrounded by technically skilled and entrepreneurial colleagues who are happy to share knowledge, challenge ideas, and learn from one another.

You will also have the opportunity to influence SwedQ, contribute to internal initiatives, and develop your own ideas alongside your client assignments.

SwedQ culture

SwedQ is built around independence, accountability, and creating genuine value.

We are a diverse group of consultants, engineers, entrepreneurs, and problem-solvers with different backgrounds and perspectives. We support one another as colleagues and friends, while giving people the freedom to take ownership of their work.

We also make time to enjoy the journey together through dinners, activities, trips, competitions, and celebrations of both the big and small wins.

Perks & Benefits


Competitive compensation with different salary models available.
Occupational pension and additional pension contributions.
Private health insurance and private healthcare.
Wellness and gym allowance.
A generous professional development budget.
Time and support for personal development and open-source initiatives.
Company car or car allowance depending on your setup.
Benefits that can make everyday life easier, including home cleaning and childcare options.
A centrally located Stockholm office close to public transport and restaurants.
Daily breakfast at the SwedQ office.
Skilled colleagues and mentors who will both support and challenge you.


Does this sound like the kind of challenge you are looking for?

Let’s talk.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
We are Sweden's leading app and marketplace for booking beauty and wellness services. As a SaaS company with industry-leading software, we empower more than 16,000 professionals across the country. Our platform brings together nearly every salon and clinic in Sweden, making it easy for consumers to book appointments with hairdressers, massage therapists, podiatrists, beauty salons, chiropractors, and many other specialists—all in one place.

On Bokadirekt.se, consumers can discover, book, and pay for treatments and services in just a few clicks. Every month, our platform is visited by 3 million consumers, and more than 2 million bookings are made through our website and app. We’re growing rapidly and are currently a team of more than 100 employees, with offices in Stockholm and Luleå.

About The Role

We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data & Analytics team and help shape the future of data and AI at Bokadirekt.

As a Data Engineer, you will be responsible for building, maintaining, and evolving the data platform that powers analytics, business intelligence, and AI across the company. You'll work at the intersection of data engineering and AI, ensuring our data infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and ready to support everything from reporting and experimentation to LLM-powered features and machine learning pipelines.

You will collaborate closely with product managers, software engineers, analysts, and other stakeholders to create high-quality data products and enable data-driven decision-making throughout the organization. This is an opportunity to have a significant impact on both our technical platform and how data and AI are used to create value for millions of users every month.

What You'll Do


Design, build, and optimise scalable ELT pipelines that power analytics, reporting, and AI initiatives across the company
Build a reliable, trusted and well-documented source of truth for company KPIs
Work on the integration of AI capabilities into our data infrastructure
Collaborate on the development and deployment of machine learning solutions and AI-powered features
Identify and carry out data platform cost optimization initiatives


Who You Are


Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Physics or related field
Proven experience (4-6 years) as a Data Engineer, Data Scientist, ML Engineer or AI Engineer, ideally in a technology-driven environment
Strong proficiency in SQL and Python
Solid data engineering fundamentals with hands-on AI experience
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience with GCP (BigQuery, GCS, Gemini Agent Platform, Looker), Airflow, dbt and Cube is a plus. Bonus points for prompt engineering, LLM APIs, NL querying and RAG
Professional fluency in English


What We Offer


The opportunity to build and scale the data platform behind one of Sweden's most widely used consumer apps
The chance to work with modern data and AI technologies, helping shape the foundations for analytics, machine learning, and LLM-powered solutions
A collaborative culture built on ownership, innovation, and knowledge sharing
A flexible hybrid work model with four days in the office each week, including Wednesdays as our "Inspiration Day," when the whole company comes together for breakfast and shared activities
A modern office in the heart of Stockholm
A competitive salary and benefits package


About The Position

Start date: As soon as possible / By agreement

Location: Our office at Kungsgatan 38 in central Stockholm (hybrid)

Employment type: Full-time, permanent position

Application deadline: August 14

Application

We review applications continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Summer is here, and we are also taking some time to recharge. During the holiday period, our response times may be slightly longer than usual, and the recruitment process will resume from week 32.

Thank you for your patience. We wish you a wonderful summer and hope to hear from you soon!

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Nepa is a strategic marketing intelligence and optimization platform with AI built into everything we do — helping iconic global brands like Fjällräven, Kellogg's and Wolt make smarter marketing decisions, faster.




About the Role

As our Senior Data Scientist, you'll lead the analytical design of our most demanding work and act as the main technical point of contact with our clients. You'll set the technical standard, solve the hardest problems, and be the advisor clients trust when the stakes are high. This role suits people who want to set the approach themselves rather than follow someone else's: one engagement might have you designing a bespoke model from scratch, the next advising a client's senior leadership team on what the numbers really mean.

Your Responsibilities

As our Senior Data Scientist, your key responsibilities will include:

Leading the design and delivery of advanced analytical work — Bayesian and econometric models, larger machine learning pipelines, the problems without a standard playbook.
Leading AI-driven product work, including automated marketing mix modelling, our Trinity AI, and Creative AI — our tool for analyzing which creative elements actually drive ad performance.
Driving AI and automation across the team's delivery — and knowing where it genuinely helps and where it doesn't.
Acting as the main technical point of contact for clients, advising them on where AI and analytics create real value.
Supporting scoping and sales conversations, and spotting where the analytical agenda with a client can go deeper.
Setting methodology, tooling and automation standards, and mentoring colleagues coming up behind you.




Your Profile

To excel in this role, you should have:

A degree in a quantitative mathematics or engineering field (an advanced degree is a plus).
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
Around 3–6 years of applied experience in the data science and/or engineering space.
Deep knowledge of statistics and machine learning, with the judgement to choose the right method — and know when AI isn't the right tool.
Genuine specialist depth in your area, with the independence to define an approach when there's no template to follow.
Client-facing confidence — you can explain complex methodology clearly and act as a trusted advisor.
A track record of raising the bar for the people and processes around you.
You must have the legal right to work in Sweden. Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or relocation support for this role.
Nice to have: experience shaping or scaling an AI-driven product feature

We know great candidates don't always check every box. If this sounds like you, we'd still love to hear from you.




A Few More Details

You believe in the power of data and AI to drive smarter decisions and lasting growth.
You share our values: curiosity that sees what others don't, passion that shows, clarity over complexity, and the drive to care and act.
You want the freedom to grow in your own way, backed by the guidance and support of a close-knit team.
You take pride in delivering the clarity, speed, and impact our clients rely on.




Who We Are

At Nepa, we help great brands grow by turning insight into action. We're building a strategic marketing intelligence and optimisation platform for the AI era — connecting continuous data with sharp analytics, machine learning and deep marketing expertise, so businesses can act faster, spend smarter, and focus on what really drives results.




Our platform brings together Brand Tracking, Marketing Mix Modelling and Campaign Evaluation into one clear, AI-powered view for marketers and the C-suite alike. It's a transformation with real momentum: we're profitable, our subscription business is accelerating, and our AI-driven products are already proving out in the market. Our Continuous MMM tracks what's driving performance on an ongoing basis rather than waiting for a quarterly report, and our new Creative AI has already helped a client uncover a 40%+ potential reduction in cost-per-acquisition by identifying which creative elements in their ads actually move the needle. We're just getting started — for the right person, that's a real opportunity to help shape what comes next.




We're trusted by more than 300 blue-chip clients across 50+ markets — including brands like Fjällräven, Kellogg's and Wolt — and we track over 7,500 brands and campaigns every day. Founded in Stockholm in 2006 and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, Nepa has grown into a team of around 220 people across 10 offices on six continents. We're proud to bring clarity to complexity, and to make insight an engine for growth.




Next Steps

We review applications on a rolling basis, so don't delay — submit your application today to be considered for this exciting opportunity to join our team as a Senior Data Scientist.

Title: Machine Learning Engineer
Description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.  

We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a Machine Learning Engineer in our Stockholm office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change?

The Role 

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Viaplay, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the next generation of our data-driven products and services. Working at the intersection of personalization, customer engagement, and operational intelligence, you’ll design and deploy state-of-the-art ML systems that directly impact millions of users across our platform. 

Your responsibilities will extend far beyond model development. You’ll act as a strategic partner to product, engineering, and commercial teams, translating business objectives into scalable, high-impact ML solutions. Whether enhancing our recommendation engines, uncovering deep user insights, or enabling smarter decision-making across the organization, your work will be central to Viaplay’s continued growth and innovation. 

You’ll join a high-performing, inclusive, and curious team of ML Engineers, Data Scientists, Analysts, and Data Engineers. Together, we foster a culture of experimentation, shared ownership, and technical excellence. Our recommender system already powers engaging user experiences, and we’re only at the beginning of our machine learning journey. 

What You’ll Be Doing 


Design, develop, and deploy scalable machine learning models for recommendation, prediction, and classification use cases. 
Own and lead end-to-end ML initiatives, from ideation and stakeholder alignment to development, deployment, and ongoing performance evaluation.
Translate business needs into structured ML problems and deliver measurable, impactful outcomes. 
Build robust, production-ready pipelines and monitor ML systems in a cloud-native environment. 
Conduct advanced statistical analyses to uncover trends in user behavior, content performance, and platform engagement. 
Collaborate closely with product, engineering, content, commercial, and marketing teams to drive data-informed decision-making. 
Contribute to a culture of experimentation, innovation, and continuous learning within the data team. 


What We’re Looking For 

We're seeking someone who combines technical depth with strategic thinking and a curious, problem-solving mindset. 

We understand you may feel confident ticking certain boxes more than others and that’s why we always keep an open mind in our recruitment process. But, in order to thrive in this role, we do believe you’ll have at least some experience in the following: 


Proven experience leading ML projects end-to-end, from problem definition and stakeholder alignment to deployment and monitoring in production. 
Expertise in one or more ML domains such as LLMs, NLP, recommendation systems, or reinforcement learning. 
Ability to build ML solutions that are scalable, robust, and explainable, not just performant in isolation. 
Strong experience deploying ML models in cloud environments (preferably AWS) and using containerization tools like Docker .
Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Airflow for reliable ML pipeline execution and monitoring 
Solid software engineering fundamentals.
5+ years of hands-on experience in applied Machine Learning within production environments.
Strong academic background in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.


It’s a bonus if you have: 


Experience with recommender systems, personalization, or content optimization — ideally in media, streaming, or e-commerce. 
Familiarity with MLOps practices, including CI/CD for ML, model monitoring, and production observability. 
Exposure to real-time or near-real-time ML architectures and streaming data systems.


What we offer you


We’ve got you covered! 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.
Your wellbeing matters. We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.
Flexibility that works. We follow a hybrid model with at least three days a week in the office, giving you the best mix of collaboration and focus time.
A safe space to grow and up-skill. Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.
An innovative environment with Hack Days once a year. This week-long initiative allows you to think outside the box and deliver creative, technical solutions that (more often than not) go on to be implemented, either in our product or our ways of working.
Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do. So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including serier & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more. 


Hit play today 

If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position. 

Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

Title: Data Scientist (Industrial PhD Track)
Description:
About Braive




Braive is the AI-powered mental health platform that supports clinicians and patients through the full treatment journey, from assessment and treatment planning through delivery, follow-up, and outcome measurement. We are MDR Class IIA certified, clinically validated, and built in the Nordics, and our partners include leading healthcare providers and insurers across Norway and Sweden. Research has been central to Braive from the beginning: between 2021 and 2025 we led a research project with KTH Royal Institute of Technology and the University of Oslo, developing machine learning methods for personalised digital mental health care. The proof points back it up: around 50% average symptom reduction and 80% patient improvement within six weeks.




We are now looking for a senior data scientist who can help build on this research foundation into continuously improving clinical products and services.




Why this role matters




Braive's ambition is to make care measurably more precise, adaptive and continuous. That depends on being able to learn systematically from every completed treatment: what worked, for whom, in which circumstances and at what point in the journey. This role is where that learning happens. You develop the analytical and machine learning capabilities that turn accumulated clinical data into a better next decision for the clinician, better next functionality for the product and more effective care for the next patient.




This is also an Industrial PhD track. You will complete a doctorate while employed at Braive, with KTH as the likely degree-conferring institution and continued research collaboration with UiO. The research question will be developed jointly by yourself, Braive and your academic supervisors, and the doctoral component is subject to formal university admission, agreement with the academic partner, and funding through the Research Council of Norway's Industrial PhD Scheme.




What you'll do




Develop statistical and machine learning models that support personalised assessment, treatment planning, monitoring and follow-up, using approaches such as longitudinal and hierarchical modelling, causal inference, treatment-effect estimation and dynamic prediction
Own and improve Braive's dbt project and analytical datasets, including staging-to-mart architecture, dimensional models, automated data quality tests and defensible definitions for clinical, operational and commercial reporting
Work with product and engineering to operationalise validated models into production, including reproducible pipelines, monitoring, safeguards and human oversight for clinical decision support
Evaluate models for discrimination, calibration, robustness, fairness and clinical usefulness, and contribute to the technical and clinical documentation required in a regulated medical-device environment
Translate clinical and business questions into scientific problems and communicate findings accurately to both technical and non-technical audiences
Collaborate with psychologists, researchers, product managers, engineers and commercial colleagues at Braive, plus academic supervisors and research groups at KTH and UiO
Shape the doctoral research direction jointly with Braive and your academic supervisors, and contribute to research protocols, publications and funding applications




What success looks like




In your first six months, you understand Braive's clinical data, analytical architecture and regulatory context deeply, priority analytical datasets are more reliable and better documented, core clinical and treatment-process measures have agreed definitions, and at least one substantive analysis has informed a clinical, product, or commercial decision. The doctoral research direction is defined with Braive and the prospective academic supervisors, and the Industrial PhD application is in motion.




Within a year, you have established a reproducible framework for analysing treatment trajectories and outcomes, developed and evaluated at least one advanced statistical or machine learning approach on Braive's clinical data, and given clinical and product teams more reliable measures to work with.




Research suitable for publication is underway, and the working relationship with the academic environment is productive. Over time, this role helps make Braive's data and research capabilities a genuine clinical and strategic advantage: the ability to learn systematically from accumulated experience, personalise care while maintaining clinical oversight, evaluate new functionality with scientifically defensible methods and advance the science of precise, adaptive and continuous mental healthcare.




About you




Completed master's degree in data science, statistics, computer science, machine learning, biostatistics, computational psychology or a related quantitative discipline, meeting the admission requirements of the relevant doctoral programme, with no previously completed doctorate (per Industrial PhD Scheme eligibility)
Genuine interest in completing an Industrial PhD as an integrated part of your role at Braive
Strong programming skills in Python or R, and advanced SQL with real feeling for performance, data quality and analytical correctness
Strong foundation in statistical inference and applied machine learning, with experience working on complex observational or longitudinal datasets
Experience with dbt or comparable transformation frameworks, dimensional modelling, cloud data warehouses and modern BI or semantic-layer tools (we use ThoughtSpot)
Able to design analytical approaches with clear scientific rationale, evaluate and communicate uncertainty and bias and produce reproducible, well-documented work
Able to work independently and collaborate effectively across clinical, technical, academic and commercial disciplines, communicating clearly in written and spoken English




How the Industrial PhD component works

The doctoral project will be developed jointly between yourself, Braive, and the academic institution. You will be employed by Braive throughout, with KTH as the expected degree-conferring institution and UiO contributing through research collaboration or co-supervision where appropriate. The likely structure is a four-year project in which at least 75% of your time is devoted to doctoral research and up to 25% to related responsibilities at Braive. The final structure will be agreed with the academic institution and set out in the funding application and employment arrangements. Publication, IP, data access, and use of research outputs will be governed by formal agreements between the participating organisations.




You can find a thorough deep dive of the role and PhD here.




What we offer




Access to clinically meaningful and scientifically valuable real-world data
Close collaboration with experienced clinical, technical, and academic colleagues
The opportunity to undertake doctoral research while remaining closely connected to practical clinical and product development
Substantial ownership of an important area of Braive’s research and technology strategy
A working environment that supports professional development, intellectual curiosity, and responsible innovation




Why join Braive?




This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of data science, clinical psychology, healthcare delivery and applied research.




The central question is not simply how to produce more dashboards or more accurate predictions. It is how data from real treatment journeys can be used responsibly to improve the next clinical decision, support the next clinician, and provide more effective care for the next patient.




The person joining us will have the opportunity to help answer that question scientifically and to turn the resulting knowledge into systems used in everyday mental healthcare.

Title: AI/ML-utvecklare
Description:
Är du en erfaren AI/ML-utvecklare som vill utveckla och produktionssätta lösningar som gör skillnad på riktigt? Då kan du vara en bra match för oss på Softhouse!

Vad vi kommer att göra tillsammans 🧑‍💻

Som AI/ML-utvecklare på Softhouse hjälper du våra kunder att planera, bygga och realisera sina AI/ML-projekt i olika leveranser och kunduppdrag. Du tar helhetsansvar för maskininlärningsmodellers livscykel, från datainsamling och utveckling, till utvärdering och stabil driftsättning i produktion.

Vårt AI-team arbetar både självständigt och tillsammans i leveranser och träffas regelbundet för att diskutera utmaningar och dela kunskap. Här ges du utrymme och möjlighet att vara med och utveckla Softhouse erbjudande inom AI samt skapa värde och driva innovation för våra kunder.

Vad vi söker hos dig 📌

På Softhouse värdesätter vi vår konsultmässighet högt. För oss handlar det inte bara om dina tekniska färdigheter, utan också om att du är kommunikativ, lyhörd och driven med förmåga att bygga förtroende hos våra kunder.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har minst 5 års erfarenhet inom:


AI/ML-utveckling i Python (särskilt bibliotek som Numpy, Scipy och Matplotlib).
Implementering och produktionssättning av maskininlärningsmodeller.
Hela ML-livscykeln, från datainsamling och utveckling, till modellträning, utvärdering och driftsättning.


Vi tror att du har en masterexamen eller PhD inom Teknisk Matematik, Teknisk Fysik, Datateknik, Elektroteknik eller motsvarande. Då konsultrollen innebär mycket kundkontakt krävs det att du är flytande i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Det är även meriterande om du har erfarenhet av MLOps, on-premises-implementering och driftsättning av AI-lösningar, samt hantering av stora datamängder.

Title: Senior Data Scientist / AI Engineer - Generative AI
Description:
Job ID: 1878

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Scientist / AI Engineer to build and scale Generative AI applications. The role is permanent based in Stockholm or Helsinki. We work in a hybrid model and expect team members to work three days per week in the office. This is an English-speaking working environment.

About The Team

You will join Nordea’s AI & Machine Learning team, part of the group financial crime prevention (GFCP) unit that provides financial crime prevention services across Nordea. We use AI to improve how we detect and investigate financial crime across the bank, helping to keep our customers, our company, and society safe. We are a team of about 25 colleagues based in Stockholm, Helsinki and Copenhagen. We have already launched Nordea’s first generative AI product and are now building the next wave of high impact generative AI use cases.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

Why this role is exciting

This is an opportunity to work on real-world Generative AI applications in a domain where quality, robustness, and responsible AI matter. You will help turn ideas into production-grade AI solutions in financial crime prevention, working closely with business stakeholders and experienced colleagues across the Nordics.

In this role, you will


Identify and prototype high-impact GenAI projects with business stakeholders
Build, deploy and monitor production-grade Gen AI applications
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, engineering, data) to deliver end-to-end solutions
Design and implement evaluation frameworks to measure and improve application quality
Contribute to best practices, tooling and architecture for Generative AI development
Document models and evaluations to meet risk and compliance standards and ensure responsible use of AI


Your background and skills:


MSc or PhD in Data Science, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, or related fields. Equivalent practical experience is also valued.
3+ years experience delivering production ML/AI systems in python
Experience developing generative AI applications, using LLM APIs, RAG, agentic frameworks, or emerging patterns (MCP, A2A, etc.)
Experience with structured testing, evaluation metrics, and experimentation for AI applications
Experience with standard DevOps practices: git, observability, and production debugging
Solid understanding of systems design for ML & AI applications
A proven track-record of turning ideas into prototypes, and prototypes into production applications
A knack for tackling complex problems and creating simple solutions
Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders


What We Offer

People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 03/09/2026. For more information you are welocome to contact Wen Zhou, Head of Unit, at wen.zhou@nordea.com. A Background Check will be performed for the person selected for this position, including internal applicants.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

For candidates in Finland: A security clearance will be performed for the person selected for this position.

For candidates in Sweden: For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

Title: 2 Data & Machine Learning Engineers ( 1 Senior & 1 Mid-level/Junior)
Description:
emagine is currently looking for two Data & Machine Learning Engineers (Senior and Mid-level) for a global technology client based in Stockholm.

Start Date: 2026-09-01

End Date: 2027-08-31 (extension possible)

Location: Stockholm, Sweden (Hybrid)

Assignment Overview

Our client is undertaking a strategic initiative to strengthen its data-driven decision-making capabilities within a large-scale, high-volume messaging and communications environment. The consultants will play a key role in building and enhancing data pipelines, real-time analytics capabilities, machine learning foundations, and intelligent routing and pricing systems.

The assignment will be delivered within a modern cloud-native architecture built around Go microservices, Kafka-based event streaming, ClickHouse data platforms, Kubernetes, and machine learning-enabled services.

We are looking for one Senior Data & Machine Learning Engineer and one Mid-Level Data & Machine Learning Engineer.

Must-Have Requirements (non-negotiable)

Technical Skills


Strong Data Engineering background with software development experience, preferably in Go (Golang)
Experience working with databases, ideally ClickHouse
Experience with Kubernetes and application deployment


Personal Qualities


Strong communication and collaboration skills
Proactive problem solver
Curious and eager to learn
Team-oriented and supportive of colleagues


Highly Meritorious


Experience within telecommunications, messaging, routing, billing, or CPaaS environments
Experience with Machine Learning Engineering and production deployment of ML models


Senior Data & Machine Learning Engineer

About The Assignment

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data & Machine Learning Engineer to design and develop intelligent data products and predictive capabilities supporting mission-critical messaging services.

You will work within a large-scale data ecosystem and be responsible for creating data foundations, scoring mechanisms, forecasting models, anomaly detection capabilities, and machine learning pipelines that enable automation and business optimization.

This role requires a combination of strong software engineering, data engineering, and machine learning expertise.

Responsibilities

Pricing Intelligence & Forecasting


Develop simulation models and forecasting capabilities
Build cost and margin prediction models
Deliver pricing recommendations based on authoritative business data


Dynamic Route Scoring


Create scoring models using real-time and historical datasets
Continuously evaluate route quality and performance metrics
Support automated routing decision engines


Real-Time Anomaly Detection


Build highly responsive detection models
Identify service degradations, network anomalies, and operational issues in near real time
Enable automated reactions and alerts


Data Architecture


Design scalable and AI-ready ClickHouse data models
Ensure data consistency, modularity, and quality standards
Support future analytics and machine learning initiatives


Production Engineering


Develop and integrate solutions within a Go-based microservices ecosystem
Deploy and maintain machine learning inference services
Ensure high performance and low-latency operation in streaming environments


Required Experience

Programming


Strong experience with Go (Golang)
Strong experience with Python


Data & Infrastructure


ClickHouse or similar analytical databases
Apache Kafka
Protobuf
Redis
Kubernetes
Helm
Grafana
Prometheus


Machine Learning


Dynamic scoring models
Forecasting and simulation models
Real-time anomaly detection
Streaming inference architectures
MLOps and production deployment
Feature engineering and data preparation


Preferred Experience


Telecommunications
Messaging platforms
Routing optimization
Billing systems
Pricing engines


Mid-Level Data & Machine Learning Engineer

About The Assignment

We are looking for an ambitious Data & Machine Learning Engineer who will help build and maintain the data infrastructure powering advanced analytics and machine learning initiatives.

Working closely with senior technical specialists, you will focus on developing data ingestion pipelines, preparing high-quality datasets, building microservices, and supporting production machine learning workflows.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to deepen their expertise in data engineering, distributed systems, and MLOps.

Responsibilities

Data Pipeline Development


Build and maintain Go-based Kafka ingestion pipelines
Process both real-time and aggregated data streams
Ensure scalability, reliability, and data quality


Data Preparation & Structuring


Clean, normalize, and structure data
Create AI-ready datasets and ClickHouse tables
Support downstream analytics and machine learning workloads


Microservices Development


Develop APIs and supporting backend services
Expose aggregated metrics and data products internally
Contribute to platform scalability and reliability


ML Platform Support


Prepare data features for machine learning workflows
Support deployment and monitoring of ML solutions
Collaborate closely with senior engineers and architects


Monitoring & Reliability


Implement observability and monitoring solutions
Utilize Prometheus and Grafana
Ensure stable and reliable production systems


Required Experience

Programming


Good proficiency in Go (Golang)
Experience with Python


Data & Infrastructure


SQL
Analytical databases (ClickHouse experience is highly desirable)
Kafka or similar messaging systems
Protobuf
Docker
Kubernetes
Grafana
Prometheus


Desired Mindset


Strong interest in data engineering and machine learning
Understanding of feature engineering and data preparation
Desire to learn MLOps and production ML deployments
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Vill du använda data och AI för att lösa affärskritiska utmaningar som påverkar miljontals kundmöten varje dag? Som Senior Data Scientist på ICA Sverige får du arbeta nära verksamheten och utveckla datadrivna lösningar för flera av ICAs verksamheter.

Om rollen som Senior Data scientist

Som Senior Data Scientist kommer du att vara en nyckelspelare inom vårt Data Science-team. I din roll ansvarar du för att driva data science-projekt från konceptstadiet till produktion, samt säkerställa att lösningarna är tekniskt effektiva och i linje med verksamhetens krav. Du förväntas även vara en mentor för juniora kollegor och bidra till att höja den tekniska nivån inom teamet, men också se till att lösningarna inte bara fungerar tekniskt utan också levererar maximalt affärsvärde. 

Det betyder att du kommer att: 


Arbeta nära våra Data Engineers och verksamhetsexperter för att utveckla och implementera datadrivna lösningar. 
Agera teknisk expert i komplexa projekt, med fokus på skalbarhet och affärsnytta. 
Vara ansvarig för hela data science-flödet, från insamling och bearbetning av data till avancerad modellering och implementering. 
Arbeta med stora datamängder, identifiera användbara signaler och omsätta dessa i affärsstrategier. 
Aktivt delta i beslut om tekniska vägval och lösningsstrategier inom AI och data science. 



Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som har lång erfarenhet och djup kunskap inom data science och maskininlärning. Du har tidigare arbetat i seniora roller där du lett komplexa data science-projekt från idé till produktion och har erfarenhet av att arbeta med affärskritiska frågor. 

Vi ser gärna att du har: 


Minst 5 års erfarenhet av arbete som Data Scientist, med fokus på maskininlärning, AI och avancerad analys. 
Gedigen erfarenhet av att arbeta med Python, SQL och molnbaserade lösningar (gärna i GCP). 
Stark kompetens inom statistik, matematik eller datavetenskap, med dokumenterad erfarenhet av att omsätta teorier till praktiska affärsdrivna lösningar. 
Erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt, DevOps, CI/CD, och andra moderna mjukvaruutvecklingskoncept. 



Som person är du analytisk, nyfiken och lösningsorienterad med ett starkt eget driv. Du har en förmåga att kommunicera och anpassa tekniska insikter till affärsnytta för både tekniska och icke-tekniska stakeholders samt delar med dig av din kunskap till mer juniora kollegor. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift.

Vad händer nu?

Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag då urval sker löpande, sista ansökningsdag 30/8.

För frågor om tjänsten, kontakta rekryterande chef Ola Ottosson, ola.ottosson@ica.se och för frågor om processen, kontakta rekryterare Josefine Åsmyr, josefine.asmyr@ica.se.

ICA ska spegla våra kunder och samhället, vi strävar därför efter att anställa människor med olika bakgrund, kompetenser, kunskap och erfarenheter. Om roller kräver det så behöver du genomgå tester, bakgrundskontroller och drogtestning innan anställning.

Title: Quantitative Analyst
Description:
Om tjänsten

Myntro söker nu en engagerad kvantitativ analytiker som vill vara med och forma nästa steg i vår utveckling. Du kommer att vara med och utveckla den finansiella infrastrukturen i vårt kreditmarknadsbolag. Tillsammans utvecklar vi de modeller, informationsflöden och processer som krävs för en modern treasuryfunktion och för rapportering till Finansinspektionen. Här får du inte bara analysera data – du är också med och definierar vilken data vi behöver, hur den ska flöda genom organisationen och hur vi skapar rätt beslutsunderlag för verksamheten.

Du blir en del av ett litet team där du kommer att spela en nyckelroll i att analysera och modellera data kopplade till våra finansiella produkter och kommer att arbeta nära våra experter inom risk, affärsutveckling och inköp av portföljer. En viktig del av arbetet innebär att kravställa mot IT där vi håller samman data för redovisning, affärsbeslut och riskbedömning. Det är en roll där du får kombinera analytiskt djup med ett nära samarbete över flera funktioner.

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:


Kravställa och samarbeta med IT och verksamheten för att utveckla datalösningar som stödjer treasuryfunktionen och den regulatoriska rapporteringen.
Bidra till utvecklingen av processer och rutiner för datainsamling och analys.
Kontinuerlig uppföljning och hantering av finansiella risker såsom likviditets-, valuta- och ränterisk.
Analysera och utvärdera data för att identifiera trender och mönster i NPL-portföljerna.
Presentera analyser och rekommendationer till ledningen för att stödja strategiska beslut.


Vem söker vi?

Vi tror att du har arbetat några år i en liknande analytisk roll och trivs i miljöer där du får kombinera teknisk problemlösning med affärsförståelse. Du motiveras av att sätta dig in i komplexa frågeställningar och tycker om att hitta smarta lösningar tillsammans med andra.

Du är en person som gärna tar initiativ, ställer frågor och ser möjligheter till förbättring. Du kan förklara avancerade analyser och tekniska resonemang på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt, oavsett mottagare. För att lyckas i rollen ser vi också att du har en stark analytisk förmåga och god erfarenhet av att arbeta med stora datamängder, analysverktyg och programmering. Du uppskattar en miljö där mycket fortfarande byggs upp och där du får vara med och påverka hur lösningarna ska se ut.

Vi ser gärna att du har:


Akademisk examen inom finans, matematik, statistik, ingenjörsvetenskap eller motsvarande.
Flerårig erfarenhet av kvantitativ analys och datamodellering, gärna inom finansiella tjänster.
Goda kunskaper i Python, SQL, C# eller andra relevanta analys- och programmeringsverktyg. Erfarenhet av att arbete i Cloud-miljö och med API-lösningar är meriterande.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med stora datamängder.
God förmåga att kommunicera komplexa analysresultat på ett tydligt sätt.


Vad erbjuder vi dig?

Vi på Myntro vet att våra medarbetare är nyckeln till vår framgång. Vår kultur präglas av omtanke, ansvar och en stark tro på att vi lyckas bäst när vi gör det tillsammans. På vårt kontor i Stockholm välkomnas du till ljusa, moderna lokaler med goda pendlingsmöjligheter och närhet till både kollegor och stadskärnan. Här får du en arbetsmiljö där energi och framåtanda präglar vardagen och där våra centrala värden – collaboration, customer focus, personal accountability och simplicity – är en självklar del av hur vi arbetar tillsammans varje dag.

Intresserad? Varmt välkommen att ansöka!

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med placering i Stockholm i gruppen Capital Management som ansvarar för treasury, kapitalplanering och regulatorisk rapportering. Sista ansökningsdag är 1.9.2026. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

För mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef, Olle Mattsson, Financial Director Investments & Deposits, olle.mattsson@myntro.com.

För mer information om rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen kontakta Azra Semic, Talent Acquisition Specialist: azra.semic@myntro.com.

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
Born autonomous. Born electric.

Since 2016, our technology has connected global communities with the things they need – and all without the emissions. We’re made up of experts in multiple fields and that’s how we’ve developed a new way to move goods. This is technology purpose-built for the industry. This is safer, cleaner, and more reliable movement.

We are Einride and this is how we build a better future.

Want to be part of transforming road freight – for good? Einride is showing the world a new way to move, based on the latest digital, electric and autonomous technologies. Through freight capacity as a service, we enable businesses around the world to accelerate towards their sustainability goals.

Founded in 2016, Einride became the first company in the world to deploy a cab-less autonomous electric vehicle on a public road (Sweden, 2019). In 2022, we were the first to successfully operate such a vehicle on a US public road. Today our award-winning technology has been launched across 8 countries (and counting). Our clients are some of the world’s biggest shippers, including Fortune 500 companies. We are also operating Sweden’s largest truck dedicated public charging network and counting.

We are looking for an enthusiastic, creative Analytics Engineer to join our growing Analytics Platform team. As our second hire in this role, you will partner closely with our existing Analytics Engineer, Data Engineers, and Business Analysts to scale our data foundations and elevate our analytics practices.

You won’t just be writing code; you will be a key player in shaping our data architecture, championing data literacy, and empowering the transport industry to go electric through simple, beautiful, and highly effective data solutions.

You Will


Anticipate business needs: Work proactively with stakeholders to not just understand, but predict their future needs in terms of datasets and dashboards.
Scale our data foundations: Design robust data models and build reliable pipelines alongside our engineering teams.
Drive business insights: Define and implement key metrics to assess business performance and enhance our analytics-driven products.
Optimize our stack: Continuously improve our analytics frameworks, BI tools, and data documentation.
Champion data literacy: Educate colleagues across the organization on data modeling and BI tooling to empower them to do their jobs more efficiently.


We Expect You To Have


Passion for high data quality and experience scaling analytics workflows.
Strong skills in SQL, data modeling, and version control (Git).
Proficiency in modern data warehousing and orchestration. Our core stack is BigQuery, dbt, and Dagster - you don't need to be a day-one expert in these exact tools, but you must have solid experience with them or their direct equivalents.
Solid end-to-end development experience with BI tools. We use Looker, but expertise in similar tools (like Tableau or Qlik Sense) is perfectly fine.
A proven ability to thrive in both collaborative team settings and independent work.


Ideally, You Also Bring


Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (we use Terraform).
Experience with a programming language for data analysis (e.g., Python, R).
A strong eye for UI/UX design in dashboards and data visualization.
Solid business acumen, financial literacy, and an understanding of predictive modeling.


This is a full-time position based anywhere in Stockholm or Gothenburg. You will be part of a truly diverse, high performing team with a common passion for sustainability and making things happen in an innovative way. We recommend that you submit your application as soon as possible since selection and interviews are held continually.

At Einride, we are innovators, building solutions the world has never seen before – but urgently needs. That’s why we take action, and it’s why we are always eager to be challenged. We know that our best innovations come from having a diverse mix of people, including those of different experiences, career paths, and walks of life. By coming together and sharing our perspectives openly – by disagreeing, discussing, and committing – we deliver greater impact.

Please note: Our recruitment process includes an online candidate assessment via Alva Labs and a standard background check prior to employment.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Har du erfarenhet av att designa, utveckla och testa lösningar inom avancerad analys? Är du redo att ta nästa steg i din karriär med möjligheter och utveckling som ledord? Vill du, precis som vi, skapa affärsdrivna end-to-end lösningar som gör verklig skillnad? Då ser vi fram emot att höra ifrån dig!

Vem är du?

Du har ett genuint teknikintresse och drivs av att utvecklas tillsammans med ditt team. Du delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och är nyfiken på att lära dig av andra. Du är trygg i att ta ansvar för uppgifter där du får strukturera och identifiera affärsmässiga samt tekniska mål, och driva arbetet framåt. Du har lätt för att kommunicera resultat till olika målgrupper, oavsett teknisk nivå och du tar gärna ansvar för leveranser från start till mål.

Du är lösningsorienterad och ser alltid till att kunden får den bästa möjliga lösningen. Eftersom tjänsten även innehåller en och annan fika, tror vi att du gillar att nätverka med kollegor och tillsammans utforska nya idéer, erbjudanden och tjänster. Du är en lagspelare som gärna stöttar dina kollegor när behov uppstår.

Du brinner för att designa, implementera och agera rådgivare inom datalösningar för avancerad analys. Med en operativ inställning omfamnar du DevOps/MLOps och har ett starkt fokus på automation och end-to-end ägarskap.

Vi vill jobba med dig som


har 3+ års erfarenhet av design, utveckling och testning av avancerade BI-lösningar.
har erfarenhet av att implementera lösningar i exempelvis Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake & Snowflake.
har hands-on erfarenhet av programmering inom SQL och Python.
har erfarenhet av att hantera stora datamängder med hjälp av distribuerade ramverk, såsom Apache Spark, för att möjliggöra skalbar och effektiv databehandling.
behärskar svenska och engelska.
har erfarenhet av att utveckla Power BI-rapporter.


Ett plus om du har erfarenhet av


Data Vault
DBT (Data Build Tool)
Machine Learning och AI lösningar


Vårt team

I teamet Data-Driven Transformation samarbetar vi nära med våra kunder för att omvandla data till konkret värde vilket leder till tryggare beslut, effektivare arbetssätt och framgångsrika organisationer.

Vår ambition är att kombinera professionalism och entreprenörsanda och därigenom bidra med både kompetens och kreativitet. Vi strävar efter att vara en partner som inte bara levererar lösningar, utan också inspirerar till utveckling.

Vi är både rådgivare och teknisk partner inom data-drivna system, från design till implementation av lösningar för såväl avancerad analys som machine learning. Det kan handla om att samla in, strukturera och kvalitetssäkra data, skapa visuella rapporter eller möjliggöra mer proaktivt beslutsfattande.

Vårt team innehåller en dynamisk mix av erfarna experter och nya talanger, vilket skapar både energi och arbetsglädje i våra leveranser och interna initiativ. Vi tror på att växa tillsammans genom kompetensutveckling, kunskapsdelning och sociala aktiviteter som stärker både teamkänsla och konsultrollen.

Kompensation och förmåner

Vår förmånspolicy är utvecklad för att möta både dina professionella och personliga behov. I vårt omfattande förmånspaket ingår friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension och frivillig sjukvårdsförsäkring. Vår ersättningsmodell består av en konkurrenskraftig fast del och en rörlig del som ger dig möjlighet att påverka din lön baserat på din prestation och ambition. Vi erbjuder både professionell och personlig utveckling.

Nyfiken? Vi svarar gärna på frågor, eller berättar mer om oss över en kaffe - du kan enkelt komma i kontakt med oss: tyra.drakenberg@accigo.se

Läs gärna mer om oss och träffa våra medarbetare på vår karriärsida: https://karriar.accigo.se/

Accigo är ett konsultbolag som hjälper företag och organisationer med digital affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling med tekniken som möjliggörare. För oss handlar digitalisering till 90% om människor och 10% om teknik. Det är när samspelet mellan människa och teknik fungerar som digitaliseringens fulla styrka visar sig.

För många handlar digitalisering mest om teknik. För oss är det så otroligt mycket större. Digitalisering kan få både människor och organisationer att våga sikta högre, följa sina drömmar och öppna dörrar som de inte ens visste fanns. Och när man ser igenom tekniken och börjar skönja vilka möjligheter som gömmer sig där bakom. Då ser man att framtiden kan vara en fantastisk plats – fylld av mänsklig energi och värme – och digitalisering är inget annat än vår superkraft för att komma dit.

Title: Data Engineer (m/f/d)| Legal AI Tech Scale-Up | Full Remote
Description:
Your team

As a Data Engineer (f/d/m), you will play a key role in our Data Expansion Squad, which is responsible for integrating and operationalizing legal data from multiple jurisdictions. The team transforms heterogeneous source data into a unified, high-quality foundation that powers search, retrieval, and AI-supported workflows across our products.

Felix, our VP AI & Data Engineering, will guide you through your journey at Noxtua. With deep expertise in AI systems, Felix leads with a passion for innovation and a collaborative approach, ensuring every team member thrives.

You will work closely with AI, engineering, and legal domain experts to adapt and extend existing data workflows for new customer datasets and source formats. Your work will focus on understanding source structures, defining robust mappings, standardizing and enriching content, and ensuring that data is integrated in a way that is reliable, scalable, and easy to use in downstream systems. Our Tech Team of around 32 people, including UI Engineers, UI Designers, AI Engineers, Data Engineers, as well as Fullstack, Backend, and DevOps Engineers. Within that team, the Data Expansion Team provides the data foundation, structure, and metadata needed for our agent-based systems to retrieve relevant legal information efficiently and reliably across jurisdictions.

About You


Experience: at least 2 years of professional experience in data engineering, and being involved in successfully deployed projects
Programming: Strong Python skills with experience in designing robust data pipelines
Technical Expertise: Experience in building and maintaining reliable ET and RAG pipelines and a solid understanding of data modeling, quality, filtering, validation, and consistency
Infrastructure: Familiarity with containerization (Docker), CI/CD pipelines, and version control (Git)
Fundamentals: Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, system design principles, and software engineering best practices
Expertise in working with graph databases and familiarity with developing and deploying NLP models is a bonus
Language: English proficiency at the C2 level


Your Responsibilities


Design, build, and optimize end-to-end ETL pipelines for legal data from multiple jurisdictions, including cleaning, transformation, chunking, validation, embedding, and ingestion into vector databases
Work extensively with XML-based legal data feeds: parse, validate, normalize, and transform XML structures into scalable internal schemas and unified document formats
Develop and maintain data models and storage schemas that support continuously updated datasets while ensuring consistency, scalability, and accuracy across diverse datasets and large amounts of data
Coordinate data handover and integration from multiple internal and external data providers, including official sources, APIs, and web scraping pipelines, ensuring reliable and timely updates
Implement and continuously refine metadata enrichment strategies to maximize searchability, ranking quality, and relevance of legal information in vector databases.
Build and maintain a high-performance search and retrieval infrastructure enabling agent-based systems to call search functions and retrieve the most relevant legal information efficiently
Collaborate with product, AI, and legal domain experts to deliver high-quality, reliable data solutions
Own the data integration of one jurisdiction end-to-end


Our offer to you

Building Europe's sovereign Legal AI is ambitious, meaningful work — and we want the people doing it to be properly looked after. Our benefits are built around flexibility, real-time off to recharge, and the setup to do your best work from wherever you are.


Remote: 100% remote work possible (given a German residence), other countries upon request
Working hours: Flexible working hours
Vacation: 26 days + December 24th & 31st off, + 1 additional vacation day per year of employment (up to 30 days)
Discounts: e.g., Urban Sports Club Membership, depending on location
Equipment: Laptop (Lenovo or Mac), plus €1,000 net home office setup budget (paid with your first salary)


Mid-Level Salary Ranges gross per year:


Germany: €58k – €72k EUR
France: €48k – €59k EUR
Switzerland: 77k – 96k CHF (≈ €75k – €93k EUR)
Sweden: 667k – 828k SEK (≈ €58k – €72k EUR)
Austria: €57k – €71k EUR
Italy: €46k – €58k EUR
Poland: 168k – 209k PLN (≈ €39k – €48k EUR)
Croatia: €35k – €43k EUR
Slovakia: €34k – €42k EUR


The actual offer within the range depends on your relevant experience, demonstrated impact, and interview outcome — not on negotiation skill or gender. In line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive, we are happy to discuss the criteria for placement within the range during the interview process.

For other countries you will get the information within your invitation to a potential interview.

About Us

Noxtua is Europe’s sovereign Legal AI. This legally competent AI covers the entire spectrum of legal text work – from information gathering (research) and analysis of complex issues (understanding) to document creation (drafting). The legally compliant AI meets the professional, criminal, and data protection requirements for lawyers (e.g. Section 203 German Criminal Code, Section 43e German Federal Code for Lawyers), is certified according to BSI C5, TISAX, ISO 27001, 9001, 27018, 27017, and 42001. The tech company Noxtua has formed exclusive partnerships with leading European publishing houses from Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Poland, the Czech Republic, and Slovakia for the Legal AI Workspaces Beck-Noxtua, MANZ-Noxtua, Swiss-Noxtua, Beck-Noxtua Poland, Beck-Noxtua Czech Republic and Beck-Noxtua Slovakia.

Founded in 2017 in the German capital as a result of a research project by Dr. Leif-Nissen Lundbæk and Professor Dr. Michael Huth at Oxford University and Imperial College London, the European legal tech company has many years of experience in developing GDPR-compliant AI solutions and now has offices in Paris, Berlin, Zagreb, and Munich. Strategic partners including Germany’s leading legal publisher C.H.BECK as well as the leading law firms CMS and Dentons have invested around 81 million EURO in the European scaleup as part of its Series B.

We explicitly encourage women to apply, as they are currently underrepresented. Our goal is to build a diverse and inclusive work environment that values different perspectives. Of course, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals – regardless of gender, ethnic origin, religion, disability, age, or sexual identity.

Title: Analytics Engineer II
Description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

We’re looking for an Analytics Engineer II to join Spotify's Platform Central Data (PCD) squad, a cross-functional Data Engineering and Analytics Engineering team within the Platform Mission. You’ll help build and maintain trusted analytical models, metrics, and data products that power developer productivity, platform health, and leadership decision-making. Working closely with Data Engineers, Product, Engineering, and Platform partners, you’ll translate platform signals into reliable, well-modeled data assets that help Spotify ship faster and safer.

What You"ll Do


Build and maintain analytical data models using dbt (or similar SQL-based transformation frameworks) in BigQuery for a broad set of stakeholders
Build and operate reliable data pipelines using SQL, with a focus on testing, observability, and CI/CD
Help define and evolve key metrics for platform health, developer productivity, and ML/AI platform adoption
Partner with Data Engineers on upstream pipelines and collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to scope and deliver insights
Improve data quality, performance, and cost efficiency across pipelines and models, including troubleshooting and backfills
Contribute to dashboards and self-serve data products that enable better decision-making across teams
Follow and contribute to data quality, testing, and documentation practices across the analytics layer
Participate in a fair support rotation for key datasets, pipelines, and analytical products


Who You Are


You have 2+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related field
You have strong SQL skills and experience with data modelling
You are experienced with dbt (or similar SQL-based transformation frameworks) and a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Databricks SQL
You are familiar with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or Flyte
You care about data quality, reliability, and testability
You are comfortable working with BI/visualisation tools such as Looker or Tableau
You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical partners
You are able to prioritize and deliver in a fast-moving environment
You have experience with platform or developer productivity data, experimentation, or ML/AI metrics


Where You'll Be

This role is based in London or Stockholm.

We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice

Title: Quantitative Analyst to the IFRS 9 team | SEB, Stockholm
Description:
Are you a data-driven credit risk professional with a passion for model development?

We are looking for a Quantitative Analyst to join the Expected Credit Loss (ECL) team within Credit Risk, with a primary focus on IFRS 9 model development.

Since SEB was founded in 1856, our focus on customers and long-term relationships has been at the heart of our success. We aim to drive positive change by providing capital to help everyone reach their goals and accelerate progress towards a sustainable tomorrow. As a leading financial services group in northern Europe, we'll help you grow and empower you to take on more responsibility to create a real difference. Welcome to SEB.

About The Role

In this role, you will contribute directly to the development and refinement of the Bank’s expected credit loss models. You will combine quantitative analysis with hands-on model development and tooling.

Main responsibilities include:


Develop, enhance, and maintain IFRS 9 ECL models and methodologies
Analyse model performance and support calibration, including overlays
Build analytical tools and data solutions
Support integration of models into reporting processes


To thrive in this role, we believe you have


Experience in credit risk modelling / IFRS 9 / ECL
Strong quantitative and analytical skillset with a focus on model development
Structured, proactive, and delivery-oriented - Able to communicate complex modelling topics clearly
Experience working with data and tools such as SQL, SAS, or Python


What we offer:


A central role in the Bank’s IFRS 9 model development
Broad exposure across risk, finance, and business
A collaborative and supportive team environment
Attractive compensation and benefits


Do you want to be part of SEB?

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.

Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today via the link in this ad, but no later than 2026-08-31. If you have questions about the position, please contact Daniel Odelfalk, Head of ECL & Stress-testing, daniel.odelfalk@seb.se, but we will not process applications via email.

 

Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and criminal records checks. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Vill du vara med och bygga robusta dataflöden som möjliggör analys, maskininlärning och AI i praktiken? Nu söker vi på Länsförsäkringar AB en Data Engineer som vill utveckla skalbara och pålitliga lösningar i nära samarbete med data scientists, AI Engineers och arkitekter. Här får du en viktig roll i ett innovativt och prestigelöst team där ny teknik, samarbete och verklig verksamhetsnytta står i centrum.

OBS: Då denna rekrytering sker under semestertider kan återkoppling komma att dröja lite längre än vanligt.

Om jobbet

Som Data Engineer inom gruppen Data Science får du en central roll i att bygga och vidareutveckla den informationsförsörjning som krävs för analys, maskininlärning och AI. Rollen innebär att du arbetar med lösningar som behöver vara robusta, skalbara och långsiktigt hållbara, med fokus på att göra rätt data tillgänglig med rätt kvalitet, i rätt format och vid rätt tidpunkt. Du blir en del av ett innovativt team på 16 personer där data scientists, AI Engineers, lösningsarkitekter och Data Engineers arbetar nära varandra, delar kunskap och tillsammans driver AI-utvecklingen framåt inom Länsförsäkringar AB. Här får du möjlighet att bygga lösningar som används i praktiken och bidra till framtidens AI i en miljö präglad av samarbete, utveckling och hög teknisk ambition.

Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer vara bland annat:


designa, bygga och underhålla skalbara, robusta och pålitliga datapipelines
strukturera och modellera data så att den kan användas för analys, feature engineering och maskininlärning
säkerställa stabil informationsförsörjning till ML-modeller och AI-tillämpningar i nära samarbete med data scientists och AI Engineers
bygga integrationer och datatjänster som gör information tillgänglig på ett säkert, effektivt och återanvändbart sätt
bidra till övervakning, loggning och kvalitetssäkring för att följa upp hälsa, prestanda och tillförlitlighet i datapipelines


Följande kommer göra dig framgångsrik i denna tjänst:


högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom relevant tekniskt område, exempelvis datateknik, AI, teknisk fysik eller matematik

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
HiQ växer inom data, AI och cloud - och vi letar nu efter Data Engineers som vill bygga moderna dataplattformar, skapa smarta dataflöden och göra det möjligt för våra kunder att fatta bättre beslut och utveckla nya tjänster.

Som Data Engineer på HiQ kommer du att bygga och implementera skalbara dataplattformar i molnet, från datainhämtning och transformering till realtidsanalys och vidare till användning i analys, rapportering och AI. Du designar och optimerar datamodeller och dataflöden, inklusive streaminglösningar med till exempel Apache Kafka eller motsvarande, och du arbetar med robusta CI/CD processer samt IaC i moderna cloudmiljöer. Du blir en viktig del i hur våra kunder samlar, strukturerar och använder sin data för att skapa verkligt affärsvärde.

Utöver detta kommer du att vara med i den AI satsning som HiQ gör, med möjlighet att påverka teknikval, arkitektur och arbetssätt för hur data blir navet i våra AI lösningar.

Vi söker dig som har:


Minst 3 års erfarenhet av data engineering och molnbaserade dataplattformar
Erfarenhet av molnlösningar i Azure, AWS eller GCP
Goda kunskaper i Python och SQL för att bygga, automatisera och optimera dataflöden
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med datamodellering, prestandaoptimering och kvalitetssäkring av data
Högskole eller universitetsexamen i datateknik, datavetenskap, systemvetenskap eller annan relevant inriktning
Svenskt medborgarskap samt är flytande i svenska och engelska


Meriterande:


Erfarenhet av Databricks, Snowflake eller liknande plattformar
Erfarenhet av AI eller ML workflows, till exempel att ta modeller i produktion i en dataplattform
Förmåga att designa dataarkitektur och göra tekniska vägval i komplexa miljöer
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med ETL eller ELT verktyg och ramverk som till exempel Airflow eller dbt
Vana av att sätta upp och underhålla CI CD pipelines för data och molnprojekt
Vana av att jobba kundnära i tekniska projekt


Vi tror att du är en person som älskar att bygga stabila lösningar som gör data enkel att använda. Du trivs när du får kombinera struktur med kreativitet, du gillar att dela med dig av din expertis och du har en naturlig förmåga att driva arbetet framåt tillsammans med andra.

Varför HiQ

Sedan 1995 har HiQ varit konsultbolaget som förenklat världen för både kunder och slutanvändare med hjälp av teknik, design och kommunikation. HiQ har alltid fokuserat på två saker: att ha kul på jobbet och att leverera lösningar utöver förväntningar, det är vad som driver oss framåt. Vi HiQare är stolta över att ha en kultur som präglas av resultat, ansvar, enkelhet och glädje. Vi tror på att arbeta tillsammans för att nå våra gemensamma mål och strävar efter att hjälpa varandra att fortsätta växa och utvecklas. Hos oss får du utöver chansen att utveckla din egen kompetens också möjlighet att lära, leda och inspirera dina kollegor.  

I denna rekrytering tillämpar vi löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut. För att göra rekryteringsprocessen så rättvis och objektiv som möjligt kommer det att ingå urvalsfrågor, intervjuer, tekniska tester, referenstagning och bakgrundskontroll. Vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig och tillsammans forma framtidens dataintensiva och AI drivna lösningar. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Just nu tankar vi energi på semestern och är därför lite långsammare på bollen än vanligt. Vi är tillbaka i början av augusti och hör av oss då – tills dess hoppas vi att du njuter av en riktigt skön sommar! 🌞

Part of your time will also involve contributing to selected research projects, provide guidance on advanced analytical and AI-driven methodologies, and engage in postgraduate training on a national level.
