Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Data Engineer




Build products with data, not just pipelines.




Most Data Engineering roles focus on moving data from A to B.

This one is about deciding what to build with it.




We're partnering with one of the Nordics' most exciting technology businesses as they continue investing heavily in their data platform, AI capabilities and engineering function. They're looking for a curious Data Engineer who enjoys solving problems with technology and wants to build complete solutions rather than spend every day maintaining ETL pipelines.




If you enjoy working across data engineering, software engineering and automation, this could be exactly the kind of challenge you're looking for.




The Opportunity:

The business has already built the foundations of a modern cloud-native data platform. Now they're entering the exciting phase.




Rather than focusing on collecting data, the team is building intelligent services, internal products and AI-enabled solutions that help the business make smarter decisions every day.




You'll work in a small, collaborative engineering team where ideas move quickly, ownership is encouraged and engineers are trusted to take solutions from concept through to production.




What you'll be doing:

Your work will span far more than traditional data engineering, including:

Designing scalable data models using SQL and dbt
Building Python services and automation tools
Developing REST APIs that expose trusted data
Creating integrations where off-the-shelf tools aren't enough
Improving data quality, testing and platform reliability
Building cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code
Working closely with stakeholders to translate business problems into technical solutions
Helping shape the next generation of AI-powered products and internal tooling




The philosophy is simple:

Use technology to solve business problems.




Sometimes that's a data model.

Sometimes it's an API.

Sometimes it's a lightweight application.

Whatever delivers the greatest value.




What they're looking for:

You'll have strong experience in modern Data Engineering, including:

SQL
Python
dbt
Cloud data platforms
Modern data architecture and engineering best practices




You'll also ideally have experience building some combination of:

REST APIs
Backend services
Internal tooling
Automation solutions
Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar)
Data integrations




Experience with Google Cloud is helpful but not essential. Engineers from Azure or AWS environments are equally encouraged to apply.




More important than the exact tech stack is your mindset. They're looking for someone who enjoys learning, solving problems and building whatever is needed to create value.




Tech Stack:

Python
SQL
dbt
BigQuery
Google Cloud Platform
Docker
Terraform
Airbyte




You don't need experience with every technology. Strong engineering principles and a willingness to learn are far more important.




Why Join?

This is an opportunity to join a business at exactly the right stage.

The platform has been built.




Now the focus is on creating products that power self-service analytics, intelligent automation and AI across the organisation.




You'll work in a highly visible engineering team where your work has a genuine impact, collaborate directly with business stakeholders and have the autonomy to shape solutions rather than simply deliver tickets.




If you're the kind of engineer who enjoys ownership, variety and building things that matter, you'll thrive here.




Salary & Benefits

55,000–70,000 SEK per month
Hybrid working (Tuesday–Thursday in the Stockholm office)
Comprehensive benefits package
Permanent position




Interview Process

Hiring Manager conversation
Technical discussion and problem-solving case study (no live coding)
Final technical and cultural interview

  • Creating integrations where off-the-shelf tools aren't enough
  • Improving data quality, testing and platform reliability
  • Building cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code
  • Working closely with stakeholders to translate business problems into technical solutions
  • Helping shape the next generation of AI-powered products and internal tooling


The philosophy is simple:

Use technology to solve business problems.


Sometimes that's a data model.

Sometimes it's an API.

Sometimes it's a lightweight application.

Whatever delivers the greatest value.


What they're looking for:

You'll have strong experience in modern Data Engineering, including:

  • SQL
  • Python
  • dbt
  • Cloud data platforms
  • Modern data architecture and engineering best practices


You'll also ideally have experience building some combination of:

  • REST APIs
  • Backend services
  • Internal tooling
  • Automation solutions
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar)
  • Data integrations


Experience with Google Cloud is helpful but not essential. Engineers from Azure or AWS environments are equally encouraged to apply.


More important than the exact tech stack is your mindset. They're looking for someone who enjoys learning, solving problems and building whatever is needed to create value.


Tech Stack:

  • Python
  • SQL
  • dbt
  • BigQuery
  • Google Cloud Platform
  • Docker
  • Terraform
  • Airbyte


You don't need experience with every technology. Strong engineering principles and a willingness to learn are far more important.


Why Join?

This is an opportunity to join a business at exactly the right stage.

The platform has been built.


Now the focus is on creating products that power self-service analytics, intelligent automation and AI across the organisation.


You'll work in a highly visible engineering team where your work has a genuine impact, collaborate directly with business stakeholders and have the autonomy to shape solutions rather than simply deliver tickets.


If you're the kind of engineer who enjoys ownership, variety and building things that matter, you'll thrive here.


Salary & Benefits

  • 55,000–70,000 SEK per month
  • Hybrid working (Tuesday–Thursday in the Stockholm office)
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Permanent position


Interview Process

  • Hiring Manager conversation
  • Technical discussion and problem-solving case study (no live coding)
  • Final technical and cultural interview

Sektionen ansvarar för utveckling och förvaltning av Folksams data- och analysplattformar, masterdatasystem samt AI-lösningar. Vi tror på ett hållbart arbetsliv och jobbar aktivt med inkludering och mångfald. Våra moderna kontor bjuder in till samarbete och lärande, här får vi saker att hända! Du har flexibiliteten att kunna varva arbete på kontoret med att jobba hemifrån, utifrån verksamhetens behov.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Vill du vara med och förändra pensionsbranschen?

Är du en kreativ problemlösare med en passion för att strukturera och organisera information? Brinner du för att skapa affärsvärde utifrån data? Då är du den vi söker!




Om tjänsten🚀

Att effektivt använda data operationellt och för analys är centralt för att lyckas i SPPs kommande utveckling. I rollen som data engineer spelar du en avgörande roll i att effektivt skapa värde ur data genom att bygga vår nya dataplattform tillsammans med resten av teamet.

Förutsättningarna finns för att du ska kunna göra stor skillnad. Vi är i en förändringsfas där vi bygger nya tekniska lösningar samt förändrar kulturen kring hur data produceras och konsumeras. Du kommer vara med att sätta denna grund. Satsningen inom datadomänen samt förståelse för utmaningen är väl förankrad i SPPs ledningsgrupp.




Hos SPP Tech får du en dynamisk arbetsmiljö med fokus på innovation och utveckling. Du kommer att vara en del av ett engagerat team och ha stora möjligheter att påverka och utvecklas i din roll. Du kommer rapportera till Head of Data och vara en del av ett team på totalt tio personer.




Vem är du?👋

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi du är nyfiken på att utforska nya tekniska lösningar och att utveckla nya arbetssätt tillsammans med andra. Du behöver kunna balansera utforskande av nya lösningar med att samtidigt skapa ordning och reda. Du har ett coachande förhållningssätt där du bidrar till andras utveckling och gärna erfarenhet av att ta en tech/development lead roll. Vi tror du har:

Flera års erfarenhet av liknande roller, gärna att viss erfarenhet är inom bank- eller försäkringsbranschen.
Erfarenhet av dimensionsmodellering. Vår tech stack bygger på Snowflake, DBT, Dagster, DLT och programmering i Python.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med CI/CD och DevOps samt mycket goda kunskaper i SQL.
Erfarenhet av att designa och utveckla nya tekniska lösningar inom data samt ersätta gammal ETL-kod med ELT.
Förmågan och drivet att agera på eget initiativ och få saker att hända.
God samarbetsförmåga.
Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.




Varför välja SPP? 💚

SPP är en del av den nordiska finanskoncernen Storebrand. Tillsammans skapar vi en framtid att glädjas åt genom att vägleda till ekonomiska beslut som gynnar individen, samhället och planeten långsiktigt på ett enkelt sätt. Vi sitter i helt nyrenoverade lokaler precis intill Stockholms centralstation och erbjuder en hybrid arbetsvardag, med majoriteten av tiden på kontoret. På SPP värdesätter vi de perspektiv och erfarenheter som en jämn könsfördelning och mångfald bidrar med, och välkomnar därför sökande oavsett kön, bakgrund eller livserfarenhet.




Ansökan

Du är varmt välkommen att skicka in din ansökan senast 23 augusti. I din ansökan vill vi ha ditt CV, men i stället för ett personligt brev ber vi dig svara på några urvalsfrågor kopplat till tjänsten.

Om du har frågor om tjänsten eller rekryteringsprocessen får du gärna höra av dig till Kim Wedenberg, Head of Data, kim.wedenberg@spp.se eller Clairy Zhao, Rekryteringsansvarig, clairy.zhao@spp.se.




Kontaktuppgifter till våra lokala fackförbund

Mattias Thunström, Finansförbundet, tel 070-864 41 11

Anna Peltovuori, Akademikerföreningen, tel 070-648 17 55




Med kandidatens samtycke görs en bakgrundskontroll under anställningsprocessens slutskede som innebär kontroll av personalia, ekonomiska förhållanden och juridiska frågor. Även CV och annan ansökningsdokumentation kan komma att verifieras.

Title: Data Specialist
Description:
We are Posti, a versatile, modern, and international logistics expert with 400 years of experience. Today, we connect people and businesses by delivering information, emotions, and goods with the help of 13,000 experts across the Nordics and Baltics. We make everyday life easier for you, businesses, and society while building a more sustainable future for us all.

Är du noggrann och trivs med att arbeta i olika projekt? Har du stark samarbetsförmåga? Är du duktig på att omvandla verksamhetsbehov till flexibla tekniska tjänster? Arbetar du obehindrat i en internationell leverantörsmiljö och vet hur man framgångsrikt leder outsourcade tjänster?

Då borde du söka rollen som Data Specialist och ansluta till vårt mycket kompetenta och lösningsfokuserade team inom Business Data & Insights (BDI).

Vårt BDI-team är en central del av affärsenheten Fulfillment and Logistics Services (FLS), som verkar i Finland, Sverige och Norge. Som ett multinationellt team spelar vi en nyckelroll i att utveckla lagerverksamheten och driva digitaliseringsinitiativ. I denna roll får du möjlighet att bidra i engagerande projekt och arbeta med mycket varierande och omfattande datamängder. Vi är engagerade i din professionella utveckling genom kontinuerliga lärandemöjligheter, inklusive utbildningar, kurser och branschcertifieringar.

Din Profil


Relevant högskole- eller universitetsutbildning (ekonomi, industriell ekonomi, business intelligence)
Erfarenhet av SQL och Power BI
Viss erfarenhet av versionshantering (GitHub)
Starka kvantitativa, analytiska och problemlösande färdigheter
Förmåga att ta initiativ och vara innovativ
God kommunikativ förmåga i tal och skrift på engelska och svenska
Intresse för logistik och materialflöden


Meriterande


Kunskap om Python och Spark
Erfarenhet av Confluence och JIRA


Du kommer att ansvara för att stödja och samarbeta med operativa och affärsinriktade kollegor, samla in och tolka krav samt översätta verksamhetens behov till robusta datatjänster. Med din kompetens inom data och programmering kommer du att designa och implementera effektiva datalösningar. I rollen som data specialist kommer du att samla in data från flera källor, säkerställa datakvalitet och integritet samt förbereda data för användning i verksamheten.

Du arbetar nära kollegor med olika professionella bakgrunder, vilket gör att god samarbets- och kommunikationsförmåga är avgörande. Vi söker en öppen och nyfiken person som tar initiativ, bidrar med nya perspektiv och vidareutvecklar befintliga lösningar. Du bör trivas med att arbeta med olika teknologier och vara flexibel i en dynamisk och föränderlig miljö. Vårt team består av både data specialists och data scientists, vilket ger möjlighet att arbeta i spännande och affärskritiska projekt. Du kommer även att samarbeta nära med IT-avdelningen och externa konsulter i en integrerad och framåtblickande arbetsmiljö.

Placering

Stockholm eller Jönköping

Skicka in din ansökan (Vi ser gärna att CV/Personligt brev är på engelska ) inklusive löneanspråk, senast den 16/8 via Postis rekryteringssystem Workday.

  • Erfarenhet av SQL och Power BI

Meriterande

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Du ser mönster i det komplexa, drivs av att hitta nya lösningar och är tillräckligt nyfiken för att ifrågasätta dina egna svar. Med några års relevant erfarenhet inom teknik, data, systemutveckling, analys eller integration kan du här ta nästa steg som Data Engineer. I rollen hjälper du etablerade företag att förstå, strukturera och använda sin data för att fatta bättre beslut. Du arbetar i gränslandet mellan teknik, data, AI och affär på ett expansivt specialistbolag där du får utvecklas nära seniora kollegor, med möjlighet till delägarskap på sikt.




Om tjänsten:

Som Data Engineer hjälper du några av Sveriges mest datadrivna företag att fatta bättre beslut. Du arbetar i skärningspunkten mellan data, teknik, AI och affär, där fokus ligger på att göra information tillgänglig, tillförlitlig och användbar för verksamheten.




Vi söker dig som tidigare arbetat nära data, system eller informationsflöden och där du ställt dig frågan: "Hur kan den här datan användas på ett bättre sätt?"




Din arbetsgivare är ett specialistkonsultbolag inom Data Analytics, Data Engineering och AI. De hjälper sina kunder att bygga moderna dataplattformar, utveckla analysförmåga och skapa bättre beslutsunderlag med hjälp av data.




Bolaget är i stark tillväxt, har stabil lönsamhet och en tydlig plan framåt. De är fortfarande tillräckligt små för att varje person ska kunna påverka, men tillräckligt etablerade för att arbeta med stora och spännande kunder. Möjlighet till delägarskap finns.




Kulturen präglas av hög kompetens, nyfikenhet och kunskapsdelning. Här arbetar du nära seniora kollegor som är starka problemlösare och som gärna delar med sig av sin erfarenhet.




Arbetsuppgifter:

Du arbetar nära kunder för att förstå deras verksamhet, utmaningar och målbild. Rollen passar dig som är analytisk, kommunikativ och affärsmässig, och som drivs av att lösa komplexa problem med hjälp av modern teknik och AI-stödda arbetssätt. Uppdragen varierar i både omfattning och innehåll.




I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

Kartlägga data, system och informationsflöden
Strukturera och konsolidera data från flera källor
Designa och vidareutveckla moderna dataplattformar
Arbeta med datamodellering och datapipelines
Integrera data mellan olika system
Använda AI-stödda arbetssätt och moderna verktyg
Översätta verksamhetsbehov till tekniska lösningar




Vem vi söker:

Relevant civilingenjörsexamen, exempelvis inom datateknik, industriell ekonomi, teknisk fysik, systemvetenskap, matematik, maskinteknik, elektro eller liknande
Cirka 3–7 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet där du kommit i kontakt med data, system, integrationer, analys eller informationsflöden
Förmåga att förstå hur data kan användas som beslutsunderlag
God kommunikativ förmåga och trygghet i dialog med kunder eller andra intressenter
Nyfikenhet på AI, moderna utvecklingsverktyg och nya arbetssätt
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska




Har du byggt något på fritiden, testat AI-verktyg, automatiserat en process, skapat en app, analyserat data eller fördjupat dig i teknik av eget intresse? Då är det starkt meriterande. Som person söker vi dig med rätt grundförmågor: skärpa, nyfikenhet, konsultmässighet och förmåga att lära sig snabbt.




Moderna verktyg och AI förändrar hur tekniska lösningar byggs. Därför är det viktigare att du kan förstå problemet, välja angreppssätt, använda rätt stöd och kvalitetssäkra resultatet än att du redan har arbetat med exakt samma teknik i tidigare roller.




Du tycker om att möta kunder, förstå deras verklighet och hjälpa dem framåt. Du kan förklara komplexa saker på ett enkelt sätt och bygga förtroende i dialog med både tekniska och icke-tekniska personer.




Samtidigt gillar du problemlösning. Du är inte rädd för otydliga frågor, komplexa system eller data som inte är perfekt från början. Du tycker snarare att det är intressant att reda ut, strukturera och hitta vägen framåt.




Om anställningen:

Detta är en rekrytering där du kommer bli anställd direkt hos kundföretaget. Friday ansvarar för rekryteringsprocessen och alla frågor hänvisas till Friday.




Övrig info:

Omfattning: Heltid
Start: Enligt överenskommelse
Placering: Stockholm
Rekryteringsansvarig: Anna Persson, anna.persson@friday.se
Lön: Fast månadslön samt bonusmodeller




Ansök genom att klicka på länken nedan. Kom ihåg att vara snabb med din ansökan då vi gör löpande urval av kandidater och att annonsen kan stängs ner innan tjänsten är tillsatt om vi gått över till urvals och intervjufasen. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail.




Om Friday:

På Friday hjälper vi Tech-talanger att hitta roller där de trivs, utvecklas och gör skillnad. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av, matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet. Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering, där alla ges samma chans att lyckas. Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.

Title: Data engineer
Description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla vår centrala analys- och dataplattform? Vi etablerar Microsoft Fabric som kärnan i vår dataplattform och söker nu en data engineer som vill bidra till nästa steg i utvecklingen. Här får du möjlighet att utveckla din kompetens, arbeta med modern teknik och skapa värde genom data. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!



Om avdelningen/enheten



Vi på verksamhetsstödet utvecklar kontinuerligt arbetssätt, processer och digitala stöd för att skapa bästa möjliga förutsättningar för universitetets utbildning och forskning. Hos oss får du möjlighet att bidra till denna utveckling och samtidigt utvecklas professionellt.



Teamet



Du kommer att ingå i ett mindre team där du har stor möjlighet att ta ansvar, komma med idéer och utveckla såväl den egna som verksamhetens kompetens. I teamet ingår data engineers, objektledning, kravanalytiker samt arkitekter. Du kommer därtill ha nära samarbete med verksamheten i planerings- och leveransarbetet. 



Arbetsuppgifter



KTH etablerar Microsoft Fabric som kärnan i sin dataplattform och söker nu Data Engineers som vill vara med och utveckla plattformen vidare.



Som Data Engineer hos oss är du med i ett tidigt skede och formar KTH:s centrala analys- och dataplattform i Microsoft Fabric. Du arbetar i en miljö där forskning, utbildning och samhällsnytta står i centrum, och du får stort ansvar och frihet att påverka samt bidra till den framtida utvecklingen.



I rollen kommer du att: 

Du kommer att vara med och forma, vidareutveckla och framtidssäkra KTH:s dataplattform i Microsoft Fabric tillsammans med teamet.
Du är med och utvecklar integrationer för att hämta in data från olika källor och lär dig hur man designar stabila och skalbara lösningar.
Tillsammans i teamet arbetar ni med att utforma vår Lakehouse-struktur enligt Medallion-arkitekturen och utveckla transformationer i PySpark.
Du bygger semantiska modeller och Power BI-rapporter och lär dig koppla ihop tekniska lösningar med verksamhetsbehov.
Du versionshanterar din kod i Git och lär dig hur CI/CD-flöden fungerar i Azure DevOps. 

 



Kvalifikationer



Krav

Relevant akademisk utbildning eller på annat sätt förvärvade motsvarande kunskaper som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdiga.
Data Engineering & kod: Grundläggande erfarenhet av Python och SQL.
Grundläggande kunskap om databaser, datamodellering och ETL/ELT-processer.
Erfarenhet, från utbildning eller annat, av att fånga upp och lyssna in verksamhetens behov - och förmågan att översätta dessa till tekniska lösningar.
Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i såväl tal som skrift. 

Personliga egenskaper 



Tjänsten passar dig som är nyfiken och vill växa in i en viktig roll i en miljö där lärande är en naturlig del av vardagen. Vi söker dig som är kvalitetsmedveten och vill bidra till hållbara lösningar. Du har god samarbetsförmåga och bidrar till ett positivt arbetsklimat. Vi ser även att du är strukturerad och självgående samt har förmåga att ändra fokus och prioritera om vid behov.



Meriterande

Kännedom om Microsoft Fabric, Azure eller annan data- och molnplattform.
Erfarenhet av datavisualisering, t.ex. Power BI eller liknande.
Erfarenhet av att jobba med API:er.
Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700) och/eller Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600).
Kännedom om versionshantering med Git och ett intresse för ett strukturerat arbetssätt med verktyg som Azure DevOps eller liknande CI/CD-lösningar.

Vi kommer lägga stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.



Bli en del av KTH  



KTH formar framtiden genom utbildning, forskning och innovation. Som ett ledande internationellt tekniskt universitet spelar vi en aktiv roll i att driva och medverka i omställningen till ett hållbart samhälle. Här erbjuds du möjligheten att växa och utvecklas på en kreativ och dynamisk arbetsplats med goda arbetsvillkor och förmåner. Jämställdhet, mångfald och lika villkor är en kvalitetsfråga och en självklar del av KTH:s värdegrund som universitet och statlig myndighet.



Läs mer om våra förmåner och hur det är att arbeta och utvecklas på KTH.



Fackliga representanter



Kontaktuppgifter till fackliga representanter.



Ansökan



Du ansöker via KTH:s rekryteringssystem. Du som sökande har ansvaret för att din ansökan är komplett när den skickas in och att de kvalifikationer vi efterfrågar i annonsen framgår i ditt CV.



I denna rekrytering söker du endast med ditt CV. I stället för ett personligt brev kommer du i rekryteringssystemet att få besvara en eller flera frågor. Det är viktigt att du besvarar frågorna noggrant och sanningsenligt, för att vi ska få en tydlig bild av din kompetens och erfarenhet. Vi baserar vårt urval på kvalifikationerna som framgår av annonsen.



 Ansökan ska vara KTH tillhanda senast sista ansökningsdagen vid midnatt, CET/CEST (CentralEuropean Time/Central European Summer Time).



Om anställningen 



Anställningen gäller tillsvidare enligt avtal.



Anställningen inleds med sex månaders provanställning.



Övrigt



För information om behandling av personuppgifter i samband med rekrytering.



Det kan förekomma att en anställning hos KTH är placerad i säkerhetsklass. Om så är fallet för just denna anställning görs en säkerhetsprövning av sökande i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) efter samtycke. I dessa fall är en förutsättning för anställning att sökande blir godkänd efter säkerhetsprövning.



Tester kan komma att tillämpas i denna rekryteringsprocess.



Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av platsannonser.

Title: Analytics Engineer till UR i Stockholm
Description:
Vill du sätta din prägel på en helt ny Analytics Engineer-roll hos UR i Stockholm och skapa data som gör skillnad?

Vill du vara med från början och forma hur en modern data- och analysplattform ska fungera? Som Analytics Engineer på UR får du en nyckelroll i en omfattande satsning där hela datainfrastrukturen moderniseras. Du får möjlighet att bygga upp modelleringslagret, utveckla arbetssätt och skapa förutsättningar för datadrivna beslut i en verksamhet med ett viktigt samhällsuppdrag. Här blir du en del av ett engagerat team som arbetar nära varandra och där samarbete, nyfikenhet och kunskapsdelning står i fokus. Under din första tid får du stöd av en senior Analytics Engineer-konsult samtidigt som du successivt tar ägarskap över dbt-projektet och utvecklingen av modelleringslagret.

Vi erbjuder dig

Hos UR får du möjligheten att ta en viktig roll där du får stort inflytande över hur dataarbetet utvecklas framåt. Du blir en del av en strategisk satsning där BigQuery är det centrala datalagret och dbt Cloud transformeringsverktyget. Samtidigt blir du en del av ett kompetent och engagerat team som arbetar nära verksamheten och tillsammans driver utvecklingen framåt.


En unik möjlighet att bygga upp modelleringslagret från grunden.
En nyckelroll i moderniseringen av UR data- och analysplattform.
Ett engagerat team med nära samarbete och stort kunskapsutbyte.
Möjlighet att påverka arbetssätt, struktur och den fortsatta utvecklingen av dataplattformen.
Ett meningsfullt uppdrag där datadrivna insikter bidrar till UR verksamhet.



Det här gör du hos oss


Designar, bygger och underhåller datamodeller i dbt Cloud ovanpå BigQuery.
Implementerar KPI:er och mätetal enligt UR:s KPI-ramverk.
Säkerställer datakvalitet genom tester, dokumentation och tydliga konventioner.
Samarbetar nära dataingenjörer och analytiker kring datakällor, datakvalitet och verksamhetens behov.
Bidrar till den fortsatta utvecklingen av dataplattformen och dess arbetssätt.
Ansvarar för kvalitet, struktur och vidareutveckling av dbt-projektet.



Ditt team och arbetsplats

Du blir en del av Data & Analys-teamet på UR i Stockholm. Teamet arbetar tätt tillsammans med återkommande avstämningar och sprintplanering för att driva utvecklingen framåt. Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med dataingenjörer, analytiker och andra kollegor inom dataområdet. UR arbetar huvudsakligen från kontoret för att skapa goda förutsättningar för samarbete och snabba beslutsvägar.

Mer om dig

För att lyckas i rollen har du gedigen erfarenhet av datatransformering och modellering i dbt samt mycket goda kunskaper i SQL där du är van att skriva, optimera och underhålla komplexa frågor. Du har arbetat med molnbaserade datalager, exempelvis BigQuery, Snowflake eller Redshift, och har en relevant högskoleutbildning inom data, teknik eller statistik, alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och har goda kunskaper i engelska.

Vi tror också att du är nyfiken på ny teknik och vill utforska hur AI kan användas inom dataområdet. Eftersom rollen är ny trivs du med att vara med och bygga upp strukturer och arbetssätt, samtidigt som du uppskattar ett nära samarbete med andra. Du har ett kvalitetsmedvetet arbetssätt, en stark analytisk förmåga och motiveras av att skapa hållbara lösningar som gör data till en tillförlitlig grund för verksamhetens beslut.

Så här får vi kontakt

I den här rekryteringen har vi valt att samarbeta med Ada Digital som strävar efter en transparent, inkluderande och snabbrörlig rekryteringsupplevelse. Vi vill veta mer om dig och din potential! Du söker tjänsten enkelt och behöver inte bifoga några dokument. Det räcker med en motivering till varför du söker tjänsten och om du saknar CV kan du bifoga din LinkedIn-profil. Följ sedan din ansökan live via vår hemsida. Urvalet sker löpande och tjänsten kan bli tillsatt före sista ansökningsdatum. Är du nyfiken och vill veta mer innan du söker? Hör av dig till ansvarig rekryterare. Vi ser fram emot att få kontakt med dig!

Title: Data Scientist
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About The Job

You will join a growing AI team of 11 talented colleagues with a shared mission: transforming data and AI into measurable business value for Flatpay and our merchants.

As a Data Scientist, you will design, build, and productionize GenAI-powered products and pipelines that support business-critical decisions across the organization. A key area of focus will be customer-facing conversational AI, where creativity, strong product thinking, and a user-centered mindset are essential for developing cutting-edge solutions.

In addition, you will work on AI-driven document, image, and audio processing systems that power critical business processes and analytics. You'll collaborate closely with the broader AI team while also taking ownership of projects and driving them from ideation to production.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems with modern AI technologies and seeing their work create real-world impact. You will have the opportunity to work across the entire AI product lifecycle - from data engineering and model development to deployment and user-facing applications - while maintaining a strong focus on applied machine learning, LLMs, and generative AI.

We are looking for someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, takes ownership, and is comfortable engaging directly with stakeholders to pursue opportunities, align solutions with business needs, and continuously drive improvement.

What You'll Do


Design, build, and maintain production-grade GenAI applications and pipelines using Python, MLflow, Databricks, and leading AI platforms such as OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.
Develop AI-powered solutions including customer-facing conversational AI, LLM-driven data enrichment and analytics workflows, and audio, image, and multimodal processing systems for both internal and customer-facing products.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested production python code, including automated tests, monitoring, guardrails, validation frameworks, and fail-safe mechanisms to ensure reliability, security, and robustness in AI systems.
Build, orchestrate, and maintain data and AI workflows in Databricks, including pipelines, jobs, workflows, model serving endpoints, and custom applications deployed on the Databricks platform.
Leverage cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, and Azure to provision, deploy, and scale AI services, including LLMs.
Integrate, optimize, and manage AI workflows that leverage external platforms and services, including tools such as ElevenLabs, Metabase, and other third-party providers.
Collaborate closely with data engineers to ensure AI products are built on reliable, scalable, and well-governed data foundations.
Drive projects from proof of concept through production deployment, monitoring, and ongoing optimization


Who You Are


You have 1–3 years of industry experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, AI Engineering, or a similar technical role.
You have hands-on experience building and maintaining customer-facing GenAI applications and pipelines in production and understand the importance of automated testing, monitoring, guardrails, and reliability in production AI systems.
You have experience using LLMs from multiple state-of-the-art providers of frontier and open-source models, and you have a deep understanding of the strengths and trade-offs of different frontier and open-source models.
You have experience building applications that leverage retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, agents, or other modern LLM architectures.
You are comfortable developing solutions in Python and working with libraries such as Transformers and the SDKs of leading LLM Providers.
You are comfortable working in Databricks or similar cloud-based data and AI platforms, including building pipelines, workflows, model serving endpoints, and production deployments.
You have strong PySpark, Pandas, and SQL skills and are comfortable working with large, structured datasets.
You are comfortable taking ownership of projects, working independently, and collaborating directly with stakeholders across the business.


Why Flatpay


Impact: Ship AI and data solutions that create real impact in one of Europe’s fastest-growing companies.
Meaningful products: Build models that help merchants and colleagues make better decisions, act on insights, and improve workflows.
Learning and growth: Develop across forecasting, production ML, data engineering, and AI in a supportive team.
Flat structure: Flat structure and a strong action-over-process culture
Competitive salary
Vacation: 6 weeks paid
Relaxed atmosphere with optional social events such as minigolf evenings, hackathons, and company parties in exciting off-site locations.
Co-workers with a passion for data and AI, and a passion for sharing knowledge daily.
Pension and health insurance, as well as almost unlimited company merch.


About Flatpay

Flatpay is not just another payment solution; we're dedicated to innovating the market for payment solutions and financial services in the SME segment with our customer-centric and transparent services.

We've grown into one of the fastest-growing fintech companies out of the Nordics and Denmark's fastest unicorn company. Today, we're more than 2,000 colleagues across Europe, building products that make a real difference for our customers.

We're ambitious, move fast, and like to challenge the status quo - but we also believe work should be fun. We celebrate wins, help each other out, and create an environment where people can do great work while genuinely enjoying the journey.

Established in 2022 in Copenhagen with a commitment to transparency, we've streamlined card payments to small and medium-sized businesses. Our innovative pricing model eliminates hidden costs and fees, offering a simple flat rate for all cards with no monthly subscription for our point-of-sale and payment solutions.

Operating in Denmark, Finland, Germany, Italy, France, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands, we're more than just a service provider; we are your trusted business partner.

We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our clients' evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary?

Title: Unsolicited: Business Intelligence & Data Science
Description:
Work With BI/data Science In An International Software Company
Are you motivated by making a difference and contributing to tomorrow’s BI/data science solutions? In which case you might be our new colleague.

You will create a strong foundation for strategic decisions
In your Business Intelligence or data science role, you will be working with various solutions that support Systematic’s business areas.

This involves the development of products and solutions for our customers and other business units – all in close collaboration with highly skilled colleagues.

Some of the tasks you will be working with involve:


Identifying and understanding the needs of both the customer and the product organisation through close dialogue
Using data to create value for our customers
Developing, coding and implementing BI/data science solutions
Cleaning and analysing data, and implementing and developing machine learning models
Facilitating workshops and building data models that support domains, user behaviour and software
Being part of a dynamic working environment characterised by collaboration, development and quality.



You can expect to work with a range of technologies, such as Microsoft Power BI, Python, Azure Cloud, Microsoft SQL Server, T-SQL, Microsoft SSIS and SSAS, data warehousing, data modelling and analysis.

High level of interdisciplinary expertise and collaboration
We are committed to acquiring knowledge and developing methods based on a well-functioning group of BI/data science colleagues.

We enjoy a very high level of job satisfaction, and the dynamics between experienced experts and young talents contribute to a high level of development and progress.

We work closely together across the different disciplines and areas of expertise, with teams comprising project managers, consultants, data scientists, software architects and business developers.

A key characteristic of the teams at Systematic is that we dare to challenge and develop ourselves and each other. We focus on knowledge-sharing in our work, and always find more innovative ways of doing things.

You understand the importance of BI and data science
You are creative, good at spotting opportunities and think out of the box. You have a solid understanding of the interplay between people, technologies and processes.

You have strong communication skills combined with sound business acumen, and you enjoy being involved in a wide variety of assignments.

You stay calm when faced with numerous tasks and requirements, and you maintain an overview and understand how to prioritise the tasks at every stage of the project.

You are organised, analytical and you are driven by the quality of your work. You enjoy presenting new ideas and have what it takes to garner the support of your colleagues and business partners.

At the same time, you are a team player who enjoys the prospect of actively contributing to the team and participating in development activities.

You are fluent in English, both orally and in writing. It is an advantage if you speak Danish, but this is not a requirement.

Title: Data Scientist
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
In Hearing Care, we are enhancing how data science supports commercial and operational decision-making. As our Senior Data Scientist, you will work close to the business, shape meaningful use cases and help move machine learning from idea to scalable, production-ready solutions.

Making data science matter in business

At Demant, our purpose is to improve people’s lives through hearing health. In this role, you will contribute by helping our Hearing Care business use data and machine learning more effectively – not as an isolated technical exercise, but as a practical capability that supports better decisions and creates measurable value.

Turn business challenges into scalable machine learning solutions

You will join Commercial Excellence in a business-facing data science role. Working closely with commercial and operational stakeholders, you will learn how they work, understand their challenges and decision-making processes, and translate those needs into clear data science and machine learning cases.

You will manage the end-of-the-end data science lifecycle: exploring and preparing data, feature engineering, modelling, experimentation and evaluation. You will build, validate and continuously improve machine learning models, often in data environments that are imperfect, fragmented or still evolving.

A key part of the role is making sure solutions can live beyond the prototype. Together with MLOps, Data Engineers and Architecture, you will help move models into scalable production solutions and follow their performance over time, including model drift, retraining needs and continued business relevance.

The role gives you the opportunity to help shape how data science is used across Hearing Care. As our AI maturity develops, you will have room to shape ways of working, build closer collaboration between business and technology, and build solutions that are practical, governed and adopted in the organisation.

Bring technical depth and business curiosity

You are an experienced data scientist who enjoys getting close to business problems and finding a pragmatic path from data to value. To be effective in the role, we expect that you:



Have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematical Modelling, IT or a similar relevant field.
Bring 3+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, statistical modelling and predictive analytics.
Are comfortable across the model development lifecycle, including data exploration, feature engineering, training, validation, production handover, monitoring and retraining.
Have solid Python and SQL skills and can write clean, maintainable code aligned with good software-development practices.
Can work with imperfect or fragmented data and identify what is needed to make a use case feasible.
Communicate complex analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Are familiar with MLOps practices, CI/CD, model monitoring and production handover.
Have experience working with cloud-based data platforms; we use GCP.
Are fluent in English, as it is our company language.



Want to join us?

Please send your CV and application as soon as possible and no later than August 31th, 2026. We will conduct 1st and 2nd interviews during September. If you would like to know more about the position, you may contact, Manager, Sophia Evtimova on email at sovm@demant.com.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Description:
Drive meaningful change

At our Data, Analytics & AI department, we specialize in data visualizations, BI tools, analytical consulting, statistics, forecasting, and modern data platforms. Working closely with various departments across Abacus, we combine our analytical expertise with a deep understanding of pharmaceutical markets—from product development to delivery.

We believe that robust Data Science and AI can give Abacus Medicine a competitive edge, uncovering trends and behaviors that drive smarter decision-making. Our advanced machine learning (ML) techniques transform complex market data into actionable forecasts. Join us on our growth journey and help shape the future of the pharmaceutical industry.

Get a glimpse of our world

The Data Science team consists of five highly skilled professionals, all dedicated to improve global healthcare through better access to medicine by delivering critical data and insights that drive informed decision-making.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including data analysts, data engineers, product managers, and key business stakeholders—to develop data-driven solutions that scale.

Are you ready to embark on this journey with us?

As a Data Scientist, you will play a key role in developing and deploying machine learning models that power business insights and operational efficiencies and support tactical and strategic decision-making across Abacus Medicine.

Your Responsibilities Will Include


Design, develop, and deploy advanced models, including classical machine learning, deep learning, and algorithmic solutions, to solve complex business problems.
Analyze tabular datasets to generate actionable insights, ensuring data-driven decision-making.
Design and maintain scalable MLOps pipelines for seamless model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Promote best practices in Data Science by optimizing workflows and expanding the DS/ML toolbox with tools that enhance model accuracy, runtime, and maintainability.
Strengthen our technical infrastructure by integrating modern technologies that enhance efficiency, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
Drive innovation by evaluating and integrating emerging ML/AI methodologies, including LLMs, to enhance model performance.
Translate complex model results into actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Share expertise through knowledge sharing and sparring sessions.
Proactively identify potential data science applications for value creation.
Contribute to branch development initiatives and long-term planning, including roadmap definition.


Fuel for your success in the role

We Imagine You Have


Master’s degree in a data science-related field (e.g., computer science, cognitive science, IT, mathematics/statistics, economics).
Advanced Python programming skills.
Proficient in Data Science skills including classical machine learning for tabular data, ML frameworks (scikit-learn, deep learning frameworks), data wrangling, data analysis, and visualization.
Experienced with the following technologies: SQL, Web APIs, Git, Linux commands.
Excellent English communication skills with the ability to present complex data clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Show genuine care for both team dynamics and the success of the organization, fostering a positive and inclusive work culture.


Preferred Qualifications


Prior working experience in applying data science, with a focus on machine learning and predictive modeling.
Familiarity with the following technologies: MLOps, Spark, Cloud platform (e.g. Azure/AWS), mlflow, ETL processes, CI/CD processes.
Databricks environment for building and deploying ML models.
Leveraging LLMs for enhancing the performance of ML models through prompt engineering and embeddings.

Title: Data Scientist - FP&A
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About The Role

We’re seeking a driven Data Scientist to join our FP&A team - someone who’s eager to work directly with senior leadership and bring predictive modelling, experimentation, and applied AI into a team that already understands the business deeply. This is a high-impact role that offers real visibility and room to grow.

Now a delisted, growth-equity backed business, OrderYOYO is entering an exciting new chapter – a clear testament to our bold growth ambitions and the fast paced, high-impact environment we are building.

In this role, you’ll gain broad exposure across the business by collaborating with Management, Commercial teams, Tech, and the Data Platform team. You’ll help move the organisation from “what happened” to “what will happen” - translating business questions into statistical or ML problems, building and validating models, and delivering outputs that plug into the day-to-day work. As you grow, you’ll have the freedom to shape your path based on your strengths and interests.

Here’s a taste of what you’ll be doing:


Build, validate, and explain predictive models (classification, regression, time-series forecasting, cohort and churn analysis) that connect directly to a business process.
Apply NLP and LLMs to accelerate analytical workflows and unlock new capabilities - prompting, fine-tuning, and deploying language models where they sharpen the answer to a commercial question.
Deliver model outputs in a consumable format, building and enhancing Power BI reports on our Microsoft Fabric data platform for management and internal stakeholders.
Design and analyse commercial experiments (A/B tests, hypothesis-driven investigations, causal inference) to test what works before scaling.
Assist with scenario analysis to help inform strategic decisions made at the leadership level.


What We Are Looking For In You


1+ years of experience with data science, advanced analytics, or an analytics engineering role - ideally in a SaaS, marketplace, or subscription business.
Strong Python skills (pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost). Able to build, validate, and interpret classification and regression models.
Applied NLP and LLM experience. Comfortable prompting, training, and deploying language models to solve real problems.
Experience building predictive models that were actually used in production or by business stakeholders - not just academic exercises.
Structured problem-solving. Can take an open question and decompose it into a testable hypothesis or a well-scoped modelling problem.


Why Join Us?


Direct exposure to decision-making at the highest level and learn how business challenges are tackled at the top level.
Work in a supportive, team-first culture where we help each other succeed.
Expect personal development plans and ongoing training tailored to your growth.
A dynamic, supportive environment where critical thinking is encouraged and your voice matters.
Be part of a high-growth journey in a growth equity-backed company, where ambition meets opportunity - and your impact truly matters.


Great To Have (But Not Required)


Deeper ML & AI intuition - e.g. cross-validation strategy, the bias-variance tradeoff, regularization, gradient-based optimization, model calibration, SHAP-based explainability, and RAG vs. fine-tuning for LLM work.
Exposure to Power BI, DAX, and/or Power Query.
Experience or interest in working on cross-functional projects involving Tech/Product, Operations, Sales and Marketing.
Working knowledge of SQL and comfort pulling data directly from a data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar).


What We Do At OrderYOYO

OrderYOYO is a provider of white-label online ordering, payment, marketing, and POS software solutions to independent local takeaway restaurants. We are ensuring that small to medium-sized restaurants and chains are not subjected to lofty commissions and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success.

Who We Are At OrderYOYO

Company culture is at the forefront of our minds creating an enjoyable, safe working environment where employee personal expression is supported. We are one team here at OrderYOYO and strive to help others succeed. Personal development and training plans are a key part of your journey within OrderYOYO, helping you be the best you can be by providing consistent and ongoing training for all aspects of the business. Our values (Passion, Action, Compassion, One team) are what makes us who we are and will be embedded in your day-to-day no matter what area of the business you work in.

Please note interviews for this role will be conducted in September

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Place: Billund Municipality, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

Just imagine turning manufacturing and engineering data into actionable insights that elevate every LEGO® brick’s quality. Then make it real!

This Senior Data Scientist role sits within Data & Automation under Advanced Engineering at our Billund site. You’ll be building predictive data systems, drive quality assurance, enable process improvements and much more to stabilize production workflows across element and mould manufacturing.




Play your part in our team succeeding

We have unified many of the strong digital capabilities existing in Elements & Additive Engineering (E&AE), by combining Computer Aided Engineering (CAE), Data Science, and Software Automation capabilities into one unit - Advanced Engineering. It is our goal to elevate these capabilities and reinforce their importance and impact in the operational value chain.

Our ambition is to deploy these capabilities in E&AE and beyond, while creating a strong center of excellence in Data & Automation (D&A) within Advanced Engineering to secure critical digital capabilities for the future.

D&A is a young team that creates data insights for data-driven decision making on all organizational levels. We improve product quality and strengthen processes through data analysis. Also, we reduce tedious process steps to enable value-adding engineering productivity initiatives through low code / no code automation platforms for Engineering & Algorithmic modelling software.

In short - it is where digital simulations meet data science and process automation.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will be essential for the D&A team to reach our goals, enable us to make the right prioritizations, leading the digital change and being a strong role model – not only for the team but also for our stakeholders and collaborators.

Core Responsibilities

Predictive Modeling: Drive the development of models to predict process quality, potential defects, and forecast maintenance schedules using techniques like statistical analysis, machine learning and AI models.
Quality Assurance: Drive the implementation of quality control algorithms and anomaly detection methods to monitor the operations processes and identify deviations or defects.
Process Optimization: Collaborate with engineers and value chain teams to optimize operations processes based on data-driven insights, aiming to understand and improve process stability and element and mould quality, as well as enabling faster technology development cycles.
Communication and Visualization: Ensure effective communication of findings and insights through data visualization and reports to cross-functional teams, stakeholders and external partners to develop operations solutions
Data Cleaning and Preprocessing: Responsible for the preparation of collected data by cleaning, organizing, and transforming it into a suitable format for visualization and analysis. Assess large data quantities and ensure the dimensional reduction of these data is handled in a way that minimizes the consequences of this reduction.
Root Cause Analysis: Engage in investigating and identifying the root causes of process issues or failures by analyzing historical data, helping in continuous improvement efforts.
Capabilities Building: Support in building capabilities within the LEGO Group to develop and enhance data science skills, knowledge and expertise to expand our Advanced Engineering roadmap and meet organizational goals.
Data Collection: Support in setting up data extractions methods to gather data from various existing sources. Also, identify data weaknesses and recommend where to secure sensor data, machine logs, and quality control measurements.




Do you have what it takes?

Background in statistical modelling and data analysis spanning two or more years
Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze, understand and illustrate data
Experience in programming such as Python, R, etc. as well as experience with data visualization platforms such as Power BI,
Experience in working with cloud services, such as Microsoft Azure, and data engineering platforms such as Databricks
Strong ability to navigate complex data from various sources as well as experience with ETL (Extract, Transform, Load)
A team player that strives to succeed in an ever-changing and challenging environment
Organized and structured, independent, self-driven and proactive attitude
Excellent communication and organizational skills
Experience with GitHub
Ability to construct Machine Learning models
Advanced English




Nice to Have:

Experience with Big Data, Manufacturing Data
Knowledge of Additive Manufacturing and Injection Moulding technologies
Flare for innovation, development, and out of the box thinking




No relocation assistance is offered for this position

Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

Job Description

Just imagine turning manufacturing and engineering data into actionable insights that elevate every LEGO® brick’s quality. Then make it real!

This Senior Data Scientist role sits within Data & Automation under Advanced Engineering at our Billund site. You’ll be building predictive data systems, drive quality assurance, enable process improvements and much more to stabilize production workflows across element and mould manufacturing.


Play your part in our team succeeding

We have unified many of the strong digital capabilities existing in Elements & Additive Engineering (E&AE), by combining Computer Aided Engineering (CAE), Data Science, and Software Automation capabilities into one unit - Advanced Engineering. It is our goal to elevate these capabilities and reinforce their importance and impact in the operational value chain.

Our ambition is to deploy these capabilities in E&AE and beyond, while creating a strong center of excellence in Data & Automation (D&A) within Advanced Engineering to secure critical digital capabilities for the future.

D&A is a young team that creates data insights for data-driven decision making on all organizational levels. We improve product quality and strengthen processes through data analysis. Also, we reduce tedious process steps to enable value-adding engineering productivity initiatives through low code / no code automation platforms for Engineering & Algorithmic modelling software.

In short - it is where digital simulations meet data science and process automation.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will be essential for the D&A team to reach our goals, enable us to make the right prioritizations, leading the digital change and being a strong role model – not only for the team but also for our stakeholders and collaborators.

Core Responsibilities

  • Predictive Modeling: Drive the development of models to predict process quality, potential defects, and forecast maintenance schedules using techniques like statistical analysis, machine learning and AI models.
  • Quality Assurance: Drive the implementation of quality control algorithms and anomaly detection methods to monitor the operations processes and identify deviations or defects.
  • Process Optimization: Collaborate with engineers and value chain teams to optimize operations processes based on data-driven insights, aiming to understand and improve process stability and element and mould quality, as well as enabling faster technology development cycles.
  • Communication and Visualization: Ensure effective communication of findings and insights through data visualization and reports to cross-functional teams, stakeholders and external partners to develop operations solutions
  • Data Cleaning and Preprocessing: Responsible for the preparation of collected data by cleaning, organizing, and transforming it into a suitable format for visualization and analysis. Assess large data quantities and ensure the dimensional reduction of these data is handled in a way that minimizes the consequences of this reduction.
  • Root Cause Analysis: Engage in investigating and identifying the root causes of process issues or failures by analyzing historical data, helping in continuous improvement efforts.
  • Capabilities Building: Support in building capabilities within the LEGO Group to develop and enhance data science skills, knowledge and expertise to expand our Advanced Engineering roadmap and meet organizational goals.
  • Data Collection: Support in setting up data extractions methods to gather data from various existing sources. Also, identify data weaknesses and recommend where to secure sensor data, machine logs, and quality control measurements.


Do you have what it takes?

  • Background in statistical modelling and data analysis spanning two or more years
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze, understand and illustrate data
  • Experience in programming such as Python, R, etc. as well as experience with data visualization platforms such as Power BI,
  • Experience in working with cloud services, such as Microsoft Azure, and data engineering platforms such as Databricks
  • Strong ability to navigate complex data from various sources as well as experience with ETL (Extract, Transform, Load)
  • A team player that strives to succeed in an ever-changing and challenging environment
  • Organized and structured, independent, self-driven and proactive attitude
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills
  • Experience with GitHub
  • Ability to construct Machine Learning models
  • Advanced English


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Big Data, Manufacturing Data
  • Knowledge of Additive Manufacturing and Injection Moulding technologies
  • Flare for innovation, development, and out of the box thinking


No relocation assistance is offered for this position

Here is what you can expect:

Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

Insurances – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

Wellbeing - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

Colleague Discount – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.

Bonus - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.

Our hybrid work policy means an average of 3 days per week in the office. The hiring team will discuss the policy and role eligibility with you during the recruitment process.

Title: Join Halfspace’s AI & Advanced Analytics Team - Shaping the Future with AI
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Who We Are

At Halfspace, Part of Accenture - Center for Advanced AI - we believe that the smallest edge can make the biggest difference. We began in sports, predicting outcomes in live football matches, and today we bring that same precision and ambition into the world of business. We're here to unlock value through artificial intelligence and help organisations make better, more informed decisions, faster.

With more than one hundred AI and data projects delivered, our work has transformed industries and earned international recognition. But awards and numbers tell only part of the story. What truly defines us is our people. Our team comes from leading institutions such as KU, DTU, Stanford, Oxford, Harvard, Caltech, Yale, Colombia and many more, blending expertise in physics, engineering, mathematics, statistics, operations research, computer science, chemistry, economics, biology, design and strategy. Together, we share curiosity, boldness, and a pioneering spirit.

Halfspace is a specialized spearheading unit within Accenture, focused on bringing the deepest expertise in applied AI. We are 'Inch Wide - Mile Deep' in our capabilities.

What You'll Be Doing

As part of the AI & Advanced Analytics team at Halfspace, you’ll be working at the cutting edge of artificial intelligence — designing, building, and deploying systems that push what’s possible. You’ll contribute to the development of intelligent agents, generative AI models, and advanced analytical frameworks that deliver real-world impact across industries.

You’ll work alongside engineers, scientists, and strategists from some of the world’s leading institutions, applying deep technical expertise and creative thinking to solve complex problems. From prototyping novel AI applications to operationalizing models at scale, you’ll bridge research and engineering to turn ideas into solutions that redefine performance.

Every experiment, model, and insight you create will help organizations make better decisions, faster — embodying our mission to deliver the smallest edge that makes the biggest difference.

Who We're Looking For

We’re looking for curious and technically exceptional individuals who live at the intersection of AI, mathematics, and software. You combine a strong foundation in statistical modeling and machine learning with the creativity and rigor to turn theory into working systems.

You’re fluent in Python and comfortable working with modern AI stacks — whether that means fine-tuning large language models, architecting agentic systems, or building robust analytical pipelines.

For our Generative AI unit we value:



Strong proficiency in Python and core AI libraries

Experience working with integrating Generative AI and developing AI Agents or other applications

Intellectual curiosity, precision, and a pioneering mindset — the qualities that define Halfspace



For our Advanced Analytics unit we value:



Strong proficiency in Python and core ML libraries

Solid understanding of statistical modeling, optimization, and experimental design

Familiarity with MLOps and model deployment practices

Intellectual curiosity, precision, and a pioneering mindset — the qualities that define Halfspace



If you have less than two years of professional experience, please include your academic transcripts with your application.

Life at Halfspace, part of Accenture

We think and act like a professional sports team. We value flexibility, trust, and balance. We invest in learning and development to keep our team ahead of the curve on everything AI. And we create an environment where ambitious people can grow while working on projects that matter, side by side with some of the world’s leading companies and greatest minds.

About Halfspace, Part Of Accenture

Halfspace was established in 2015. We're on a mission to bring the power of artificial intelligence to industry and deliver exceptional quality and value, whenever we engage, while creating a space which attracts the brightest, most curious and most talented people. As of March 2025 Halfspace became a part of Accenture to help build and grow the Accenture Center for Advanced AI across the Nordics and EMEA.

Title: Data Scientist
Place: Ballerup Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Location - Ballerup

Your new department

The Data Scientist in the Commercial AI & Data department is responsible for designing, developing, and implementing advanced AI and machine learning algorithms to process and analyse structured and unstructured data from diverse sources. You will be part of a business area that drives impact across the full Novo Nordisk value chain. We strive to stay close to our stakeholders in the business to ensure we deliver on their needs, helping reach millions of people living with serious chronic diseases. Our focus is on being at the forefront within our three areas; ensuring the highest quality for patients, being a trusted tech leader and an environmentally responsible business.

Your Key Responsibilities Include


Define Data Science Strategy
Develop and influence the organization's data science vision and roadmap.
Collaborate with senior leaders and executives to align AI/ML initiatives with business priorities.
Help determine where data science can create the greatest strategic value.
Lead Innovation and Advanced Analytics
Design and champion innovative AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics solutions.
Solve highly complex business problems through advanced statistical and computational methods.
Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies and methodologies.
Serve as a Technical Authority
Act as the organization’s subject matter expert for data science.
Establish best practices, standards, and frameworks for model development and deployment.
Provide expert guidance on methodologies, tools, and architectural decisions.
Shape Business Decisions
Translate business opportunities and challenges into data-driven strategies.
Communicate insights, risks, and recommendations to executive leadership.
Influence investment decisions and enterprise-wide initiatives using evidence-based approaches.
Mentor and Develop Talent
Coach senior data scientists and technical leaders.
Build organizational capability through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and establishing communities of practice.
Help develop future leaders in data science.
Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work across business functions, technology, engineering, analytics, product, compliance, and external partners.
Lead large-scale initiatives that span multiple teams and organizational boundaries.
Represent the IT Organization across the Stakeholders’ communities
Bring stakeholders together on the DS strategy and vision
Build external networks and stay at the forefront of AI and data science advancements.
Position the Enterprise AI org. as a leader in data-driven innovation.


Your New Department

The Data Scientist in the Commercial AI & Data department is responsible for designing, developing, and implementing advanced AI and machine learning algorithms to process and analyse structured and unstructured data from diverse sources. You will be entrusted with making independent decisions on the selection of suitable methodologies, and techniques for data analysis and model development.

Skills & Qualifications.


Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field. Ph.D. is preferred. 2+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or AI, with a focus on developing and applying advanced algorithms.
In-depth knowledge of machine learning concepts, data modeling techniques and AI solution design.
Familiarity with scalable data pipelines and quality-assured coding practices is a plus.
Experience working with cross-functional teams (data engineering, ML engineering, analytics, product, operations).
Proven experience delivering data, analytics & AI solutions
Practical hands‑on experience with ML modelling and prototyping using Python and frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow; comfortable with experiment design and evaluation.
Familiarity with MLOps tools and practices (e.g., MLflow, model registries, CI/CD for models) and cloud‑agnostic deployment patterns.
In‑depth understanding and practical experience with architecture, implementation, DevOps and support for AI solutions.
Experience working with cross‑functional teams (data engineering, ML engineering, analytics, product, operations) and external vendors.
Experience in pharmaceutical or regulated industries is beneficial but not mandatory.


Working at Novo Nordisk

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

What We Offer

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

Salary

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,200.00 to 838,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About The Job

You will join a growing AI team of 11 talented colleagues with a shared mission: transforming data and AI into measurable business value for Flatpay and our merchants.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will design, build, and productionize GenAI-powered products and pipelines that support business-critical decisions across the organization. A key area of focus will be customer-facing conversational AI, where creativity, strong product thinking, and a user-centred mindset are essential for developing cutting-edge solutions.

In addition, you will work on AI-driven document, image, and audio processing systems that power critical business processes and analytics. You will collaborate closely with the broader AI team while taking strong ownership of complex projects and driving them from ideation to scalable production systems.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex, ambiguous problems with modern AI technologies and who has the technical judgment to turn ideas into robust, maintainable, and high-impact products. You will work across the entire AI product lifecycle — from data engineering and model development to deployment and user-facing applications — while helping set a high standard for applied machine learning, LLMs, and generative AI at Flatpay.

We are looking for someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, takes end-to-end ownership, and is comfortable engaging directly with stakeholders to identify opportunities, shape solutions, align technical direction with business needs, and continuously drive improvement. As a senior member of the team, you will also be expected to contribute to technical direction, raise the quality bar, and support the growth of those around you.

What You'll Do


Design, build, and maintain production-grade GenAI applications and pipelines using Python, MLflow, Databricks, and leading AI platforms such as OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.
Develop AI-powered solutions including customer-facing conversational AI, LLM-driven data enrichment and analytics workflows, and audio, image, and multimodal processing systems for both internal and customer-facing products.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested production Python code, including automated tests, monitoring, guardrails, validation frameworks, and fail-safe mechanisms to ensure reliability, security, and robustness in AI systems.
Build, orchestrate, and maintain data and AI workflows in Databricks, including pipelines, jobs, workflows, model serving endpoints, and custom applications deployed on the Databricks platform.
Leverage cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, and Azure to provision, deploy, and scale AI services, including LLMs.
Integrate, optimize, and manage AI workflows that leverage external platforms and services, including tools such as ElevenLabs, Metabase, and other third-party providers.
Collaborate closely with data engineers to ensure AI products are built on reliable, scalable, and well-governed data foundations.
Drive complex projects from proof of concept through production deployment, monitoring, ongoing optimization, and business adoption.
Make technical design decisions, evaluate trade-offs, and help define best practices for building reliable, secure, and scalable AI systems.
Mentor and support other team members through code reviews, technical sparring, and sharing practical knowledge across AI engineering, machine learning, and production GenAI systems.


Who You Are


You have 5+ years of industry experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, AI Engineering, or a similar technical role, with a strong track record of delivering production AI or ML systems.
You have hands-on experience building and maintaining customer-facing GenAI applications and pipelines in production and understand the importance of automated testing, monitoring, guardrails, and reliability in production AI systems.
You have experience using LLMs from multiple state-of-the-art providers of frontier and open-source models, and you have a deep understanding of the strengths and trade-offs of different frontier and open-source models.
You have strong experience building applications that leverage retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, agents, or other modern LLM architectures.
You are highly comfortable developing production solutions in Python and working with libraries such as Transformers and the SDKs of leading LLM providers, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others.
You are comfortable working in Databricks or similar cloud-based data and AI platforms, including building pipelines, workflows, model serving endpoints, and production deployments.
You have strong PySpark, Pandas, and SQL skills and are comfortable working with large, structured datasets.
You are pragmatic and able to turn ambiguous business problems into concrete technical solutions, while helping stakeholders understand trade-offs and opportunities.
You are comfortable taking ownership of high-impact projects, working independently, and collaborating directly with stakeholders across the business.
You contribute positively to team standards, technical direction, and knowledge sharing, and you enjoy helping others become better at building high-quality AI systems.


Why Flatpay


Impact: Ship AI and data solutions that create real impact in one of Europe’s fastest-growing companies.
Meaningful products: Build models that help merchants and colleagues make better decisions, act on insights, and improve workflows.
Learning and growth: Develop across forecasting, production ML, data engineering, and AI in a supportive team.
Flat structure: Flat structure and a strong action-over-process culture
Competitive salary
Vacation: 6 weeks paid
Relaxed atmosphere with optional social events such as minigolf evenings, hackathons, and company parties in exciting off-site locations.
Co-workers with a passion for data and AI, and a passion for sharing knowledge daily.
Pension and health insurance, as well as almost unlimited company merch.


About Flatpay

Flatpay is not just another payment solution; we're dedicated to innovating the market for payment solutions and financial services in the SME segment with our customer-centric and transparent services.

We've grown into one of the fastest-growing fintech companies out of the Nordics and Denmark's fastest unicorn company. Today, we're more than 2,000 colleagues across Europe, building products that make a real difference for our customers.

We're ambitious, move fast, and like to challenge the status quo - but we also believe work should be fun. We celebrate wins, help each other out, and create an environment where people can do great work while genuinely enjoying the journey.

Established in 2022 in Copenhagen with a commitment to transparency, we've streamlined card payments to small and medium-sized businesses. Our innovative pricing model eliminates hidden costs and fees, offering a simple flat rate for all cards with no monthly subscription for our point-of-sale and payment solutions.

Operating in Denmark, Finland, Germany, Italy, France, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands, we're more than just a service provider; we are your trusted business partner.

We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our clients' evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary?
