We’re a leading online reviews platform, free and open to all. Our mission is to be a universal symbol of trust. We are well on our way - but there’s still an exciting journey ahead of us. Do you want to join us?

A core value proposition of Trustpilot is Trust. We work hard to ensure that our platform has real content from real people with real experiences. That means eliminating fraudulent reviews and sanctioning suspect behavior to keep our platform authentic. Our Trust Technology team aims to be an established name in the use of advanced technology to safeguard the integrity of online reviews. The Trust teams are composed of both Engineering and Data Science functions, where both are integral to achieving our goals.

We are looking for a skilled Data Science Manager to join the Trust team in our mission. You will lead two teams of passionate and dedicated professionals, including Data Scientists who research Trust-specific problems and design ML solutions for them, and Engineers who build and maintain scalable infrastructure to turn detections into outcomes. You and your team will work within a focus area to develop, deploy, and maintain innovative technology at scale, alongside a cross-functional team of product managers, ML engineers, and designers. You will have the opportunity to collaborate widely across the business including with those in our Legal, Platform Engineering, and Data Science teams within Consumer, B2B, and Commercial.

To thrive in this role, you bring a background in building and scaling complex systems with machine learning at their core. You are a seasoned Data Scientist who enjoys remaining hands-on across the end-to-end lifecycle—from initial concept to production delivery. Bridging data science and engineering comes naturally to you, supported by an adaptable, curious mindset. While not required, prior exposure to fraud detection or online platform integrity is a great plus.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Team Leadership & Execution: Lead and empower two cross-functional teams of Data Scientists and Engineers dedicated to automated content moderation and fake review detection. Foster technical excellence, support career progression, and champion a transparent, accountable, and safe work environment.

Title: Energy forecast consultant
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Would you like to have a direct influence on the forecasting accuracy of 15% of the whole world’s installed renewable power and contribute to the green energy transition? Would you like to learn about electricity markets, renewable energies, power forecasting and energy trading? Do you want to work in a company where you can have a direct impact on its growth and with a flat structure where your voice is heard? Would you like to join a team among the best in their field utilizing machine learning for creating solutions for the energy markets? If the answer is yes, read below!




ENFOR A/S is a world leading provider of forecasting and optimization solutions for the evolving energy industry. Our solutions utilize advanced machine learning and applied statistics to address weather-driven energy transition issues. We serve energy companies on six continents in more than 35 countries. Our services include forecasting of renewable energy production (from wind, solar and hydro), which is used by energy traders, big international energy companies and system operators all over the world. In addition, we also offer electricity consumption and price forecasts. As we are currently experiencing an increase in demand for our services, we are looking to hire Energy forecast Consultants to help design, implement and support power forecasting solutions for our clients. ENFOR A/S provides a stable, growing environment that values and invests in its employees to become world-leading experts in renewable energy and energy demand forecasting and how it relates to emerging and established energy markets.




Areas of responsibility

Serve as subject matter expert for new and existing customers to analyze and clarify needs and requirements, as well as performing data analysis of the customer’s data.
Design and configure forecasting and optimization software solutions for customers – sometimes leading projects and sometimes supporting peers.
Provide customer support for operational forecasting systems – ensuring that the systems operate effectively and with precision.
Identify, develop and implement tools to improve the efficiency of our systems and processes. You will also have the opportunity to contribute to the implementation of AI tools and help.
shape how the team applies them in daily work.
Work closely with Sales, IT and Development teams by providing technical expertise and feedback as well as introducing new software features to client installations.




The ideal candidate

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, energy, physics, meteorology, data science, IT, mathematics/statistics or similar field.
Experienced in computer programming and knowledge about languages such as Python, R and Bash, as well as git for version control.
Good organization or project management skills. Demonstrated ability to manage working on multiple projects at the same time without losing track of important details.
Good written and spoken communication skills. Ability to communicate technical ideas effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Takes initiative, drives and seeks continuous improvements both on the personal level as well as for the company.
Strives at delivering high quality, and at the same time understands the importance of delivering results, finalize projects and find pragmatic solutions to complex problems.
Has a flexible attitude, understanding various cultures and that the customers do not always know what they want and how to achieve what they need.
Fluency in English. Additional languages are a plus.




We offer

An interesting client-facing job, where you will become part of a company with highly advanced and market leading solutions which support the green transition.
A comprehensive and well-developed training program which include sessions with subject experts.
An environment whereby you can develop your communication, programming and project management skills.
As a smaller company, you will have the opportunity to shape your own role and future within the company and make an impact on the development of the company and its solutions.
Social and professional company-wide events, held in person at the Copenhagen office.
Good opportunities for personal and professional development in an international environment.
Becoming part of a highly skilled team, which are among the best in the world within its field.
Interested candidates are asked to send a CV and a short cover letter.




For questions please contact:

Helena Charlotte Hansen, Head of Customer Forecasting Solutions, heh@enfor.dk

Title: Data Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Spirii develops world-class charging products and digital solutions for electric vehicles. Our Digital Development department fosters a listen, learn, and lead culture — allowing us to continuously improve how we work. We're looking for a hands-on Data Engineer to build and evolve Spirii's data platform and pipeline infrastructure. Working closely with our Data Lead and domain teams, you'll design and maintain reliable ELT pipelines, ensure data arrives in Amazon Redshift correctly and on time, and support the analytics layer that powers insights across EV charging events, subscriptions, and financial transactions. This is a unique opportunity to shape Spirii's data infrastructure from an early stage — establishing standards for ingestion, orchestration, and data reliability as we scale.

Your Responsibilities

Pipeline & Ingestion


Design, build, and maintain scalable ELT pipelines that bring data from product backends, third-party services, and operational systems into Amazon Redshift.
Own ingestion reliability: monitoring, alerting, and incident response for pipeline failures.
Evaluate and improve orchestration tooling and scheduling.


Data Platform & Infrastructure


Evolve Spirii's data platform architecture: storage, compute, access control, and cost optimisation in Redshift.
Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code practices for data workflows (Terraform/CDK or similar).
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data infrastructure and transformations.


Data Quality & Governance


Implement data quality checks, freshness monitoring, and anomaly detection across ingestion and transformation layers.
Work with Analytics Engineers and domain teams to define and enforce data contracts and schema standards.
Ensure GDPR-compliant data handling: PII identification, access control, and data retention policies.


Collaboration & Stakeholders


Partner with Engineering and Product teams to instrument events correctly at the source — schemas, identifiers, and change management.
Collaborate with Data team to ensure the analytics layer is built on reliable, well-modelled foundations.
Contribute to a strong data culture by creating and enhancing documentation, runbooks, data lineage, discoverability and incident response capabilities.


About You


You care deeply about data reliability and building pipelines that teams can depend on.
You're hands-on: you build, test, and ship pipelines and infrastructure improvements yourself.
You think of data pipelines as products — you care about uptime, observability, and the downstream consumers who depend on them.
You're pragmatic: you know when to engineer robustly and when to keep things lean.
You collaborate well across teams and communicate clearly about trade-offs and status.


Qualifications


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related role with a strong data focus.
Strong SQL skills and solid experience building production data pipelines.
Hands-on experience with a modern data warehouse (Redshift preferred; BigQuery/Snowflake/Databricks also relevant).
Experience with orchestration tools (Apache Airflow or similar).
Proficiency in Python for data work (pipeline scripts, transformations, tooling).
Solid understanding of ELT/ETL concepts, including incremental loading, CDC, and idempotency.
Familiar with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or similar).
Familiar with data governance concepts: access control, PII handling, GDPR-minded practices.


Nice to Have


Experience with data observability tooling.
Experience with event/data contract patterns in product analytics (schemas, versioning, instrumentation).
Experience with finance data and/or subscription/transaction domains.
Experience with dbt (understanding of transformation layer and how it interfaces with pipelines).
Machine learning infrastructure experience is a plus, but not required for this role.


Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work-life balance.


Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.
Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days (5 weeks + 5 extra) and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.
Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.
Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.
Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.
Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.
Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.


The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but fluent English language skills are required.

About Spirii – Who We Are

Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii has recently celebrated its six-year anniversary as a founded company; however the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as the development of future transport and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

Title: Control and Simulation Specialist
Place: Aarhus Municipality, Central Denmark Region, Denmark
Description:
Vestas Wind Systems A/S > Research & Development (R&D) > Plant Innovation

In the Plant Innovation department, innovative ideas within wind power plants are transformed into concepts that form the foundation for Vestas to maintain its leadership in innovation. We promote a working environment with a high degree of freedom to explore new concepts and a willingness to take on high technical risks, as failures are one of the sources of major innovations.

We are a team of diverse people with different technical competencies, educational backgrounds, and personal traits - we are very collaborative and encourage taking initiative.

You will get the opportunity to be involved in a vast number of different programming tasks and development of applications for simulations, data processing, analysis, and wind turbine, wind power plant and energy solution optimization.

Responsibilities


Propose and conduct innovative ideas within wind farm control, and wind power simulation
Develop and perform feasibility studies and technical assessments of new technologies supporting control and performance improvements in wind and hybrid power plants
Develop and apply AI/ML solutions, including use of AI agents, to support analysis, optimization, and decision support use cases
Design, build, and test prototypes and proof-of-concept solutions through direct programming, simulation, and experimental development
Execute and coordinate activities within a specific project, including documentation


Qualifications


Master's degree (or PhD) in Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Energy Systems, Control Engineering, or a related technical field
Solid experience with wind farm/hybrid plant control, wind power simulation, or power plant modeling
Solid hands on experience in applied AI/ML development, AI based approaches for analysis, optimization, orchestration, or decision support applications
Demonstrated 5+ years of experience working with large-scale operational or industrial datasets, such as time series or SCADA-style data, including data preprocessing, feature engineering, and performance evaluation
Advanced programming skills in Python and MATLAB, C/C++, including use of ML frameworks, data pipelines, and simulation environments


Competencies


Motivated and creative approach to bring new ideas to feasibility assessment and business case justification, including risks, and scalability potential
Experience with new technology development and comfortable operating in an innovation environment with technical uncertainty and risk
An effective collaborator who shares knowledge and supports the team
Self-motivated, results-focused, and accountable
Clear and concise communicator of technical results to both specialist and non specialist stakeholders
Fluent English communication skills, both spoken and written


What We Offer

We offer an opportunity to be part of a collaborative team supporting Vestas' mission for sustainability. You will be part of an innovative organization and can contribute to future directions with your innovative ideas supporting highly skilled, creative, and international team working in an agile environment. We offer an attractive compensation package based on your qualifications, quality professional and personal development opportunities at a global manufacturer of wind turbines.

BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD

It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, www.vestas.com/en/careers/job-openings.

DEIB Statement

At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.

About Vestas

Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore. Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 173 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field. With 29,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future. Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity. To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Hos Knowit skaber vi digitale kundeoplevelser og løsninger for nogle af landets mest ambitiøse virksomheder. Data og AI spiller en stadig større rolle i den udvikling, og vi arbejder tæt sammen med både Google og Microsoft. Derfor leder vi nu efter en Data Engineer, der kan tage teknisk ejerskab for big data-delen på et af vores største kundeprogrammer.

Din rolle som Data Engineer

Du bliver en del af et fast, tværfagligt team i Aarhus, hvor udviklere, specialister og rådgivere arbejder sammen om den samme løsning. Her er du med til at bygge og drifte det dataøkosystem, som både forretning, redaktører og digitale services læner sig op ad hos en af vores store globale kunder.

I dit daglige opgave vil du have bidrage til og ofte have ansvaret for:


At eje og udvide rygraden i vores dataflow, bygget med data fra webanalyse, søgeperformance, indholdssystemer og andre eksterne signaler ind i data warehouse.
Bygge og vedligeholde afledte dataprodukter, for eksempel content scoring og user segmentation, som andre services og redaktører bruger til rangering og prioritering
Føde downstream marketing- og CRM-platforme ved at batche brugeraktivitet og samtykkedata ind i Salesforce Data Cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud og en marketing automation-platform
Modellere data til både analytisk og operationel brug, med et vedvarende blik for datakvalitet og sporbarhed
Tage ejerskab for det, vi sender i produktion, og holde øje med det, når det kører



Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du kan genkende dig selv i flere af punkterne nedenfor, også selvom ikke alle passer på din profil.


Har stor erfaring med SQL, og solid praktisk erfaring med BigQuery på Google Cloud, herunder datasæt, views, routines og query-performance.
Har et solidt data engineering-fundament på Google Cloud, altså erfaring med at bygge og drifte pipelines i produktion.
Er en øvet softwareudvikler, for eksempel i Python, så du kan bevæge dig mellem værktøjer i stedet for at være låst til én teknologi.
Bruger AI-kodeassistenter og agentiske arbejdsgange som en naturlig del af din hverdag, og tager nye AI-værktøjer i brug, efterhånden som de kommer.
Kan rådgive kunder om dataarkitektur og big data-opsætninger
Du har arbejdet med customer data platforms og CRM-dataflows, for eksempel Salesforce Data Cloud og Marketing Cloud, samt samtykkebevidst datahåndtering
Kender gængse AI- og ML-værktøjer, for eksempel Vertex AI, Gemini eller Azure OpenAI, vektor- og semantisk søgning, retrieval der føder LLM-funktioner, og nye standarder som MCP



Hvad tilbyder vi?

Hos Knowit tilbyder vi naturligvis en attraktiv løn- og pensionspakke, sundhedsordning, frokostordning og en god kaffe. Men først og fremmest skal du vælge Knowit, fordi det er et sted, hvor:


Du bliver en del af et passioneret team, der elsker at udfordre hinanden, både fagligt og socialt
Du har frihed til at forme din hverdag og din karriere i et af landets mest ambitiøse bureauer
Du arbejder med store kunder og innovative projekter, der gør en forskel
Der er plads til både professionalisme og personlighed, og hvor vi fejrer hinandens forskelligheder
Du har plads til at tage indflydelse og ansvar



Vi holder til i lyse lokaler i Aarhus C, og vi lægger vægt på fleksibilitet, fællesskab og ordentlighed, både over for hinanden og vores kunder.

Lyder det som den rette rolle for dig?

I stedet for en traditionel ansøgning vil vi gerne høre, hvordan du arbejder med løsningsarkitektur i praksis. Du behøver ikke skrive langt eller gøre det unødigt formelt. Konkrete erfaringer og ærlige refleksioner fortæller os langt mere end polerede buzzwords.

Når du søger stillingen, vil vi gerne have, at du svarer på ét eller flere af spørgsmålene nedenfor.


Del et eksempel på en dataløsning i BigQuery, Databricks eller lignende som du har bygget. Hvad skulle den bruges til og hvad var din rolle var
Giv et eksempel på, hvordan du har omsat et forretningsbehov til en konkret dataløsning. Hvad bidrog du med, og hvordan arbejdede du med datakvalitet og performance?
Hvordan bruger du AI-kodeassistenter eller andre AI-værktøjer i dit arbejde med data og kode? Del gerne et konkret eksempel på, hvad værktøjet hjalp dig med, og hvordan du kvalitetssikrede resultatet



Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Senior Solution Architect, Hans Skov på hans.skov@knowit.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Knowit is a consultancy firm that helps companies and people succeed in the digital transformation. Every day, millions of people use the solutions we have created. With 3,900 employees mainly in the Nordic countries, but also in operations in Germany and Poland, we work with clients and partners to develop innovative solutions that contribute to a sustainable and humane society.

Title: Dataanalytiker med interesse for metode og dataanalyse
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Vil du være en del af et område med en høj politisk bevågenhed? Vil du være med til at udvikle analytiske modeller og andre dataunderstøttede løsninger, der skal bidrage til en mere effektiv inddrivelse af offentlig gæld? Har du stærke metodiske og dataanalytiske evner, og har du lyst til at afprøve dem på store datamængder? Så er du måske vores nye dataanalytiker i Center for Data, Analyse og Modeller.

I Center for data, analyse og modeller udvikler vi analytiske modeller og andre dataløsninger. Modellernes beregninger anvendes dels som input til at sætte den strategiske retning for inddrivelsesområdet og dels til at optimere driften via en datadreven optimering af inddrivelsesprocesserne.

Området har en høj grad af politisk bevågenhed, så forandringer er en del af hverdagen. Vi søger nye kolleger med et højt ambitionsniveau og en god metodisk og dataanalytisk faglighed, som vil være en del af vores team.

Vi arbejder med dataanalyser og analysemodeller til inddrivelsesområdet

Du bliver en del af et kontor, der kombinerer høj faglighed med tæt samarbejde i mindre grupper. Vi har en uformel omgangstone med højt til loftet. Kontoret består af mange fagligheder - fra fysikere til sociologier – alle dog med den fællesnævner, at vi interesserer os for metode og dataanalyse samt formidling af resultater til et bredt publikum.

Med udgangspunkt i et datawarehouse, der samler store mængder register- og transaktionsdata fra forskellige systemer, udfører vi dataanalyser og udvikler analysemodeller til inddrivelsesområdet. F.eks. udvikler vi modeller vedrørende skyldnersegmentering, fremskrivning, kursværdi, forældelse og produktionsstyring. Modellerne anvendes blandt andet til at belyse forskellige problemstillinger og konsekvenser, der er knyttet til områdets politiske og strategiske beslutninger.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil være at:


Håndtere og kombinere data og gennemføre dataanalyse på store datamængder
Udvikle eller videreudvikle vores statistiske/analytiske datamodeller
Belyse problemstillinger på inddrivelsesområdet og præge faglige drøftelser om opstilling af analysedesigns, metodevalg m.m.
Formidle forretningsviden og analyseresultater i eksempelvis notater eller præsentationer
Koordinere og styre processer ift. leverancer til vores interessenter.


Selvstændig, fagligt ansvarsfuld og grundig profil

Vi forestiller os, at du ved ansættelsestidspunktet har afsluttet en akademisk uddannelse på kandidatniveau indenfor et samfundsfagligt eller naturvidenskabeligt område. Du kunne fx være økonom, politolog, sociolog, matematiker eller fysiker.

Det er vigtigt, at du:


Via dit studie eller tidligere arbejde har praktisk erfaring med at håndtere og analysere data ved brug af kvantitative analysemetoder, fx via SQL, SAS, SPSS, Matlab, R, Python eller lignende værktøjer
Interesserer dig for dataanalyse og analytiske metoder, og at du er hurtig til at sætte dig ind i nye programmeringssprog
Er grundig, fagligt ansvarsfuld og kan arbejde selvstændigt på projekter med en lang tidshorisont.


Det er en fordel, hvis:

Du har en stærk analytisk sans, som gør dig i stand til at fordybe dig i komplekse problemstillinger indenfor databehandling og -analyse. Dertil har du en politisk forståelse, så du kan se konteksten, hvori dit arbejde indgår. Endelig er du i stand til at formidle dine resultater i et klart sprog, og du trives i et nogle gange travlt arbejdsmiljø, der stiller krav til både hastighed og præcision.

Grundig introduktion og oplæring

Du kan se frem til et fagligt udfordrende job med samfundsrelevante arbejdsopgaver på en arbejdsplads, som lægger stor vægt på faglighed og samarbejde. Som nyansat vil du indgå i et grundigt introduktions- og oplæringsforløb, for hurtigt at komme ind i arbejdsopgaverne. Udover introduktionsforløbet vil du blive tildelt en fast kollega fra teamet, som vil kunne hjælpe dig og besvare spørgsmål i opstartsfasen.

Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår

Send din ansøgning med CV, eksamensbevis og andre relevante dokumenter via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest søndag d. 30. august 2026. Spørgsmål besvares gerne af kontorchef Troels Verge på telefon 72 38 93 56 eller analytiker Sofie Scholl på telefon 72 37 82 59 eller mail sofie.scholl@gaeldst.dk.

Vi forventer at afholde 1. og 2. samtaler i løbet af uge 36 og 37. Der kan indgå en case og/eller person- og logikanalyse i rekrutteringsprocessen.

Forud for ansættelse foretager vi restancetjek for så vidt angår restancer til det offentlige. Vi indhenter straffeattest og referencer forud for ansættelsen.

Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten (AC), overenskomst for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og It-medarbejdere (HK) eller overenskomst for fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet.

Forventet tiltrædelse er den 1. november 2026 eller efter nærmere aftale.

Du bliver ansat i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner.Arbejdsstedet er Osvald Helmuths Vej 4, 2000 Frederiksberg.

Om Gældsstyrelsen

’Vi hjælper Danmark ud af gæld - vi er statens inkasso.’

Vil du være en del af et område med en høj politisk bevågenhed? Vil du være med til at udvikle analytiske modeller og andre dataunderstøttede løsninger, der skal bidrage til en mere effektiv inddrivelse af offentlig gæld? Har du stærke metodiske og dataanalytiske evner, og har du lyst til at afprøve dem på store datamængder? Så er du måske vores nye dataanalytiker i Center for Data, Analyse og Modeller.

I Center for data, analyse og modeller udvikler vi analytiske modeller og andre dataløsninger. Modellernes beregninger anvendes dels som input til at sætte den strategiske retning for inddrivelsesområdet og dels til at optimere driften via en datadreven optimering af inddrivelsesprocesserne.

Området har en høj grad af politisk bevågenhed, så forandringer er en del af hverdagen. Vi søger nye kolleger med et højt ambitionsniveau og en god metodisk og dataanalytisk faglighed, som vil være en del af vores team.

Vi arbejder med dataanalyser og analysemodeller til inddrivelsesområdet

Du bliver en del af et kontor, der kombinerer høj faglighed med tæt samarbejde i mindre grupper. Vi har en uformel omgangstone med højt til loftet. Kontoret består af mange fagligheder - fra fysikere til sociologier – alle dog med den fællesnævner, at vi interesserer os for metode og dataanalyse samt formidling af resultater til et bredt publikum.

Med udgangspunkt i et datawarehouse, der samler store mængder register- og transaktionsdata fra forskellige systemer, udfører vi dataanalyser og udvikler analysemodeller til inddrivelsesområdet. F.eks. udvikler vi modeller vedrørende skyldnersegmentering, fremskrivning, kursværdi, forældelse og produktionsstyring. Modellerne anvendes blandt andet til at belyse forskellige problemstillinger og konsekvenser, der er knyttet til områdets politiske og strategiske beslutninger.

  • Håndtere og kombinere data og gennemføre dataanalyse på store datamængder
  • Udvikle eller videreudvikle vores statistiske/analytiske datamodeller
  • Belyse problemstillinger på inddrivelsesområdet og præge faglige drøftelser om opstilling af analysedesigns, metodevalg m.m.
  • Formidle forretningsviden og analyseresultater i eksempelvis notater eller præsentationer
  • Koordinere og styre processer ift. leverancer til vores interessenter.

Title: Biostatistician and Statistical Programmer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Application deadline: 23/08/2026

Location: Ballerup 2750, Denmark, Denmark

Contract type: Permanent

Job ID: 4095

Role Description

Use your expertise in both biostatistics and statistical programming to shape evidence that supports better decisions for patients, healthcare systems, and science. In this role, you will work across clinical development, publications, and market access, applying your skills where they can create clear and visible impact. If you are looking for a position that offers variety, scientific depth, and the opportunity to work beyond a traditional specialist track, this could be the right next step for you.

Join us in creating a future legacy in medical dermatology

At LEO Pharma, we are global leaders in medical dermatology. We have 115 years’ experience in bringing innovation to healthcare. And we are eager to do much more. Each year, close to 100 million people have a better day because of our medicines. This is a unique opportunity to combine biostatistics and statistical programming in one highly impactful role, working across clinical development, publications, and market access in a way that offers both variety and visibility.

Your role

As our new Biostatistician & Statistical Programmer, you will play a key role in generating robust evidence from Phase 2b, Phase 3, and Phase 4 clinical trials, as well as non-interventional studies and external data sources. This is a broad and hands-on role where you will combine statistical thinking with programming expertise to support publication activities, pricing and reimbursement discussions, and evidence generation across our portfolio.

Perform biostatistical analyses and statistical programming for publication-related analysis requests, including abstracts and manuscripts
Conduct subgroup analyses to support affiliate pricing and reimbursement negotiations
Provide programming and statistical input to HTA and payer-related deliverables
Program, quality control, and document datasets, tables, figures, and listings
Contribute statistical guidance for meta-analyses and indirect treatment comparisons, including network meta-analysis and population-adjustment methods based on patient-level data


The role offers a rare opportunity to combine biostatistics and statistical programming in one position with broad scientific impact, working across diverse data sources including clinical trial, real-world, and external database evidence. You will contribute directly to publications, market access, and evidence-generation activities while joining a collaborative international environment with strong technical peers.

Your Qualifications

To succeed in this role, we imagine that you have the following qualifications:

MSc or PhD in Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative discipline
Experience working in the pharmaceutical industry or a related field
Strong practical expertise in SAS (familiarity with R will be an added value)
Experience with CDISC standards, including ADaM and SDTM, and familiarity with relevant regulatory guidelines
Experience with statistical analysis in clinical trials, and preferably also meta-analysis or indirect treatment comparison methods


LEO Pharma is built on collaboration, innovation and curiosity. Is this you? Can you bring this and a self-driven, flexible, and supportive mindset, along with the ability to thrive in cross-functional collaboration and a fast-paced environment?

Your new team

You will join the Real World Evidence DA & COA department within Global Clinical Development, where we work at the intersection of biostatistics, real-world evidence, and clinical outcome assessment. The team collaborates closely across projects and functions to deliver high-quality analyses that support both scientific and business decisions. In this role, your main interfaces will be with fellow biostatisticians and statistical programmers, with occasional collaboration across Medical Affairs, HEOR, and Market Access.

Your application

For additional information, please contact Niels Hoejsager Bennike, Head of Real World Evidence, DA and COA at NHBDK@leo-pharma.com.

You do not need to upload a cover letter, but feel free to add a few sentences in your resume or CV on why this position has your interest. Please refrain from adding a photo to your CV.

Beyond the skin

Become part of LEO Pharma, a global leader in medical dermatology, as we go beyond the skin to make a lasting impact. We are the legacy-builders of the future – enabling people to have a better today and tomorrow. With the world as our lab, we are transforming innovative ideas into more effective and easier-to-use medicines. Through collaboration and partnerships, we can do much more.

At LEO Pharma, we believe in the power of individuals to drive change. Our flat organizational structure empowers you to make a visible impact and offers versatile roles for professional growth. We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, recognizing that our different perspectives, backgrounds, and attitudes enable us to make the best decisions. Join our passionate team at LEO Pharma and be yourself as we work together to make a fundamental difference.

For certain positions, LEO Pharma might complete a background check conducted by a third party.

Title: Senior Network Analytics Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Maersk connects people, businesses and markets across the world. You will join a team that builds and strengthens the analytical and optimization foundation behind our global network planning. We use data, modelling and advanced optimization algorithms to support better operational and strategic decisions. We are a diverse, international community where different backgrounds, perspectives and experiences make us stronger. We work openly and collaboratively and value curiosity, clarity and shared ownership.

Ready to shape the next generation of Maersk’s optimization intelligence?

This senior role sets direction for how optimisation and modelling guide planning and network design at Maersk. You will define problem structures, design optimisation models and heuristics, and lead new capabilities from concept through validation and into implementation. You will drive the innovation agenda, guide change across the value chain and ensure new methods translate into real improvements for planners and decision makers. You will act as a technical lead, mentor others and help turn strong ideas into scalable, reliable solutions. You will work on challenging container flow, routing and network design problems that require strong problem framing, deep modelling expertise and a practical engineering mindset.

This is a fully office-based role, requiring attendance at the advertised location five days per week.

What We Offer

To work at Maersk is to step into a world of opportunity and impact. You’ll collaborate with talented professionals who keep global trade moving—shaping the flow of goods, ideas, and possibilities across the planet. Here, your growth truly matters. With access to world‑class learning, supportive leaders, and space to stretch your potential, you can build a career that takes you further than you imagined. You’ll be part of a diverse, inclusive community where you’re valued for your unique strengths and celebrated for the contributions you make. And with flexible hybrid working and industry‑leading benefits, you’ll have the freedom and support to thrive—professionally and personally

Within your impact and responsibilities, you will:


Design advanced optimisation models and heuristics and take them from idea to validated and implemented capability
Frame complex planning problems as clear mathematical formulations with explicit assumptions and success criteria
Build reusable modelling components that follow modern engineering standards and integrate with production data systems
Improve existing optimisation logic by closing gaps and lifting performance and scalability
Run structured experiments to compare alternatives and verify model behaviour with data
Translate findings into clear recommendations and partner with stakeholders to drive implementation and adoption
Shape the innovation roadmap by identifying new application areas and accelerating promising concepts into pilots and scale
Coach junior analysts and raise standards in modelling practice, documentation and code quality
Communicate results, trade offs and limitations in simple and decision-oriented language


What you'll be accountable for:


Integrity, stability and performance of optimisation logic used in planning and decision making
Robust validation and successful implementation of new modelling features with clear readiness criteria
Clear documentation of assumptions, constraints and data dependencies to support transparent decisions
A value based and well prioritised modelling backlog focused on measurable business impact and time to value
Demonstrated improvements in modelling logic, scalability and performance in real planning scenarios
Effective adoption and correct use of optimisation capabilities across the user community with visible change outcomes
Active contribution to the optimisation innovation pipeline by shaping new concepts, evaluating emerging methods and advancing promising ideas toward pilots and scale
Leadership in the transformation agenda by helping teams shift from manual work to model driven planning and ensuring new solutions are embedded and used with confidence


What you bring:

A deep technical expertise, strong analytical judgement and a record of leading optimisation solutions from first principles through implementation and adoption. You communicate clearly with both technical and non technical audiences and you take ownership of delivery and outcomes.

You offer:


A master’s degree or PhD in engineering, mathematics, computer science or a related quantitative field with exposure to optimisation or modelling
Documented experience designing and deploying optimisation models or decision support algorithms in operational or production environments
Expert level Python skills, experience applying C++ for performance critical components and strong SQL capabilities
Advanced knowledge of Operations Research, including Mixed Integer Programming, graph theory, decomposition methods, and large-scale optimisation
Strength in problem framing, algorithm design, empirical validation and scaling solutions
Confident use of Git and modern software engineering workflows
Ability to collaborate smoothly across diverse functions and to build strong working relationships that support clear communication, shared problem solving and aligned decision making
Ability to lead change by guiding stakeholders through adoption, explaining trade offs and ensuring appropriate use of models
A disciplined approach to documentation, testing, version control and reproducibility


It is a plus if you also bring:


Familiarity with GPU based acceleration or parallel computation for optimising large problem instances

As a key member of our team, you will have the opportunity to contribute directly to the performance and evolution of our intraday power trading activities. Develop fair value models for intraday power markets
Implement algorithms to integrate models with market dynamics to inform trading strategy
Compile high-quality datasets to integrate fundamental and real-time market data
Monitor and adjust model parameters in response to shifting market conditions, liquidity regimes, or evolving trading situations
Identify model limitations, edge cases, and structural risks, and proactively address them
Collaborate with engineering to optimize operations, enhance infrastructure, and scale automated decision-making

Master’s degree in Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, or a related field, possession of a PhD will be considered an advantage.
A minimum of 3 years' experience is required
Extensive experience with continuous trading, whether in prediction markets, betting platforms, crypto, or traditional markets
Expertise in predictive modelling and machine learning, with a focus on time-series analysis.
Ability to articulate model assumptions, and real-world edge cases.
Proficiency in Python and SQL, with deep working knowledge of the data and machine learning ecosystem.

Competitive compensation, inclusive of performance-based bonuses.
Comprehensive benefits package.
Pathways for professional growth and career development.
A dynamic and supportive work environment where innovation and creativity are encouraged.
Opportunity to be part of building a great business where your efforts are recognized and valued.

Title: Lead Data Analyst (Pricing & Monetization)
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

About The Role

Data isn’t just a byproduct of our business; it’s the engine that drives our growth. We are looking for a Lead Pricing & Monetization Analyst to join our Go-To-Market (GTM) Analytics team. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role designed for a seasoned expert who can bridge the gap between complex statistical modeling and strategic GTM execution in a B2B SaaS environment.

Your mission is to help us answer critical questions about our go-to-market strategy, driving growth across the customer lifecycle. You will lead the charge in analyzing our revenue engine and providing crucial insights into our pricing architecture and monetization strategies to maximize our overall commercial impact.

The GTM Analytics team operates in a semi-embedded model where each analyst serves as a trusted partner and owner for a specific strategic focus area. In this role, you’ll focus on empowering the Pricing & Monetization team while working cross-functionally across our commercial organization, and broader analytics and data teams.

What You’ll Be Doing


Pricing & Monetization Analytics: Partner with product and commercial leadership to evaluate pricing and packaging strategies, analyzing discount behaviors and tracking the financial performance of new monetization initiatives.
Advanced Statistical Analysis: Design and execute complex analyses, including cohort analysis, customer segmentation (clustering), and predictive modeling to identify growth levers.
Tool & Capability Development: Build and scale our analytics infrastructure. This includes developing proprietary solutions in R/Python and integrating them into our data stack.
Stakeholder Influence: Provide actionable insights to collaborate with, and influence stakeholders in making data informed decisions and drive data literacy around GTM optimization.
Scalable Reporting: Architect intuitive dashboards in Looker that don't just show data, but provide actionable insights for stakeholders ranging from Commercial Ops to executive leadership.
Data Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with our data engineering team using dbt to ensure our GTM data pipelines are robust, efficient, and "analyst-ready."


Who You Are


A Proven Analytical Lead: You bring demonstrated experience successfully driving strategic GTM initiatives, establishing best-in-class analytical standards, and mentoring team members to elevate overall capabilities across the analytics function.
A Technical Expert: You are fluent in SQL and R/Python and have a solid understanding of regression models, clustering, propensity and statistical significance with an ability to apply them to complex commercial and GTM problems.
A Strategic GTM Thinker: You have several years of experience solving go-to-market problems using appropriate analytical techniques. You don't just build models; you understand the "why" behind the numbers. You understand core SaaS metrics and have experience evaluating pricing strategies, monetization models, or commercial packaging structures.
A Trusted Advisor: You possess strong stakeholder management skills knowing how to challenge assumptions and guide leadership toward data-informed decisions.
An Expert Communicator: You can explain complex solutions and models to a non-technical audience and present a compelling case for strategic optimization to executive leadership.
Data Storytelling: You have proven experience with Looker (LookML) or similar BI tools, emphasizing best practices in data storytelling.
A Data Architect: You have a high bar for data quality and have experience working within modern data stacks (e.g BigQuery, dbt, Airflow)


What’s In It For You


A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you
Competitive compensation package + bonus
25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated)
Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community
Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist
Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health
Paid parental leave
Central office with a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price
Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials
Opportunity to join the Trustpilot Social Club for a small monthly fee and attend regular social and leisure activities like go-karting, cooking classes, and escape rooms
Employee discounts to restaurants and shops

About Us

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.

Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York.

We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas.

Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.

Join us at the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is a global company and our data practices are designed to ensure that your personally identifiable information is appropriately protected. Please note that your personal information will be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in our Privacy Policy.

If you have a disability and would like to discuss any adjustments you might need either in submitting your application, or to the recruitment process more generally, please let us know by contacting our Talent Acquisition Team (talent.acquisition@trustpilot.com) quoting the role you wish to apply for.

Title: AI Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
HOFOR er i gang med at etablere en fælles AI-platform, der skal gøre det muligt at udvikle, afprøve og sætte AI-løsninger sikkert i drift på tværs af organisationen. Vi søger en AI Engineer, der kan udvikle de første løsninger på platformen og omsætte konkrete forretningsbehov til velfungerende AI-agenter, assistenter og integrationer.

Fra AI-idé til løsning i drift

Du bliver en del af AI & BI Udvikling og får en central rolle i at udvikle, integrere og modne AI-løsninger, der skaber værdi i organisationen. Du kommer til at arbejde i Microsoft Foundry og relevante Azure-services, men du står ikke alene med platformen, du samarbejder tæt med blandt andet cloud-, arkitektur- og sikkerhedsteamet samt forretningen.

Du får stor indflydelse på de tekniske løsninger, kort vej fra idé til produktion og mulighed for at udvikle komponenter, der kan genbruges på tværs af organisationen.

Dine arbejdsopgaver bliver at:


Udvikle AI-agenter, assistenter, RAG-løsninger og genbrugelige AI-komponenter med Microsoft Foundry og relevante Azure-services
Udvikle backend-løsninger, AI-baserede værktøjer og integrationer med Python og API’er
Integrere AI-løsninger med bl.a. ServiceNow, Microsoft 365 og andre forretningssystemer
Udvikle løsninger, der anvender organisationens data og viden sikkert, kontrolleret og dokumenteret
Teste og evaluere AI-løsningernes kvalitet, relevans, sikkerhed og performance før og efter idriftsættelse
Bidrage til automatiseret deployment, monitorering og stabil drift af AI-løsninger i samarbejde med platform-, cloud- og sikkerhedsteams
Dokumentere løsninger og udvikle komponenter og mønstre, der kan genbruges i kommende AI-projekter



Erfaring med AI- og softwareudvikling

Du har solid erfaring med softwareudvikling og med at udvikle AI-løsninger, der kan integreres med eksisterende systemer og bringes sikkert i drift.

Det vigtigste er, at du kan omsætte et forretningsbehov til en teknisk AI-løsning og selv bidrage til udvikling, integration, test og produktionsmodning.

Derudover forventer vi, at du:


Har erfaring inden for Python, API’er og backendudvikling
Har erfaring med Microsoft Foundry, Azure eller en tilsvarende platform til udvikling af AI-løsninger
Har arbejdet med generativ AI, f.eks. AI-agenter, RAG, værktøjskald eller integration af sprogmodeller
Har forståelse for CI/CD, logging, monitorering, identitetsstyring og sikker softwareudvikling
Kan formidle tekniske løsninger klart til både tekniske kolleger og forretningen
Kommunikerer sikkert og professionelt på dansk, både mundtligt og skriftligt. Vores koncernsprog er dansk og stillingen kræver, at du kan navigere sikkert i dansk dokumentation, dialog og opgaveløsning



Dine dygtige kolleger er klar til at byde dig velkommen

Du får 9 dygtige kolleger, du kan sparre og grine med i hverdagen og bliver en del af et tværfagligt team med AI- og UX-specialister, BI-udviklere og projektledere. Derudover bliver du også en del af et større digitaliseringsområde med 180 engagerede medarbejdere.

Vi værdsætter faglig forskellighed og prioriterer et sundt og fleksibelt arbejdsmiljø, der bl.a. giver plads og mulighed for hjemmearbejde efter aftale med nærmeste leder. Hos os er der plads til dig, og til at du har et bæredygtigt arbejdsliv.

Du kan læse mere om vores medarbejdergoder her .

Sådan bliver du vores kollega

Er du klar til nye muligheder, så ser vi frem til at høre fra dig senest den 23. august 2026. Vi vil gerne gøre det nemt for dig at søge vores stilling, du skal derfor ikke skrive en ansøgning, men blot sende dit CV, hvor du sætter nogle ord på din motivation for at søge stillingen. Du kan finde inspiration til at skrive et motiveret CV her.

Vi afholder 1. samtaler den 28. og 31. august og 2. samtaler den 8. og 9. september.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte sektionsleder Shadi Chreiteh på tlf. 34458460.

Søg stillingen ved at klikke på ”Søg stillingen”.

Hos os får du plads

Vand, varme, hverdag. I HOFOR sikrer vi forsyningen i hovedstadsområdet. Men vores ansvar rækker længere: Vi skaber fremtidens bæredygtige byer. Det kræver overskud, og derfor giver vi dig plads. Plads til at forfølge de store ideer og til at hente de små. Plads til at dyrke de faglige detaljer og til at tegne de store linjer. Plads til at hjælpe hinanden og til at tænke nyt, når der er brug for det. Vi har plads til flere og til, at du kan være med.

HOFOR. Hos os får du plads. Til fællesskab, udvikling og et bæredygtigt arbejdsliv.

Inkluderende kultur og rekruttering

I HOFOR arbejder vi på at skabe en inkluderende kultur, og vi leder efter dygtige kollegaer uanset udseende, køn, kønsidentitet, seksuel orientering, etnicitet, religion, handicap, alder osv. Vi søger en AI Engineer, der kan udvikle de første løsninger på platformen og omsætte konkrete forretningsbehov til velfungerende AI-agenter, assistenter og integrationer.

Fra AI-idé til løsning i drift

Du bliver en del af AI & BI Udvikling og får en central rolle i at udvikle, integrere og modne AI-løsninger, der skaber værdi i organisationen. Du kommer til at arbejde i Microsoft Foundry og relevante Azure-services, men du står ikke alene med platformen, du samarbejder tæt med blandt andet cloud-, arkitektur- og sikkerhedsteamet samt forretningen.

Du får stor indflydelse på de tekniske løsninger, kort vej fra idé til produktion og mulighed for at udvikle komponenter, der kan genbruges på tværs af organisationen.

Dine arbejdsopgaver bliver at:

  • Udvikle AI-agenter, assistenter, RAG-løsninger og genbrugelige AI-komponenter med Microsoft Foundry og relevante Azure-services
  • Udvikle backend-løsninger, AI-baserede værktøjer og integrationer med Python og API’er
  • Integrere AI-løsninger med bl.a. ServiceNow, Microsoft 365 og andre forretningssystemer
  • Udvikle løsninger, der anvender organisationens data og viden sikkert, kontrolleret og dokumenteret
  • Teste og evaluere AI-løsningernes kvalitet, relevans, sikkerhed og performance før og efter idriftsættelse
  • Bidrage til automatiseret deployment, monitorering og stabil drift af AI-løsninger i samarbejde med platform-, cloud- og sikkerhedsteams
  • Dokumentere løsninger og udvikle komponenter og mønstre, der kan genbruges i kommende AI-projekter


Erfaring med AI- og softwareudvikling

Du har solid erfaring med softwareudvikling og med at udvikle AI-løsninger, der kan integreres med eksisterende systemer og bringes sikkert i drift.

Det vigtigste er, at du kan omsætte et forretningsbehov til en teknisk AI-løsning og selv bidrage til udvikling, integration, test og produktionsmodning.

Derudover forventer vi, at du:

  • Har erfaring inden for Python, API’er og backendudvikling
  • Har erfaring med Microsoft Foundry, Azure eller en tilsvarende platform til udvikling af AI-løsninger
  • Har arbejdet med generativ AI, f.eks. AI-agenter, RAG, værktøjskald eller integration af sprogmodeller
  • Har forståelse for CI/CD, logging, monitorering, identitetsstyring og sikker softwareudvikling
  • Kan formidle tekniske løsninger klart til både tekniske kolleger og forretningen
  • Kommunikerer sikkert og professionelt på dansk, både mundtligt og skriftligt. Vores koncernsprog er dansk og stillingen kræver, at du kan navigere sikkert i dansk dokumentation, dialog og opgaveløsning


Dine dygtige kolleger er klar til at byde dig velkommen

Du får 9 dygtige kolleger, du kan sparre og grine med i hverdagen og bliver en del af et tværfagligt team med AI- og UX-specialister, BI-udviklere og projektledere. Derudover bliver du også en del af et større digitaliseringsområde med 180 engagerede medarbejdere.

Vi værdsætter faglig forskellighed og prioriterer et sundt og fleksibelt arbejdsmiljø, der bl.a. giver plads og mulighed for hjemmearbejde efter aftale med nærmeste leder. Hos os er der plads til dig, og til at du har et bæredygtigt arbejdsliv.

Du kan læse mere om vores medarbejdergoder her .

Sådan bliver du vores kollega

Er du klar til nye muligheder, så ser vi frem til at høre fra dig senest den 23. august 2026. Vi vil gerne gøre det nemt for dig at søge vores stilling, du skal derfor ikke skrive en ansøgning, men blot sende dit CV, hvor du sætter nogle ord på din motivation for at søge stillingen. Du kan finde inspiration til at skrive et motiveret CV her.

Vi afholder 1. samtaler den 28. og 31. august og 2. samtaler den 8. og 9. september.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte sektionsleder Shadi Chreiteh på tlf. 34458460.

Søg stillingen ved at klikke på ”Søg stillingen”.

Hos os får du plads

Vand, varme, hverdag. I HOFOR sikrer vi forsyningen i hovedstadsområdet. Men vores ansvar rækker længere: Vi skaber fremtidens bæredygtige byer. Det kræver overskud, og derfor giver vi dig plads. Plads til at forfølge de store ideer og til at hente de små. Plads til at dyrke de faglige detaljer og til at tegne de store linjer. Plads til at hjælpe hinanden og til at tænke nyt, når der er brug for det. Vi har plads til flere og til, at du kan være med.

HOFOR. Hos os får du plads. Til fællesskab, udvikling og et bæredygtigt arbejdsliv.

Inkluderende kultur og rekruttering

I HOFOR arbejder vi på at skabe en inkluderende kultur, og vi leder efter dygtige kollegaer uanset udseende, køn, kønsidentitet, seksuel orientering, etnicitet, religion, handicap, alder osv. Vi vil gerne skabe lige muligheder for alle samt sikre en retfærdig rekrutteringsproces. Undlad venligst at vedhæfte et billede.

Title: Research Scientists in Computational Modelling for Neutron Science
Place: Kongens Lyngby, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Research Scientists in Computational Modelling for Neutron Science




The European Spallation Source (ESS) is one of Europe’s largest research infrastructure projects and is building the world’s most powerful neutron source. Through cutting-edge science and technology, ESS will enable discoveries that advance our understanding of materials, energy, health, and the environment.




ESS is expanding Data Analysis & User Support (DAUS) group at the Data Management and Scientific Computing Centre (DMSC) located just north of Copenhagen in Denmark. We are seeking outstanding candidates for two computational modelling and simulation positions: one focused on life science and soft matter, and one on hard condensed matter, including magnetic materials and excitations.




About the role

Neutron scattering offers unique insights into how materials are structured and how they behave at the atomic scale. At ESS, we want to combine world-leading experiments with advanced computational methods to help researchers get the most from their data and accelerate scientific discovery.




Computational modelling is becoming an increasingly important part of neutron science. We are interested in approaches such as density functional theory (DFT), molecular dynamics, Monte Carlo and spin dynamics simulations, as well as emerging machine learning and AI methods.




In this role, you will develop new modelling and data analysis approaches for neutron scattering experiments and work closely with ESS scientists, software developers, academic collaborators, and international partners. Your work will help shape the next generation of scientific workflows across the ESS instrument suite. You are also expected to provide modelling support for users’ experiments where relevant.




We are especially interested in candidates with experience connecting simulations, theory, or AI methods to neutron scattering or related experimental techniques. Experience in neutron scattering is valuable, but not required. We also welcome applicants from adjacent computational or experimental fields who are excited to bring their expertise into this rapidly developing area of research.




The role combines scientific research, computational development, and collaboration within a highly international environment where science, software, and innovation come together.




Key responsibilities

The successful candidates will:




Contribute to advanced computational workflows supporting neutron scattering experiments.
Work with ESS software developers, scientists, and external collaborators to integrate modelling and analysis methods into the ESS scientific software ecosystem.
Develop and maintain an internationally recognized research programme aligned with the DMSC strategy.
Participate in selected user experiments and scientific projects at ESS.
Build collaborations with universities, research institutes, and ESS partners.




The life science and soft matter position includes opportunities to collaborate with the ESS Lighthouse initiatives CaIFF and NEUDATA4LIFE. For exceptional candidates, ESS may support applications to the Novo Nordisk Foundation Start Package Programme or similar funding opportunities.




We welcome applications from both early-career and established researchers.




What we offer

DMSC is located on the DTU campus in Kongens Lyngby, north of Copenhagen, while the ESS neutron facility is based in Lund, Sweden. Together, they form a unique cross-border scientific environment in the Øresund region.




You will join a dynamic and highly collaborative international workplace with colleagues representing nearly 60 nationalities across ESS and DMSC. We offer flexible working conditions, opportunities for professional development, and close interaction between computational science, instrumentation, and large-scale experiments.




Benefits include 25 + 5 annual leave days in addition to public and company holidays, an attractive pension scheme, preventative healthcare benefits, and relocation support for international hires where applicable.




This is a full-time, permanent position based in Kongens Lyngby, Denmark, and we need someone who can start as soon as practically possible.Learn more about living and working in Scandinavia: https://ess.eu/living-working-scandinavia




For further information

For information about the position, contact the Group Leader for Data Analysis & User Support (DAUS), Torben Roland Nielsen, at torben.nielsen@ess.eu.

For recruitment-related questions, contact Recruitment Officer Janne Erwolter at janne.erwolter@ess.eu.




Application deadline

Please submit your application no later than 27 September 2026.




Applicants should submit:

A CV, including relevant computational methods and technical expertise.
A complete publication list, highlighting up to five relevant publications.
A statement of research interests and potential collaborations.
A draft research plan outlining future directions and relevance to ESS and the user programme for the ealier instruments, BIFROST, DREAM, ESTIA, LOKI, NMX, and ODIN




We look forward to receiving your application.

Title: Experienced Data Engineer - Innovation and Consumers, Aarhus or Gdansk
Description:
Are you passionate about data, AI and technology, and eager to build digital solutions that create real business value?

Our mission is simple to deliver business value through digital solutions that meet real business needs. We are looking for a curious and collaborative Senior IT Developer who is eager to leverage data, AI, and technology to solve challenges, enable better decisions, and make a lasting impact says Marianne Helleshøj, Head of IT Product for Innovation & Consumers.

How You Will Make An Impact

As an Senior IT Developer, you will join the Commercial IT Product team supporting Innovation and Consumer Intelligence. You will help develop and maintain data-driven solutions that enable better insights, decision-making and business outcomes. Working closely with business stakeholders and your team members, you will translate requirements into scalable and maintainable technical solutions.

Together with the team, you will build and maintain data products on Arla’s data platform primarily built around Azure Databricks, Power BI, and Microsoft Foundry. The solutions will be built in a mixture of PySpark and SQL and deployment will happen via Terraform with version control in Azure DevOps or GitHub.

Your key responsibilities include


Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Develop and maintain data pipelines, data models and digital solutions that support business needs.
Build scalable ETL/ELT processes and contribute to high-quality data engineering practices.
Support the continuous improvement of existing solutions and development processes.
Work closely with developers, architects, IT specialists and business stakeholders to deliver reliable and maintainable solutions.
Contribute to the development of modern cloud-based data platforms and applications.


What Will Make You Successful

To succeed in this role, you are curious, analytical and with strong collaboration skills. You enjoy solving complex problems, working with data and collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You strive to get the best out of the collaboration and supporting and helping your colleagues just as they help you when you need it. We imagine the ideal candidate brings


A degree in information systems, computer science, engineering or similar
3-5 years of experience as Data Warehouse Developer, BI Developer, SQL Developer or Data Engineer
The ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions
Experience developing with Spark in Databrick
Proficient in vector databases, embeddings, LLMs, data agents and generative AI
Proficient in SQL and PySpark
Proficient in any ETL/ELT/Integration/Workflow/Task Automation tool (e.g. Azure Data Factory, Logic Apps, Azure Function, SSIS etc.)
Knowledge of data engineering best practices and scalable solution design in a lakehouse environment
A proactive, positive mindset and willingness to learn new technologies – especially within AI


It is an advantage but not a requirement if you also have any of these


Databricks experience
Experience with basic data science concepts and LLM know-hows
Azure cloud experience
Terraform knowledge
Knowledge of deployment concepts and containerization
Experience in web application development


What do we offer?

You will join a collaborative IT Product team within Commercial IT, working closely with Innovation and Consumer Intelligence. The role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of business, data, AI and technology, where your solutions help transform data into actionable insights and measurable business value.

We believe in learning by doing and provide an environment where curiosity, knowledge sharing and continuous development are encouraged.

Would you like to join us?

If you are ready to start your career in a role where technology, data and business come together, we would love to hear from you. Please apply as soon as possible, as we review applications on a continuous basis and may close the recruitment once the right candidate has been found.

For additional information, please contact Marianne Helleshøj, Head of IT Product for Innovation and Consumers, at +45 91 31 16 39.

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with natural, sustainable nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

Title: AI Engineer
Description:
We’re looking for an AI Engineer who enjoys building useful software and wants to work hands-on with, not just experiment with it, but turn it into solutions people actually use.




At Boyum IT, we’re exploring how AI can make a real difference across our products and the way we work internally. That might mean building an assistant that helps colleagues find the right information faster, supporting our customer-facing teams with smarter tools, or connecting AI capabilities with our existing products and systems.




This is a practical, hands-on engineering role. You’ll have space to explore new ideas, but the goal is always the same: build something useful, reliable, and ready for the real world.

You don’t need to know every technology in our stack from day one. We’re looking for a strong software engineer who already has some hands-on experience with AI and wants to go deeper.




About the Team: We call ourselves the “Unified Platform Services” team and work across products and development teams to build shared solutions and make individual product teams more effective. We also help shape how AI is used across our different products. We are a small team with a mix of skills across AI, DevOps, and traditional software development.




What You Will Be Doing




As our new AI engineer colleague, you will be assigned to specific AI projects and deliveries, but you’ll also share what you learn and help other development teams make effective use of AI tools. As part of these two focus areas, you will:




Design, build and maintain AI-powered applications, assistants and services.
Develop backend services and APIs.
Work with LLM-powered applications, RAG, semantic search and agentic workflows.
Build and improve data pipelines and knowledge bases used by AI applications.
Help evaluate AI solutions and improve their quality, reliability and accuracy.
Deploy and operate solutions in Azure.
Work with Docker, CI/CD and Azure DevOps as part of the development lifecycle.
Collaborate with product teams and internal functions to understand problems and turn them into practical technical solutions.
Build reusable tools, integrations and templates that help other teams work effectively with AI.
Share knowledge and contribute to how we use AI across the company.




Our current technology landscape includes Python, PostgreSQL/vector, Dagster, Azure, Azure AI Foundry, MCP, Docker and Azure DevOps. You do not need to have worked with all of these before joining.




What We Are Looking For




We think you’ll be a good match if you have:

Around 3+ years of software development experience, ideally in backend or software engineering
Experience building production services or APIs – ideally AI-related ones
Hands-on experience building AI-powered applications or integrating AI into software
A solid understanding of databases, testing, and maintainable software
Curiosity about where AI genuinely adds value, and where it doesn’t
The ability to work with both technical and non-technical colleagues to understand a problem before jumping to a solution




Nice to Have

Experience with any of the following is a bonus, not a checklist:

C#
Azure or another cloud platform
Docker, DevOps, and CI/CD
Data pipelines
RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or AI agents




Why Join Boyum IT




At Boyum IT, our culture is built around Energy for Life - the belief that people do their best work when they feel energized, supported, and able to balance work with life outside of work.

For us, Energy for Life means creating a workplace where people can grow professionally, stay healthy, feel connected, and have the flexibility to be present for family, friends, and personal priorities.




What We Offer

A culture built around our Energy for Life mindset
Flexible work arrangements and respect for work-life balance
A diverse, international team with colleagues from more than 45 nationalities
A supportive workplace focused on wellbeing, inclusion, and belonging
Career development opportunities aligned with your personal goals
Helpful, knowledgeable, and collaborative colleagues
A workplace where your ideas and feedback are valued
Boyum IT committed to responsible business and positive ESG impact




Interested?

Send us your CV in English or Danish.

We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so there’s no need to wait until the last minute.




And if you’re reading the requirements thinking “I don’t tick every box”, that doesn’t automatically mean you shouldn’t apply. We’re interested in what you’ve built, how you think, and where you want to grow next.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Title: Product Manager, Data Insights
Description:
About Us

nShift is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 500 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.
