Messy data, ambiguous model outputs, and stakeholders who don't yet see why the data matters are familiar territory.

You think in terms of compounding: how every data point collected today improves predictions tomorrow, and how that improvement builds a position competitors cannot close. Data insights is nShift's path from a tool company to an intelligence platform, and that scope motivates you rather than overwhelming you.

You are as comfortable in a Jupyter notebook as in a leadership meeting, and you know when each is needed.

Purpose of role

The mission is to define what nShift builds with that data, validate it before engineering commits, and ship intelligence products that help shippers make better decisions. A shipper asking "how can I improve my delivery experience" should get an answer powered by the full network, not just their own history. Done well, that becomes a compounding intelligence layer: every data point collected today improves suggestions tomorrow, and the improvement creates a position no competitor can close.

The intelligence layer draws from two sources. Structured operational data, such as shipment telemetry and carrier performance, feeds statistical models and predictions. Qualitative data, such as customer support interactions, delivery exception messages, and community feedback, carries signal that numbers alone cannot surface. LLMs make that signal extractable and usable at scale. This role owns both.

The role sits at the intersection of product management and data science. You have the technical depth to build ML proof-of-concepts independently and the commercial judgment to translate those capabilities into products customers pay for. You write the strategy and the first notebook.

What You'll Be Doing

Define and own the data driven product strategy


Own the roadmap for nShift's data intelligence layer: carrier performance prediction, cross-customer benchmarking, ML-driven carrier recommendations, and related capabilities.
Translate nShift's data asset into a sequenced product strategy that delivers near-term value while building toward the compounding intelligence layer vision.
Define the information architecture for the data insights layer: what data is collected, how it is normalized (in partnership with adjacent teams), and how it is exposed to upstream products.
Make hard prioritization calls: what to build first to validate the ML hypothesis, what to defer, and what to kill when the data doesn't support the bet.
Own the qualitative intelligence pipeline alongside the quantitative one: define which unstructured sources carry decision-relevant signal (support tickets, delivery exception messages, customer forum, carrier communications), how LLM-extracted insights are structured for downstream use, and how qualitative and quantitative signals combine into a coherent intelligence product.
Own the positioning and differentiation narrative: why this dataset is uniquely nShift's, why no competitor can replicate it, and how to articulate that defensibility to enterprise buyers.



Build and validate before engineering commits


Run ML proof-of-concepts independently: data exploration, feature engineering, model selection, and initial validation, using Python, notebooks, and the data available in nShift's data layer.
Define the evaluation framework for both ML models and LLM pipelines. For ML features: what accuracy thresholds matter, how to measure model performance in production, how to distinguish signal from noise. For LLM-based features: how to assess output consistency, factual grounding, and quality at scale, where traditional accuracy metrics don't apply.
Design lightweight experiments that answer the key questions before a full engineering team is committed. Does the prediction accuracy justify the product? Does cross-customer data improve the model significantly? Is the data we have sufficient, or do we need to instrument more?
Translate POC findings into clear build, kill, or iterate decisions backed by data.



Partner across data, engineering, and commercial teams


Work closely with engineers to define the data models, pipelines, and normalization standards needed to power ML features. You are a customer and co-designer of the data layer, not a passenger.
Drive integration of data insights capabilities into existing products. Work closly with your PM peers to make this happen.
Engage directly with customers and prospects across the full spectrum, from small shippers to global enterprises, to validate intelligence use cases: what decisions do they make today that better data would improve? What would they pay for? What do they trust?
Build the commercial narrative: ROI frameworks, value quantification, and positioning for the target buyer.



Govern the data responsibly


Define the anonymization, aggregation, and consent frameworks that make cross-customer benchmarking legally and ethically sound, and credible to enterprise customers who will ask hard questions.
Work with Legal and the DPO to ensure data usage within the intelligence layer meets GDPR and contractual obligations. The data asset is only valuable if customers trust nShift to use it appropriately.
Establish transparency standards for ML-powered recommendations: when does a merchant see why a carrier was recommended? What level of explainability builds trust without revealing proprietary network data?



What You'll Bring

Must-have


Hands-on data proficiency across both paradigms: you can build and validate ML proof-of-concepts (data exploration, feature engineering, model training, evaluation) using Python and standard ML tooling (scikit-learn, pandas, XGBoost, or equivalent), and you can design and evaluate LLM-based analysis pipelines (prompt design, retrieval-augmented approaches, output quality evaluation). You are not a data scientist or an ML engineer, but you can work like one when the problem requires it.
Shipped ML-powered products: you have personally driven an ML or data intelligence product from initial hypothesis to production, including defining evaluation criteria, partnering with data engineers and scientists, and making commercial decisions based on model performance data.
PM fundamentals with commercial depth: 3+ years shipping B2B SaaS products. You can build a business case, define pricing, run customer discovery, and hold direct conversations with enterprise buyers about ROI.
Data literacy that earns engineering respect: you understand data models, pipeline design, normalization challenges, and the practical constraints of real production data. You can review a data schema and immediately ask the right questions.
Clear communication across the technical and commercial boundary: you can explain a precision-recall tradeoff to a CPO and a carrier event data use case to a data engineer in the same afternoon, without condescending to either.
Excellent written and verbal English: you will write strategy documents, ML experiment briefs, customer-facing product narratives, and present to leadership, often in the same week.



Nice to have


Experience with time-series or logistics domain data: carrier performance modelling, routing optimization, ETA prediction, or related domains.
Familiarity with data platform concepts: data lake houses, feature stores, model registries, observability for ML in production.
Background in cross-customer benchmarking or network intelligence products, where the value comes from aggregation rather than individual customer data.
Experience with GDPR-compliant data product design in a multi-tenant B2B SaaS context.
Nordic or European logistics market experience: carrier landscape, regulatory environment, freight economics.
Track record of building the first data product at a company, defining standards rather than inheriting them.

Title: Principal Data Scientist
Place: Ballerup Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Location - Ballerup

Your new department

The Principal Data Scientist in the Commercial AI & Data department is responsible for designing, developing, and implementing advanced AI and machine learning algorithms to process and analyse structured and unstructured data from diverse sources. You will be part of a business area that drives impact across the full Novo Nordisk value chain. We strive to stay close to our stakeholders in the business to ensure we deliver on their needs, helping reach millions of people living with serious chronic diseases. Our focus is on being at the forefront within our three areas; ensuring the highest quality for patients, being a trusted tech leader and an environmentally responsible business.

Your Key Responsibilities Include


Define Data Science Strategy
Develop and influence the organization's data science vision and roadmap.
Collaborate with senior leaders and executives to align AI/ML initiatives with business priorities.
Help determine where data science can create the greatest strategic value.
Lead Innovation and Advanced Analytics
Design and champion innovative AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics solutions.
Solve highly complex business problems through advanced statistical and computational methods.
Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies and methodologies.
Serve as a Technical Authority
Act as the organization’s subject matter expert for data science.
Establish best practices, standards, and frameworks for model development and deployment.
Provide expert guidance on methodologies, tools, and architectural decisions.
Shape Business Decisions
Translate business opportunities and challenges into data-driven strategies.
Communicate insights, risks, and recommendations to executive leadership.
Influence investment decisions and enterprise-wide initiatives using evidence-based approaches.
Mentor and Develop Talent
Coach senior data scientists and technical leaders.
Build organizational capability through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and establishing communities of practice.
Help develop future leaders in data science.
Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work across business functions, technology, engineering, analytics, product, compliance, and external partners.
Lead large-scale initiatives that span multiple teams and organizational boundaries.
Represent the IT Organization across the Stakeholders’ communities
Bring stakeholders together on the DS strategy and vision
Build external networks and stay at the forefront of AI and data science advancements.
Position the Enterprise AI org. as a leader in data-driven innovation.


Your New Department

The Data Scientist in the Commercial AI & Data department is responsible for designing, developing, and implementing advanced AI and machine learning algorithms to process and analyse structured and unstructured data from diverse sources. You will be entrusted with making independent decisions on the selection of suitable methodologies, and techniques for data analysis and model development.

Skills & Qualifications.


Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field. Ph.D. is preferred.
A proven track record of innovation and thought leadership.
Minimum 10 years of experience in data science, machine learning, or AI, with a focus on developing and applying advanced algorithms.
Deep expertise in cutting-edge data science methodologies and technologies
Strong research capabilities and the ability to translate research into business value
Experience developing enterprise-scale data strategies and AI roadmaps.
Ability to provide visionary leadership for the data science function
Broad understanding of pharma industry and Commercial business processes
Strong awareness of ethical and responsible AI practices
Experience influencing strategic decisions through data science and analytics.
In-depth knowledge of machine learning concepts, data modeling techniques and AI solution design.
Experience working with cross-functional teams (data engineering, ML engineering, analytics, product, operations).
Familiarity with MLOps tools and practices (e.g., MLflow, model registries, CI/CD for models) and cloud‑agnostic deployment patterns.
In‑depth understanding and practical experience with architecture, implementation, DevOps and support for AI solutions.
Experience working with cross‑functional teams (data engineering, ML engineering, analytics, product, operations) and external vendors.
Experience in pharmaceutical or regulated industries is beneficial but not mandatory.

Title: Research Informatics Data Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Build the digital foundation for scientific discovery

Every day, researchers rely on digital technologies to design experiments, generate data, and make scientific decisions.

We are looking for a Research Informatics Engineer who enjoys combining scientific understanding with technical expertise to build practical digital solutions that help researchers make better use of their data.

This is an engineering-focused Research Informatics role where you will help implement, configure and connect commercial scientific platforms, and build the data flows and integrations that enable modern research.

Your new role

At Lundbeck, Research Informatics works at the intersection of science, data and technology. We collaborate closely with researchers, colleagues across Lundbeck Global IT, and technology partners to implement, integrate and continuously improve the scientific systems, research data and digital workflows that support modern drug discovery.

As research becomes increasingly digital and data-driven, our role is to ensure that scientific systems evolve with the science, research data becomes a trusted asset, and digital technologies create real value for researchers.

You will join the Research Informatics team within Global Research. Working closely with researchers, colleagues across Lundbeck Global IT and technology vendors, you will help implement, configure and improve the digital platforms used across Research. You will contribute to scientific applications, research data and digital workflows that enable researchers to work more efficiently and make better use of their data.

This is a hands-on role where you will combine scientific understanding with technical skills to deliver practical digital solutions that support discovery research.

What you will do:

Support scientific applications


Work with researchers to gather, analyse and document business and scientific requirements for new digital capabilities.
Implement, configure and maintain scientific applications supporting Global Research.
Work with researchers to understand scientific workflows and translate research needs into practical digital solutions.
Support application lifecycle management, testing, documentation and user support.
Collaborate with colleagues across Lundbeck Global IT (EDE) and technology vendors to continuously improve the scientific application landscape.



Connect research data


Contribute to connecting research data across the digital research landscape.
Implement and support data flows, metadata models and integrations between scientific applications.
Apply FAIR data principles to improve the quality, accessibility and reuse of research data.
Help establish trusted research data that supports today's science and tomorrow's advanced analytics and AI.



Improve digital research


Identify opportunities to improve scientific workflows through better digital solutions.
Participate in implementation of new technologies and enhancements to existing platforms.
Contribute to testing, training and knowledge sharing.
Collaborate across Research, Lundbeck Global IT (EDE) and external partners to continuously improve the digital research environment.



Your future team

Research Informatics is a collaborative team with expertise spanning life sciences, laboratory informatics, research data management and digital technologies.

Together we build and continuously improve the scientific systems, research data and digital workflows that underpin discovery research. We combine scientific understanding with technical expertise to ensure our digital capabilities evolve alongside the science they support.

The position is based at Lundbeck Headquarters in Valby.

What You Bring To The Team

You are curious about science and motivated by solving practical problems through technology. You enjoy understanding how research is performed and using that understanding to build better systems, better research data and better digital workflows.

You are motivated by building and improving digital solutions that scientists rely on, and enjoy turning scientific needs into robust systems, integrations and data flows.

Required Qualifications


MSc in Life Sciences, Computer Science, Engineering or another relevant scientific or technical discipline.
Strong understanding of scientific research workflows.
Experience from pharmaceutical, biotechnology or academic research.



You Have Experience With Several Of The Following

You have experience working with scientific systems, research data and digital workflows and enjoy translating scientific needs into practical technical solutions. Experience with requirements gathering and using modern AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, including large language models (LLMs) for coding and technical problem solving, is an advantage.


Business and scientific requirements gathering
Using large language models (LLMs) and AI-assisted development tools to support coding, scripting and technical problem solving
FAIR data principles and research data management
Data flows between scientific applications
Metadata and scientific data models
Scientific applications and laboratory informatics
Configuration of commercial scientific software
Systems integration and APIs
Python or other scripting languages
SQL, relational databases and modern data platforms
Cloud-based scientific platforms



Experience with in vivo research and biologics, including antibody discovery, is an advantage.

Personal qualities


Enjoys solving problems in collaboration with others.
Is curious and eager to learn.
Takes a structured approach to your work.
Communicates effectively with both scientific and technical colleagues.
Enjoys working across scientific and technical disciplines.



Our promise to you

Lundbeck offers an inspiring workplace and innovative culture, where our curiosity, accountability and adaptability enable us to transform lives. We want to go faster and further on addressing the big unmet needs of people living with brain disorders. We offer rewarding careers with a mix of exciting tasks and development opportunities that are balanced with initiatives focused on your well-being.

We need every brain in the game, and at Lundbeck, we are committed to building a workforce that is as diverse as the people we serve. Read more about our commitment at www.lundbeck.com/global/about-us/our-commitment/diversity-and-inclusion.

At Lundbeck, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. Please note that the final base salary within the stated range will be based on relevant qualifications, skills, competencies, and level of proficiency as well as internal pay equity.

Apply now

Upload your CV and include a few lines about your motivation for applying. We ask you not to include a photo or personal information that does not relate to your professional experience.

If you have questions, please contact Maria Alexandersson, Director Research Informatics at maxa@lundbeck.com.

Applications must be received by August 31st, 2026.

You will join the Research Informatics team within Global Research. Working closely with researchers, colleagues across Lundbeck Global IT and technology vendors, you will help implement, configure and improve the digital platforms used across Research. You will contribute to scientific applications, research data and digital workflows that enable researchers to work more efficiently and make better use of their data.

Connect research data

Improve digital research

  • Collaborate across Research, Lundbeck Global IT (EDE) and external partners to continuously improve the digital research environment.

Research Informatics is a collaborative team with expertise spanning life sciences, laboratory informatics, research data management and digital technologies.

Together we build and continuously improve the scientific systems, research data and digital workflows that underpin discovery research. We combine scientific understanding with technical expertise to ensure our digital capabilities evolve alongside the science they support.

The position is based at Lundbeck Headquarters in Valby.

What You Bring To The Team

You are curious about science and motivated by solving practical problems through technology. You enjoy understanding how research is performed and using that understanding to build better systems, better research data and better digital workflows.

You are motivated by building and improving digital solutions that scientists rely on, and enjoy turning scientific needs into robust systems, integrations and data flows.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of scientific research workflows.
  • Experience from pharmaceutical, biotechnology or academic research.


You Have Experience With Several Of The Following

Experience with requirements gathering and using modern AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, including large language models (LLMs) for coding and technical problem solving, is an advantage.

  • Using large language models (LLMs) and AI-assisted development tools to support coding, scripting and technical problem solving
  • FAIR data principles and research data management
  • Data flows between scientific applications

  • Scientific applications and laboratory informatics
  • Configuration of commercial scientific software
  • Systems integration and APIs
  • Python or other scripting languages
  • SQL, relational databases and modern data platforms

Experience with in vivo research and biologics, including antibody discovery, is an advantage.

Personal qualities

Lundbeck offers an inspiring workplace and innovative culture, where our curiosity, accountability and adaptability enable us to transform lives. Title: Product Manager, Data Insights
Description:
About Us

nShift is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 500 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.

Our software is used by many of the world leading e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and 3PL shippers due to us having over 1000 carriers integrated into our platform, nearly 3 times more than our competitors!

If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.

About You

You think like a product manager and work like a data scientist. You have shipped ML-powered products to real customers and can point to the decisions you made, not just the ones made around you. Messy data, ambiguous model outputs, and stakeholders who don't yet see why the data matters are familiar territory.

You think in terms of compounding: how every data point collected today improves predictions tomorrow, and how that improvement builds a position competitors cannot close. Data insights is nShift's path from a tool company to an intelligence platform, and that scope motivates you rather than overwhelming you.

You are as comfortable in a Jupyter notebook as in a leadership meeting, and you know when each is needed.

Purpose of role

The mission is to define what nShift builds with that data, validate it before engineering commits, and ship intelligence products that help shippers make better decisions. A shipper asking "how can I improve my delivery experience" should get an answer powered by the full network, not just their own history. Done well, that becomes a compounding intelligence layer: every data point collected today improves suggestions tomorrow, and the improvement creates a position no competitor can close.

The intelligence layer draws from two sources. Structured operational data, such as shipment telemetry and carrier performance, feeds statistical models and predictions. Qualitative data, such as customer support interactions, delivery exception messages, and community feedback, carries signal that numbers alone cannot surface. LLMs make that signal extractable and usable at scale. This role owns both.

The role sits at the intersection of product management and data science. You have the technical depth to build ML proof-of-concepts independently and the commercial judgment to translate those capabilities into products customers pay for. You write the strategy and the first notebook.

What You'll Be Doing

Define and own the data driven product strategy


Own the roadmap for nShift's data intelligence layer: carrier performance prediction, cross-customer benchmarking, ML-driven carrier recommendations, and related capabilities.
Translate nShift's data asset into a sequenced product strategy that delivers near-term value while building toward the compounding intelligence layer vision.
Define the information architecture for the data insights layer: what data is collected, how it is normalized (in partnership with adjacent teams), and how it is exposed to upstream products.
Make hard prioritization calls: what to build first to validate the ML hypothesis, what to defer, and what to kill when the data doesn't support the bet.
Own the qualitative intelligence pipeline alongside the quantitative one: define which unstructured sources carry decision-relevant signal (support tickets, delivery exception messages, customer forum, carrier communications), how LLM-extracted insights are structured for downstream use, and how qualitative and quantitative signals combine into a coherent intelligence product.
Own the positioning and differentiation narrative: why this dataset is uniquely nShift's, why no competitor can replicate it, and how to articulate that defensibility to enterprise buyers.



Build and validate before engineering commits


Run ML proof-of-concepts independently: data exploration, feature engineering, model selection, and initial validation, using Python, notebooks, and the data available in nShift's data layer.
Define the evaluation framework for both ML models and LLM pipelines. For ML features: what accuracy thresholds matter, how to measure model performance in production, how to distinguish signal from noise. For LLM-based features: how to assess output consistency, factual grounding, and quality at scale, where traditional accuracy metrics don't apply.
Design lightweight experiments that answer the key questions before a full engineering team is committed. Does the prediction accuracy justify the product? Does cross-customer data improve the model significantly? Is the data we have sufficient, or do we need to instrument more?
Translate POC findings into clear build, kill, or iterate decisions backed by data.



Partner across data, engineering, and commercial teams


Work closely with engineers to define the data models, pipelines, and normalization standards needed to power ML features. You are a customer and co-designer of the data layer, not a passenger.
Drive integration of data insights capabilities into existing products. Work closly with your PM peers to make this happen.
Engage directly with customers and prospects across the full spectrum, from small shippers to global enterprises, to validate intelligence use cases: what decisions do they make today that better data would improve? What would they pay for? What do they trust?
Build the commercial narrative: ROI frameworks, value quantification, and positioning for the target buyer.



Govern the data responsibly


Define the anonymization, aggregation, and consent frameworks that make cross-customer benchmarking legally and ethically sound, and credible to enterprise customers who will ask hard questions.
Work with Legal and the DPO to ensure data usage within the intelligence layer meets GDPR and contractual obligations. The data asset is only valuable if customers trust nShift to use it appropriately.
Establish transparency standards for ML-powered recommendations: when does a merchant see why a carrier was recommended? What level of explainability builds trust without revealing proprietary network data?



What You'll Bring

Must-have


Hands-on data proficiency across both paradigms: you can build and validate ML proof-of-concepts (data exploration, feature engineering, model training, evaluation) using Python and standard ML tooling (scikit-learn, pandas, XGBoost, or equivalent), and you can design and evaluate LLM-based analysis pipelines (prompt design, retrieval-augmented approaches, output quality evaluation). You are not a data scientist or an ML engineer, but you can work like one when the problem requires it.
Shipped ML-powered products: you have personally driven an ML or data intelligence product from initial hypothesis to production, including defining evaluation criteria, partnering with data engineers and scientists, and making commercial decisions based on model performance data.
PM fundamentals with commercial depth: 3+ years shipping B2B SaaS products. You can build a business case, define pricing, run customer discovery, and hold direct conversations with enterprise buyers about ROI.
Data literacy that earns engineering respect: you understand data models, pipeline design, normalization challenges, and the practical constraints of real production data. You can review a data schema and immediately ask the right questions.
Clear communication across the technical and commercial boundary: you can explain a precision-recall tradeoff to a CPO and a carrier event data use case to a data engineer in the same afternoon, without condescending to either.
Excellent written and verbal English: you will write strategy documents, ML experiment briefs, customer-facing product narratives, and present to leadership, often in the same week.



Nice to have


Experience with time-series or logistics domain data: carrier performance modelling, routing optimization, ETA prediction, or related domains.
Familiarity with data platform concepts: data lake houses, feature stores, model registries, observability for ML in production.
Background in cross-customer benchmarking or network intelligence products, where the value comes from aggregation rather than individual customer data.
Experience with GDPR-compliant data product design in a multi-tenant B2B SaaS context.
Nordic or European logistics market experience: carrier landscape, regulatory environment, freight economics.
Track record of building the first data product at a company, defining standards rather than inheriting them.

What you'll be doing

Lead and manage a team of Data Scientists and Software Engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, scientific rigor, and operational excellence

A Master’s degree or PhD in computer science, mathematics, physics, statistics, machine learning or equivalent quantitative field
8+ years of experience in data science or applied machine learning, with 3+ years in a people management role

Title: Machine Learning Lead
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
August 10, 2026 - Copenhagen, Denmark




Building the Next Generation Foundation Models of Biology

We want to build the next generation of foundational models of biology. Most of medicine - and most of today's biological AI - still reads human biology through DNA and RNA. We go further: into the spatial proteome, where proteins act in the native tissue context where disease occurs. This is biology that models have never been trained on, because the data has never existed at scale. That is what we set out to change.

The data is here. ResOne, our molecular intelligence platform, has already profiled over a billion pixels and hundreds of millions of peptide and protein measurements, and we project growing that by orders of magnitude. Now comes the part we built it all for: training models of biology that inform the next generation of diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers in oncology, neurology, and chronic disease.

If you are excited about working with a one-of-a-kind biological data platform and turning its data into models that make a real difference, we would love to hear from you.




The Role

As Machine Learning Lead at Resolute Bio, you will own the modeling roadmap of our data. Today our predictive models are linear models built on foundation-model embeddings; the next step is self-supervised and multimodal architectures trained on our own data - and your job is to lead that transition. This is a player-coach role: in the beginning you will lead the charge yourself, designing, training, and evaluating the first generation of serious models, while guiding our deep learning engineers and shaping how ML gets done here as the practice grows. You will join a small, international team in central Copenhagen, in mission-driven work that translates into real differences in patient care, not just publications. We are an AI-forward team: we use agentic tools daily and expect you to be fluent with them - but the judgment about what to model, whether a result can be trusted, and when a simple baseline beats a fancy architecture still comes from you.




You Will

Own the ML roadmap - chart the path from today's linear baselines to the foundational models we train on ResOne's spatial proteomics data
Lead from the front - design, train, and evaluate models hands-on, especially in the beginning
Guide and mentor our deep learning engineers, setting the standards for how we build, evaluate, and ship models
Establish rigorous evaluation practice - strong baselines, ablations, and the discipline to catch leakage, batch effects, and confounders before they become false discoveries
Build self-supervised representations of our data and multimodal models that align modalities - connecting histology images and protein expression, with calibrated uncertainty you can act on
Build the path from prototype to production - training infrastructure, model serving, and monitoring for models the platform depends on
Shape what data we generate next - work with wet-lab and bioinformatics teams so that experiments are designed with the models in mind
Communicate modeling results and their limitations clearly to scientists, leadership, and partners


You Have




Education & Experience

MSc or PhD in machine learning, computer science, or a quantitative field, or equivalent experience
5+ years of applied ML experience, with a track record of taking models from idea to production and of guiding or mentoring other engineers

Technical Expertise

Deep, hands-on expertise in modern deep learning with PyTorch, across architectures such as transformers, CNNs/ViTs, and self-supervised approaches
Ruthless empirical fundamentals - evaluation design, strong baselines, error analysis, uncertainty calibration, and a nose for leakage and spurious signal in messy real-world data
Experience training models at scale - multi-GPU workflows and large, high-dimensional datasets
Experience serving large models in production - inference optimization, GPU serving, and monitoring
Strong Python and software-engineering fundamentals, and fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development tools

Mindset & Skills

You go wild on data, let evidence beat opinion, and are suspicious of results that look too good
Player-coach - you lead by building, and you make the people around you better
Pragmatic - you right-size the model to the problem and know when a linear baseline is the honest answer
Driven by impact - you want models that help answer biological questions, not just top a leaderboard


Nice to have

A strong competitive ML track record (e.g., Kaggle) demonstrating your ability to extract every drop of signal from a dataset
Experience with biological or medical data - omics, computational pathology, medical imaging, or clinical outcomes
Experience with self-supervised pretraining, pathology foundation models (e.g., UNI, Virchow), or CLIP-style multimodal alignment
Familiarity with ML infrastructure and MLOps - experiment tracking, training pipelines, feature/data stores
Publications, open-source contributions, or a public portfolio in relevant fields


Interested?

The role is on-site at our office in central Copenhagen. Please send your resume and a short cover letter to jobs@resolute.bio, with "ResBioML26" in the subject line - applications without the correct subject line will be filtered out. Feel free to include your salary expectations and any relevant portfolio links, such as GitHub, Kaggle, or publications.

As a company, we care about your potential, not your background. If this role excites you, do not hesitate to apply. We review applications as they come in and look forward to hearing from you!

Want to learn more about us first? Visit resolute.bio to see what we are building.

Who We Are

At Halfspace, Part of Accenture - Center for Advanced AI - we believe that the smallest edge can make the biggest difference. We began in sports, predicting outcomes in live football matches, and today we bring that same precision and ambition into the world of business. We're here to unlock value through artificial intelligence and help organisations make better, more informed decisions, faster.

With more than one hundred AI and data projects delivered, our work has transformed industries and earned international recognition. But awards and numbers tell only part of the story. What truly defines us is our people. Our team comes from leading institutions such as KU, DTU, Stanford, Oxford, Harvard, Caltech, Yale, Colombia and many more, blending expertise in physics, engineering, mathematics, statistics, operations research, computer science, chemistry, economics, biology, design and strategy. Together, we share curiosity, boldness, and a pioneering spirit.

Halfspace is a specialized spearheading unit within Accenture, focused on bringing the deepest expertise in applied AI. We are 'Inch Wide - Mile Deep' in our capabilities.

What You'll Be Doing

As part of the Engineering team at Halfspace, you’ll help build the data and AI platforms that power the next generation of applied intelligence. You’ll design, develop, and deploy robust systems that enable our scientists, researchers, and clients to transform data into insight — and insight into action.

You’ll work on complex, high-impact projects across industries, collaborating closely with experts in machine learning, data science, and strategy. From designing scalable data architectures and optimizing model pipelines, to integrating cutting-edge AI into enterprise environments, you’ll be at the core of turning ideas into reality.

Every line of code, every system you shape, will contribute to our mission: delivering the smallest edge that makes the biggest difference.

Who We're Looking For

We’re looking for engineers who combine deep technical ability with intellectual curiosity and a drive to push boundaries. You thrive in solving complex problems and take pride in building elegant, high-performance systems.

You may come from a background in software engineering, data engineering, MLOps, or platform architecture — but above all, you have a passion for applying technology to create meaningful impact.

We value:



Strong proficiency in one or more of Python, Java, C++, or similar languages

Experience with modern data and AI infrastructure (e.g., cloud platforms, distributed systems, CI/CD, containerization)

A solid understanding of software design principles, scalability, and performance optimization

A collaborative mindset and ability to work across disciplines

Curiosity, precision, and a pioneering spirit — the qualities that define Halfspace



If you have less than two years of professional experience, please include your academic transcripts with your application.

Life at Halfspace, part of Accenture

We think and act like a professional sports team. We value flexibility, trust, and balance. We invest in learning and development to keep our team ahead of the curve on everything AI. And we create an environment where ambitious people can grow while working on projects that matter, side by side with some of the world’s leading companies and greatest minds.

Halfspace was established in 2015. We're on a mission to bring the power of artificial intelligence to industry and deliver exceptional quality and value, whenever we engage, while creating a space which attracts the brightest, most curious and most talented people. As of March 2025 Halfspace became a part of Accenture to help build and grow the Accenture Center for Advanced AI across the Nordics and EMEA.

Title: Control and Simulation Specialist
Place: Aarhus Municipality, Central Denmark Region, Denmark
Description:
Vestas Wind Systems A/S > Research & Development (R&D) > Plant Innovation

In the Plant Innovation department, innovative ideas within wind power plants are transformed into concepts that form the foundation for Vestas to maintain its leadership in innovation. We promote a working environment with a high degree of freedom to explore new concepts and a willingness to take on high technical risks, as failures are one of the sources of major innovations.

We are a team of diverse people with different technical competencies, educational backgrounds, and personal traits - we are very collaborative and encourage taking initiative.

You will get the opportunity to be involved in a vast number of different programming tasks and development of applications for simulations, data processing, analysis, and wind turbine, wind power plant and energy solution optimization.

Responsibilities


Propose and conduct innovative ideas within wind farm control, and wind power simulation
Develop and perform feasibility studies and technical assessments of new technologies supporting control and performance improvements in wind and hybrid power plants
Develop and apply AI/ML solutions, including use of AI agents, to support analysis, optimization, and decision support use cases
Design, build, and test prototypes and proof-of-concept solutions through direct programming, simulation, and experimental development
Execute and coordinate activities within a specific project, including documentation


Qualifications


Master's degree (or PhD) in Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Energy Systems, Control Engineering, or a related technical field
Solid experience with wind farm/hybrid plant control, wind power simulation, or power plant modeling
Solid hands on experience in applied AI/ML development, AI based approaches for analysis, optimization, orchestration, or decision support applications
Demonstrated 5+ years of experience working with large-scale operational or industrial datasets, such as time series or SCADA-style data, including data preprocessing, feature engineering, and performance evaluation
Advanced programming skills in Python and MATLAB, C/C++, including use of ML frameworks, data pipelines, and simulation environments


Competencies


Motivated and creative approach to bring new ideas to feasibility assessment and business case justification, including risks, and scalability potential
Experience with new technology development and comfortable operating in an innovation environment with technical uncertainty and risk
An effective collaborator who shares knowledge and supports the team
Self-motivated, results-focused, and accountable
Clear and concise communicator of technical results to both specialist and non specialist stakeholders
Fluent English communication skills, both spoken and written


What We Offer

We offer an opportunity to be part of a collaborative team supporting Vestas' mission for sustainability. You will be part of an innovative organization and can contribute to future directions with your innovative ideas supporting highly skilled, creative, and international team working in an agile environment. We offer an attractive compensation package based on your qualifications, quality professional and personal development opportunities at a global manufacturer of wind turbines.

BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD

It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, www.vestas.com/en/careers/job-openings.

DEIB Statement

At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.

About Vestas

Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore. Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 173 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field. With 29,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future. Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity. To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

Title: Dataanalytiker med interesse for metode og dataanalyse
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Vil du være en del af et område med en høj politisk bevågenhed? Vil du være med til at udvikle analytiske modeller og andre dataunderstøttede løsninger, der skal bidrage til en mere effektiv inddrivelse af offentlig gæld? Har du stærke metodiske og dataanalytiske evner, og har du lyst til at afprøve dem på store datamængder? Så er du måske vores nye dataanalytiker i Center for Data, Analyse og Modeller.

I Center for data, analyse og modeller udvikler vi analytiske modeller og andre dataløsninger. Modellernes beregninger anvendes dels som input til at sætte den strategiske retning for inddrivelsesområdet og dels til at optimere driften via en datadreven optimering af inddrivelsesprocesserne.

Området har en høj grad af politisk bevågenhed, så forandringer er en del af hverdagen. Vi søger nye kolleger med et højt ambitionsniveau og en god metodisk og dataanalytisk faglighed, som vil være en del af vores team.

Vi arbejder med dataanalyser og analysemodeller til inddrivelsesområdet

Du bliver en del af et kontor, der kombinerer høj faglighed med tæt samarbejde i mindre grupper. Vi har en uformel omgangstone med højt til loftet. Kontoret består af mange fagligheder - fra fysikere til sociologier – alle dog med den fællesnævner, at vi interesserer os for metode og dataanalyse samt formidling af resultater til et bredt publikum.

Med udgangspunkt i et datawarehouse, der samler store mængder register- og transaktionsdata fra forskellige systemer, udfører vi dataanalyser og udvikler analysemodeller til inddrivelsesområdet. F.eks. udvikler vi modeller vedrørende skyldnersegmentering, fremskrivning, kursværdi, forældelse og produktionsstyring. Modellerne anvendes blandt andet til at belyse forskellige problemstillinger og konsekvenser, der er knyttet til områdets politiske og strategiske beslutninger.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil være at:


Håndtere og kombinere data og gennemføre dataanalyse på store datamængder
Udvikle eller videreudvikle vores statistiske/analytiske datamodeller
Belyse problemstillinger på inddrivelsesområdet og præge faglige drøftelser om opstilling af analysedesigns, metodevalg m.m.
Formidle forretningsviden og analyseresultater i eksempelvis notater eller præsentationer
Koordinere og styre processer ift. leverancer til vores interessenter.


Selvstændig, fagligt ansvarsfuld og grundig profil

Vi forestiller os, at du ved ansættelsestidspunktet har afsluttet en akademisk uddannelse på kandidatniveau indenfor et samfundsfagligt eller naturvidenskabeligt område. Du kunne fx være økonom, politolog, sociolog, matematiker eller fysiker.

Det er vigtigt, at du:


Via dit studie eller tidligere arbejde har praktisk erfaring med at håndtere og analysere data ved brug af kvantitative analysemetoder, fx via SQL, SAS, SPSS, Matlab, R, Python eller lignende værktøjer
Interesserer dig for dataanalyse og analytiske metoder, og at du er hurtig til at sætte dig ind i nye programmeringssprog
Er grundig, fagligt ansvarsfuld og kan arbejde selvstændigt på projekter med en lang tidshorisont.


Det er en fordel, hvis:

Du har en stærk analytisk sans, som gør dig i stand til at fordybe dig i komplekse problemstillinger indenfor databehandling og -analyse. Dertil har du en politisk forståelse, så du kan se konteksten, hvori dit arbejde indgår. Endelig er du i stand til at formidle dine resultater i et klart sprog, og du trives i et nogle gange travlt arbejdsmiljø, der stiller krav til både hastighed og præcision.

Grundig introduktion og oplæring

Du kan se frem til et fagligt udfordrende job med samfundsrelevante arbejdsopgaver på en arbejdsplads, som lægger stor vægt på faglighed og samarbejde. Som nyansat vil du indgå i et grundigt introduktions- og oplæringsforløb, for hurtigt at komme ind i arbejdsopgaverne. Udover introduktionsforløbet vil du blive tildelt en fast kollega fra teamet, som vil kunne hjælpe dig og besvare spørgsmål i opstartsfasen.

Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår

Send din ansøgning med CV, eksamensbevis og andre relevante dokumenter via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest søndag d. 30. august 2026. Spørgsmål besvares gerne af kontorchef Troels Verge på telefon 72 38 93 56 eller analytiker Sofie Scholl på telefon 72 37 82 59 eller mail sofie.scholl@gaeldst.dk.

Vi forventer at afholde 1. og 2. samtaler i løbet af uge 36 og 37. Der kan indgå en case og/eller person- og logikanalyse i rekrutteringsprocessen.

Forud for ansættelse foretager vi restancetjek for så vidt angår restancer til det offentlige. Vi indhenter straffeattest og referencer forud for ansættelsen.

Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten (AC), overenskomst for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og It-medarbejdere (HK) eller overenskomst for fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet.

Forventet tiltrædelse er den 1. november 2026 eller efter nærmere aftale.

Du bliver ansat i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner.Arbejdsstedet er Osvald Helmuths Vej 4, 2000 Frederiksberg.

Om Gældsstyrelsen

’Vi hjælper Danmark ud af gæld - vi er statens inkasso.’

Gældsstyrelsens opgave er at sikre, at så mange som muligt betaler deres gæld til det offentlige, og at ny gæld forebygges. Men det handler ikke kun om kroner og øre. Når vi inddriver gæld, gør det en forskel for vores fælles retsfølelse og sammenhængskraft.

Borgere og virksomheder skal møde en åben og kommunikerende styrelse, som tager dialogen i øjenhøjde og evner at gøre det komplekse forståeligt. Derfor lægger vi vægt på at have dygtige og motiverede medarbejdere, som med høj faglighed forstår at balancere samarbejde og service med myndighedsrollen. Vi søger løbende nye kolleger, som deler vores ambition om at hjælpe Danmark ud af gæld.

Læs mere om os på  gaeldst.dk .

Gældsstyrelsen opfordrer alle kvalificerede uanset alder, køn, seksuel orientering, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

Title: Biostatistician and Statistical Programmer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Application deadline: 23/08/2026

Location: Ballerup 2750, Denmark, Denmark

Contract type: Permanent

Job ID: 4095

Role Description

Use your expertise in both biostatistics and statistical programming to shape evidence that supports better decisions for patients, healthcare systems, and science. In this role, you will work across clinical development, publications, and market access, applying your skills where they can create clear and visible impact. If you are looking for a position that offers variety, scientific depth, and the opportunity to work beyond a traditional specialist track, this could be the right next step for you.

Join us in creating a future legacy in medical dermatology

At LEO Pharma, we are global leaders in medical dermatology. We have 115 years’ experience in bringing innovation to healthcare. And we are eager to do much more. Each year, close to 100 million people have a better day because of our medicines. This is a unique opportunity to combine biostatistics and statistical programming in one highly impactful role, working across clinical development, publications, and market access in a way that offers both variety and visibility.

Your role

As our new Biostatistician & Statistical Programmer, you will play a key role in generating robust evidence from Phase 2b, Phase 3, and Phase 4 clinical trials, as well as non-interventional studies and external data sources. This is a broad and hands-on role where you will combine statistical thinking with programming expertise to support publication activities, pricing and reimbursement discussions, and evidence generation across our portfolio.

Perform biostatistical analyses and statistical programming for publication-related analysis requests, including abstracts and manuscripts
Conduct subgroup analyses to support affiliate pricing and reimbursement negotiations
Provide programming and statistical input to HTA and payer-related deliverables
Program, quality control, and document datasets, tables, figures, and listings
Contribute statistical guidance for meta-analyses and indirect treatment comparisons, including network meta-analysis and population-adjustment methods based on patient-level data


The role offers a rare opportunity to combine biostatistics and statistical programming in one position with broad scientific impact, working across diverse data sources including clinical trial, real-world, and external database evidence. You will contribute directly to publications, market access, and evidence-generation activities while joining a collaborative international environment with strong technical peers.

Your Qualifications

To succeed in this role, we imagine that you have the following qualifications:

MSc or PhD in Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative discipline
Experience working in the pharmaceutical industry or a related field
Strong practical expertise in SAS (familiarity with R will be an added value)
Experience with CDISC standards, including ADaM and SDTM, and familiarity with relevant regulatory guidelines
Experience with statistical analysis in clinical trials, and preferably also meta-analysis or indirect treatment comparison methods


LEO Pharma is built on collaboration, innovation and curiosity. Is this you? Can you bring this and a self-driven, flexible, and supportive mindset, along with the ability to thrive in cross-functional collaboration and a fast-paced environment?

Your new team

You will join the Real World Evidence DA & COA department within Global Clinical Development, where we work at the intersection of biostatistics, real-world evidence, and clinical outcome assessment. The team collaborates closely across projects and functions to deliver high-quality analyses that support both scientific and business decisions. In this role, your main interfaces will be with fellow biostatisticians and statistical programmers, with occasional collaboration across Medical Affairs, HEOR, and Market Access.

Your application

For additional information, please contact Niels Hoejsager Bennike, Head of Real World Evidence, DA and COA at NHBDK@leo-pharma.com.

You do not need to upload a cover letter, but feel free to add a few sentences in your resume or CV on why this position has your interest. Please refrain from adding a photo to your CV.

Beyond the skin

Become part of LEO Pharma, a global leader in medical dermatology, as we go beyond the skin to make a lasting impact. We are the legacy-builders of the future – enabling people to have a better today and tomorrow. With the world as our lab, we are transforming innovative ideas into more effective and easier-to-use medicines. Through collaboration and partnerships, we can do much more.

At LEO Pharma, we believe in the power of individuals to drive change. Our flat organizational structure empowers you to make a visible impact and offers versatile roles for professional growth. We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, recognizing that our different perspectives, backgrounds, and attitudes enable us to make the best decisions. Join our passionate team at LEO Pharma and be yourself as we work together to make a fundamental difference.

For certain positions, LEO Pharma might complete a background check conducted by a third party.

  • Contribute statistical guidance for meta-analyses and indirect treatment comparisons, including network meta-analysis and population-adjustment methods based on patient-level data

The role offers a rare opportunity to combine biostatistics and statistical programming in one position with broad scientific impact, working across diverse data sources including clinical trial, real-world, and external database evidence. You will contribute directly to publications, market access, and evidence-generation activities while joining a collaborative international environment with strong technical peers.

Your Qualifications

To succeed in this role, we imagine that you have the following qualifications:
  • MSc or PhD in Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative discipline
  • Experience working in the pharmaceutical industry or a related field
  • Strong practical expertise in SAS (familiarity with R will be an added value)
  • Experience with CDISC standards, including ADaM and SDTM, and familiarity with relevant regulatory guidelines
  • Experience with statistical analysis in clinical trials, and preferably also meta-analysis or indirect treatment comparison methods

LEO Pharma is built on collaboration, innovation and curiosity. Is this you? Can you bring this and a self-driven, flexible, and supportive mindset, along with the ability to thrive in cross-functional collaboration and a fast-paced environment?

Your new team

You will join the Real World Evidence DA & COA department within Global Clinical Development, where we work at the intersection of biostatistics, real-world evidence, and clinical outcome assessment. The team collaborates closely across projects and functions to deliver high-quality analyses that support both scientific and business decisions. In this role, your main interfaces will be with fellow biostatisticians and statistical programmers, with occasional collaboration across Medical Affairs, HEOR, and Market Access.

Your application

For additional information, please contact Niels Hoejsager Bennike, Head of Real World Evidence, DA and COA at NHBDK@leo-pharma.com.

You do not need to upload a cover letter, but feel free to add a few sentences in your resume or CV on why this position has your interest. Please refrain from adding a photo to your CV.

Become part of LEO Pharma, a global leader in medical dermatology, as we go beyond the skin to make a lasting impact. We are the legacy-builders of the future – enabling people to have a better today and tomorrow. With the world as our lab, we are transforming innovative ideas into more effective and easier-to-use medicines. Through collaboration and partnerships, we can do much more.

At LEO Pharma, we believe in the power of individuals to drive change. Our flat organizational structure empowers you to make a visible impact and offers versatile roles for professional growth. We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, recognizing that our different perspectives, backgrounds, and attitudes enable us to make the best decisions. Join our passionate team at LEO Pharma and be yourself as we work together to make a fundamental difference.

Title: Data Engineer with 3+ years of experience in Databricks and/or Microsoft Fabric, Aarhus
Description:
Are you passionate about designing and building strong, scalable data solutions that create meaningful value? Do you enjoy working where technology and business meet, helping translate complex data challenges into clear, impactful outcomes? Whether your strengths are in partnering with clients or engineering high-performing data pipelines, we would be delighted to welcome you into Valcon’s growing data community.

About Us

Valcon is a leading European management consulting firm with Scandinavian roots. With offices in the Netherlands, Denmark, the UK, Sweden, Croatia and Serbia, we bring strategy and operations closer together through innovative technology and data. We are looking for people who are curious, collaborative and motivated to make a difference, with a positive and proactive mindset.

Experience


Data Consulting, bridging data into business needs
3+ years of experience
A master’s degree
Ideally, hands-on experience with Databricks, Fabric and the wider Azure ecosystem for Data & AI


Keywords


Data Engineer // Data Consultant
Drive clarity not only around the “how”, but also the “why” for data engineering solutions


Location: Denmark

The role

As a data consultant at one of Europe’s fastest-growing consultancies, you will translate technical data concepts into clear business value and ensure systems are aligned with organisational objectives. You will design and build scalable ETL pipelines that support data integration and transformation needs, using modern tools and technologies such as Databricks, Azure, dbt and Fabric to create meaningful solutions for our clients.

You will develop data models and architectures that enable efficient querying, reporting and analysis in complex environments. You will also help ensure strong engineering practices through CI/CD pipelines, test automation, DevOps and MLOps approaches, while bringing clarity to both the “how” and the “why” behind each solution.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is skilled, curious and committed to both personal and professional growth. You bring a master’s degree and significant practical experience as a data engineer or in a similar role, ideally three or more years. You have a consulting mindset and enjoy working closely with clients both on-site and remotely. As we work with both international and Danish clients, proficiency in Danish is a plus.

You have hands-on expertise in Databricks, Microsoft Fabric and the wider Azure Data & AI ecosystem, with strong skills in Python, SQL and ideally PySpark. You bring a solid foundation in data modelling and architecture, including concepts such as Star schema and Data Vault, and you are familiar with data extraction tools such as ADF, Fivetran, DLTHub and Lakeflow Connect, as well as BI and orchestration tools such as dbt, Airflow and Dagster.

Experience with Git version control, CI/CD, DevOps, MLOps, test automation, streaming data solutions and API data extraction will support you well in the role. We also value a genuine commitment to continuous learning, including achieving relevant certifications over time.

Certifications we value

We highly regard the following technical certifications, although they are not required upfront:


Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate (or higher)
DP-100 Azure Data Scientist Associate
DP-203 Data Engineering on Microsoft Azure
DP-600 Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate
DP-700 Fabric Data Engineer Associate
AI-102 Azure AI Engineer Associate
AZ-104 Azure Administrator Associate
AZ-305 Azure Solutions Architect Expert


If you do not yet hold these certifications, we will support you in achieving many of them over time. Your first-year learning plan will include certifications and advisory fundamentals to help you create strong impact with our clients.

We offer a clear career model with transparent roles and expectations, relevant training and certifications, and an equal process for everyone. You will be part of a diverse and international work environment with an informal culture, flat hierarchy and opportunities for both personal and professional growth.

What We Can Offer

At Valcon, we believe in fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and respected. You will have the opportunity to combine your data expertise with some of the best business consultants to solve complex business problems and create tangible benefits for our clients. You will collaborate with talented and experienced consultants across business areas and levels and be supported by enhanced benefits throughout all life stages, including maternity, paternity and adoption leave, health and well-being initiatives, and resources for navigating significant life transitions. Our value-driven culture is guided by Integrity, Together, Joy, Curious and Can Do, and you can also look forward to engaging in social activities. In Aarhus, you will join a small but growing office with a start-up vibe.

Application

If this sounds like you, we warmly encourage you to apply today and share how you would like to contribute as our new data engineer. We review applications on an ongoing basis. For questions or further information, feel free to contact Jesper Nielsen – [email protected] or Casper Høgh – [email protected].

Title: Data Engineer – vil du udvikle moderne dataløsninger i cloud med Snowflake, dbt og AI?
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Vil du være med til at bygge fremtidens dataløsninger i skyen og skabe værdi gennem data? Hos LB Forsikring betragter vi data som en af vores mest værdsatte ressourcer, og nu har du muligheden for at slutte dig til vores Data Team, hvor vi udvikler vores moderne dataplatform i skyen.




Vil du gerne forandre og være noget særligt for andre? Som medarbejder i LB får du mere substans i dit job, hvor vilkår, goder og fleksibilitet gavner det hele menneske. Hos LB Forsikring lægger vi sjæl i arbejdet, og vi møder medlemmer, kolleger og omverden med skærpet sans. Du bliver en del af et medlemsejet fællesskab, hvor vi er der for hinanden. Vi deler også målet om at gøre forsikring overflødig.




Vi arbejder for at skabe en arbejdsplads, hvor innovation, samarbejde og vedvarende læring er i fokus. Du bliver en del af et team af engagerede og dygtige fagfolk, hvor vi værdsætter åben kommunikation, kreativitet og en sund balance mellem arbejde og privatliv.




Lyder de her opgaver som noget for dig?

Som data engineer bliver du en del af vores centraliserede datateam med ca. 25 specialister inden for data engineering, data governance og data operations.




Du får en central rolle i den videre udvikling af vores moderne cloud-baserede dataplatform, hvor Snowflake og dbt er centrale teknologier. Vi arbejder med standardisering, automatisering og moderne udviklingsmetoder for at skabe en skalerbar, robust og fremtidssikret dataplatform. Samtidig ser vi AI og agentbaserede løsninger som en vigtig del af fremtidens dataudvikling og forventer, at du bidrager til at anvende disse teknologier til at optimere vores udviklingsprocesser og skabe endnu mere værdi gennem data.




Dine væsentligste opgaver i stillingen vil være:




Udvikle, optimere og vedligeholde robuste datapipelines i Snowflake og dbt
Integrere og strukturere data fra både interne systemer og eksterne kilder
Modellere og transformere komplekse forretningsdata til dimensionelle datamodeller
Sikre høj datakvalitet gennem overvågning, test, validering og automatiserede kontroller
Udvikle semantiske lag og bidrage til standardisering af fælles datamodeller og definitioner
Dokumentere datastrukturer, datamodeller og processer, så data kan anvendes bredt og sikkert i organisationen
Samarbejde med forretningen og analytikere om at gøre data tilgængelige, forståelige og værdiskabende
Anvende AI-assistenter og Copilots til at effektivisere udviklingsarbejdet, fx kodeforslag, dokumentation, test og kvalitetssikring
Bidrage til at afprøve agentbaserede løsninger, der kan automatisere rutineopgaver og understøtte en mere effektiv dataudviklingsproces
Være med til at etablere best practices for ansvarlig og værdiskabende brug af AI i data engineering




Vil du være en del af vores fællesskab?

Vi ønsker, at du trives, og at vi når vores mål sammen. Derfor kigger vi blandt andet på, om du har følgende faglige og personlige færdigheder til jobbet:




Minimum 2-5 års erfaring som Data Engineer eller lignende rolle
Solid praktisk erfaring med Snowflake og dbt (certificeringer er en fordel)
Solide SQL-kompetencer og erfaring med datamodellering
Erfaring med CI/CD, Git og gerne Infrastructure as Code
Erfaring med eller stor interesse for anvendelse af AI, Copilots og agentbaserede løsninger i udviklingsarbejdet
Forståelse for datasikkerhed og compliance (fx GDPR)
Kendskab til Power BI
Forståelse for, hvordan AI kan bruges ansvarligt til at automatisere, optimere og kvalitetssikre dataudviklingsprocesser
Interesse for automatisering, standardisering og skalerbare løsninger
Nysgerrighed på nye teknologier og lyst til løbende at udfordre og forbedre arbejdsmetoder




Du er nysgerrig på, hvordan et solidt datafundament understøtter AI-løsninger, og du ser AI som et naturligt værktøj i den moderne udviklingsproces. Vil du gerne forandre og være noget særligt for andre? Som medarbejder i LB får du mere substans i dit job, hvor vilkår, goder og fleksibilitet gavner det hele menneske. Hos LB Forsikring lægger vi sjæl i arbejdet, og vi møder medlemmer, kolleger og omverden med skærpet sans. Du bliver en del af et medlemsejet fællesskab, hvor vi er der for hinanden. Vi deler også målet om at gøre forsikring overflødig.


Vi arbejder for at skabe en arbejdsplads, hvor innovation, samarbejde og vedvarende læring er i fokus. Du bliver en del af et team af engagerede og dygtige fagfolk, hvor vi værdsætter åben kommunikation, kreativitet og en sund balance mellem arbejde og privatliv.


Lyder de her opgaver som noget for dig?

Som data engineer bliver du en del af vores centraliserede datateam med ca. 25 specialister inden for data engineering, data governance og data operations.


Du får en central rolle i den videre udvikling af vores moderne cloud-baserede dataplatform, hvor Snowflake og dbt er centrale teknologier. Vi arbejder med standardisering, automatisering og moderne udviklingsmetoder for at skabe en skalerbar, robust og fremtidssikret dataplatform. Samtidig ser vi AI og agentbaserede løsninger som en vigtig del af fremtidens dataudvikling og forventer, at du bidrager til at anvende disse teknologier til at optimere vores udviklingsprocesser og skabe endnu mere værdi gennem data.


Dine væsentligste opgaver i stillingen vil være:


  • Udvikle, optimere og vedligeholde robuste datapipelines i Snowflake og dbt
  • Integrere og strukturere data fra både interne systemer og eksterne kilder
  • Modellere og transformere komplekse forretningsdata til dimensionelle datamodeller
  • Sikre høj datakvalitet gennem overvågning, test, validering og automatiserede kontroller
  • Udvikle semantiske lag og bidrage til standardisering af fælles datamodeller og definitioner
  • Dokumentere datastrukturer, datamodeller og processer, så data kan anvendes bredt og sikkert i organisationen
  • Samarbejde med forretningen og analytikere om at gøre data tilgængelige, forståelige og værdiskabende
  • Anvende AI-assistenter og Copilots til at effektivisere udviklingsarbejdet, fx kodeforslag, dokumentation, test og kvalitetssikring
  • Bidrage til at afprøve agentbaserede løsninger, der kan automatisere rutineopgaver og understøtte en mere effektiv dataudviklingsproces
  • Være med til at etablere best practices for ansvarlig og værdiskabende brug af AI i data engineering

  • Solid praktisk erfaring med Snowflake og dbt (certificeringer er en fordel)

  • Erfaring med CI/CD, Git og gerne Infrastructure as Code

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Technology at Primark

Our technology team is actively shaping the next wave of advancements. Engaged with innovative initiatives, your expertise will propel our business into the future. Collaborating with a creative team of tech enthusiasts, you’ll contribute your unique skills to fuel our technological advancements.

We are seeking a Data Scientist to join Primark’s Data Science & Measurement team, delivering advanced analytics, experimentation and data science solutions that drive better business decisions. You will work closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Analytics teams and business stakeholders to solve complex challenges using data. Leveraging Python, SQL, statistics and machine learning, you will develop models, analyse large datasets and generate actionable insights. This is a hands-on role for a commercially minded professional who can translate complex analysis into clear recommendations. You will contribute to reusable analytical assets, robust methodologies and scalable solutions that support business growth. The role offers an exciting opportunity to help shape Primark’s growing data science capability and deliver measurable business value.

What You'll Do


Data Science & Advanced Analytics: Design and deliver data science solutions including predictive modelling, forecasting, segmentation, optimisation, experimentation and measurement to support better business decisions and measurable outcomes.
Data Preparation & Analysis: Build, transform and analyse complex datasets using Python, SQL, Databricks and modern analytics tools to create robust analytical datasets and scalable workflows.
Machine Learning & Statistical Modelling: Develop, evaluate and monitor machine learning and statistical models, applying best practices across feature engineering, model validation, documentation and performance assessment.
Experimentation & Commercial Insight: Support A/B testing and measurement initiatives, helping to define hypotheses, assess results and quantify the commercial impact of business decisions and interventions.
Stakeholder Partnership & Storytelling: Work closely with business stakeholders and senior data professionals to translate complex analytical findings into clear, compelling recommendations that drive action.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Data Engineers, Analytics teams and platform specialists to productionise analytical solutions, improve scalability and ensure operational reliability.
Continuous Improvement & Data Science Innovation: Contribute to reusable analytical assets, coding standards and best practices while identifying opportunities to automate processes, improve analytical quality and increase adoption of data science solutions across the business.


What You'll Bring


Data Science Experience (2-5 Years): Experience applying data science, machine learning, statistical modelling and advanced analytics techniques to solve real-world business problems and deliver measurable outcomes.
Python, SQL & Analytical Expertise: Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience building robust, reproducible analyses and working with large datasets in modern analytics environments such as Databricks, Spark or cloud-based platforms.
Machine Learning & Statistical Foundations: Solid understanding of supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, experimentation, A/B testing and statistical analysis techniques.
Business Problem Solving & Commercial Mindset: Ability to translate business questions into analytical approaches, testable hypotheses and practical solutions that support commercial decision-making and value creation.
Data Storytelling & Stakeholder Engagement: Proven ability to communicate complex analytical findings through clear narratives, visualisations and recommendations that influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Collaboration & Delivery: Experience working effectively across Data Science, Analytics, Engineering and business teams, balancing analytical rigour with pragmatic delivery in fast-paced environments.
Continuous Learning & Innovation: Demonstrated curiosity for emerging technologies, data science techniques and AI capabilities, with a commitment to quality, simplicity and continuous improvement.


About Primark

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to a £9bn+ turnover business and over 80,000 colleagues and over 440 stores in 17 countries today. Our values run through everything we do. In essence, we're Caring and always strive to put people first. We're also Dynamic, bravely pushing the boundaries to stay ahead. And finally, we succeed Together.
